CVE-2026-104933.description: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

CVE-2026-106535.description: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a crafted VSDX file contained a malformed path from one part of the drawing to another. In fixed versions a malformed path is handled without writing outside its data.

CVE-2026-108169.description: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.
CVE-2026-108169.summary_ko: LibreOffice에서 명령줄 인수로 전달된 웹 쿼리 파일(.iqy)을 열면, 조작된 파일의 주소로 인해 웹 페이지 열기 이외의 동작이나 코드 실행이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-108169.background_ko: 웹 쿼리 파일에서 가져온 주소에 명령줄로 직접 전달된 주소에 적용되는 검사를 수행하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-113630.description: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows a local attacker with command execution as the ds user to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted --hash argument that is interpolated unvalidated into a GNU sed expression, where the sed e flag runs attacker-controlled commands. The packaged sudoers policy permits ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.
CVE-2026-113630.summary_ko: 공식 onlyoffice/documentserver 컨테이너의 ONLYOFFICE Docs 9.4.0-129에서 ds 사용자 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있는 로컬 공격자가 명령 주입으로 root 권한의 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-113630.background_ko: 유지보수 스크립트가 검증하지 않은 인수를 명령 실행이 가능한 sed 표현식에 삽입하며, sudoers 정책은 ds의 해당 스크립트 root 실행을 비밀번호나 인수 제한 없이 허용한다.

CVE-2026-113631.description: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows an authenticated view-only user to export a reconstructed copy of a document, including content the viewer never displayed such as custom XML, custom document properties and field instruction text, even when download and form-filling are disabled. The attacker reconnects with a valid Session JWT while substituting an attacker-controlled callback URL, which the Session JWT does not bind, then invokes sendForm over RPC, causing DocumentServer to send the reconstructed DOCX to that URL.
CVE-2026-113631.summary_ko: 공식 onlyoffice/documentserver 컨테이너의 ONLYOFFICE Docs 9.4.0-129에서 인증된 읽기 전용 사용자가 다운로드와 양식 입력이 차단돼도 문서 사본을 내보낼 수 있다. 사본에는 뷰어에 표시되지 않은 사용자 지정 XML·문서 속성·필드 명령문도 포함될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-113631.background_ko: sendForm RPC의 인가 검증이 부적절하고, 재연결 처리에서 Session JWT가 콜백 URL에 바인딩되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-129235.description: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the download_file tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go accepts caller-controlled path and dest values, fetches a selected Kubeshark Hub API response, and writes the returned bytes through os.Create(dest) in callDownloadFile without confining the destination. An attacker who influences arguments through an AI agent driving kubeshark mcp can write Hub-supplied bytes to any path writable by the local MCP user and can read captured network traffic from default auth-disabled Hub deployments. The tool is registered without --allow-destructive; reliable code execution is not demonstrated because the bytes are constrained to Hub API responses. Hub-side default authentication remains outside this remediation, so captured traffic can remain readable in default auth-disabled Hub deployments after the local destination-write fix. The destination-write issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

CVE-2026-129236.description: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the start_kubeshark MCP tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go uses callStartKubeshark to append caller-controlled pod_regex as a bare positional argument to kubeshark tap without a -- end-of-options separator, allowing a value beginning with --set to be parsed as a Helm value override. An attacker who influences tool arguments against kubeshark mcp --allow-destructive can redirect the privileged worker, Hub, and front images through tap.docker.registry and tap.docker.tag to an attacker-controlled registry. Because the deployed worker DaemonSet runs privileged with host networking and host filesystem access, a malicious image can obtain node and cluster-admin access when the host already has permission to deploy it. This issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

CVE-2026-129237.description: qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.41, the unpackTar extraction logic in app/utils/tar.go validates cleaned archive entry paths with strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, destdirClean) without enforcing a path-separator boundary. When UseContext enables the Docker Compose build context path in app/configuration/bundle_docker_compose.go, a less-privileged archive supplier with delegated configuration and/or file-manager access can provide a sibling-prefix traversal entry that passes the check, causing utils.UnpackTar to create directories and regular files outside the intended context extraction directory with qbee-agent process privileges, despite the supplier lacking authority to write those sibling files. In deployments where only full device or fleet administrators can provide Docker Compose context archives, this behavior is hardening rather than a crossed security boundary. The demonstrated impact is limited to nearby cache or project paths sharing the destination prefix, may affect integrity or availability of qbee-agent-managed Docker Compose state, and does not establish arbitrary absolute-path writes or direct code execution. This issue is fixed in version 2026.41.

CVE-2026-129239.description: Directus is a real-time API and App dashboard for managing SQL database content. Prior to 12.3.1, Directus allows an authenticated non-admin with update permission on directus_shares to modify user_created, role, item, and collection on an existing owned share because authorization checks the pre-update row and does not revalidate the merged row. The update path does not force user_created to the acting user or rerun share access checks when item or collection changes. Setting user_created and role to administrator identifiers causes guest share authentication to derive administrator accountability from both fields, exposing data reachable from the shared item beyond the owner and share role permissions. The issue requires update permission on directus_shares, an item the account can share, and knowledge of administrator user and role identifiers, and it does not issue an administrator token or provide write or availability impact. This issue is fixed in version 12.3.1.

CVE-2026-18563.description: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

CVE-2026-18564.description: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.
CVE-2026-18564.summary_ko: LibreOffice에서 PDF 2.0 옵션으로 내보낸 암호 보호 PDF는 암호를 몰라도 파일 암호화 키가 복구될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-18564.background_ko: 파일 암호화 키와 솔트를 암호학적 용도에 적합하지 않은 의사난수 생성기에서 생성했다.

CVE-2026-18565.description: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

CVE-2026-18566.description: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

CVE-2026-64890.description: : Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information vulnerability in Johnson Controls Open Blue Companion Android App on Android allows : Retrieve Embedded Secrets from Software. This issue affects Open Blue Companion Android App: before R2.22.0.

CVE-2026-84234.description: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mask, are converted along the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when an image with a transparency mask was converted, because positions taken from a crafted image were not checked against the size of the image buffer. In fixed versions the image size is limited, and the position of each mask pixel is checked before it is written.

CVE-2026-84443.description: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so opening or converting a crafted database document could run a macro and, through it, any command. In fixed versions macros bound to the events of a Base document follow the macro security setting, as macros in other documents do.
CVE-2026-84443.summary_ko: LibreOffice Base에서 조작된 데이터베이스 문서를 열거나 변환하면 매크로 보안 설정을 우회해 매크로와 임의 명령이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-84443.background_ko: Base 문서 이벤트에 연결된 매크로를 실행할 때 매크로 보안 설정을 적용하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-86046.description: termux-sync is an open source tool for backing up and restoring a Termux environment across devices. Prior to 1.2.4, termux-sync restore uses the parent directory of the untrusted manifest.json files.*.source value as an extraction destination, and extract_archive calls tarfile.extract on archive members without enforcing a destination boundary. A victim who restores a malicious or tampered backup from local, shared, GitHub, or Google Drive storage can have files written anywhere the Termux user can write, including shell startup files or executable scripts that can lead to code execution when later used. The restore path also accepts unsafe backup_name values for temporary paths, and archive members are not constrained to the intended destination. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.4.

CVE-2026-87932.description: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current values when the document is exported, including in a conversion run from the command line. Values taken from the document were not escaped where they were used, so a crafted document could write a file of its choosing anywhere the user can write when it was exported to DOCX. In fixed versions these values are written into the document directly, and the XSLT transformations LibreOffice runs can no longer write files or use the network.
CVE-2026-87932.summary_ko: LibreOffice Writer에서 조작된 문서를 DOCX로 내보내면 사용자가 쓰기 권한을 가진 임의의 위치에 파일이 기록될 수 있다. 명령줄을 통한 변환도 영향을 받는다.
CVE-2026-87932.background_ko: DOCX 내보내기 중 사용자 지정 XML 데이터를 갱신할 때 문서에서 가져온 값을 이스케이프하지 않고 사용했다.

CVE-2026-88987.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove script-capable XHTML and XML data URIs from stored CMS content. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-88988.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove SVG data URIs from stored CMS content even though SVG documents can execute script. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-88989.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form can send a direct save request that creates a new record even when the user does not have permission to create that record type. The server-side save path checks edit access but does not enforce the required create permission before persistence. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91110.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not normalize certain control bytes that browsers ignore when parsing URLs. A CMS author can place those bytes before a javascript: URL in stored content so the sanitiser misses the dangerous scheme, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views the content. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91112.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a user with CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin but without ADMIN can edit or reparent a group that grants ADMIN-equivalent permissions through an assigned role or a parent group, thereby escalating to full administrative privileges. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91113.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form can submit a user-controlled ClassName value to change the record into an unrelated class without the create and edit permission checks required for that target class. This permits an unauthorized record type change outside the GridField's intended model hierarchy. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91114.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, PermissionCheckboxSetField accepts permission codes that the field did not offer and stores them without an allowlist, then renders permission codes without escaping them. A user with access to the Security section can save attacker-controlled content as a permission code, causing JavaScript to execute in the browser of another user who views the field. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

CVE-2026-91115.description: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.13, the writer option of i18nTextCollectorTask is passed to the dependency injector without validating that it names an allowed writer implementation. A crafted dev task URL can therefore instantiate arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and execute code on the server. An administrator can be induced to run the task by following a link because the nested task did not require confirmation, and a site in dev mode exposes the path without authentication. CMS 5 is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.
CVE-2026-91115.summary_ko: Silverstripe Framework 6.0.0 이상 6.2.13 미만에서 임의 객체 생성으로 서버 코드 실행이 가능하다. 관리자의 작업 실행을 유도해 악용할 수 있으며, 개발 모드에서는 인증 없이 해당 경로에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-91115.background_ko: i18nTextCollectorTask의 writer 옵션이 허용된 구현인지 검증하지 않은 채 의존성 주입기에 전달되며, 하위 작업 실행에는 확인 절차가 없었다.

CVE-2026-97892.description: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size of the file. In fixed versions a signature that claims to cover anything outside the file is reported as not valid.

CVE-2026-97894.description: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line could be copied into the imported document. In fixed versions each line is read up to its limit and no further.

CVE-2026-97999.description: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the migration, because a value could be longer than the space set aside for its column. In fixed versions that space is enlarged whenever a value is longer than its column.

CVE-2026-98100.description: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken only from the picture data.

CVE-2026-129295.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.2.0 until 4.6.1, attacker-controlled email headers can cause polynomial regular-expression backtracking during ordinary parse_from_string(), parse_from_bytes(), or parse_from_file() calls. In src/mailparser/utils.py, get_addresses() invokes the _ADDR_FALLBACK_RE fallback when strict address parsing yields no usable address, and overlapping quantifiers rescan padded address headers quadratically or cubically. In src/mailparser/const.py, parse_received() applies _CLAUSE_SPLITTER to uncollapsed whitespace in a Received header, causing quadratic backtracking when a whitespace run is not followed by a clause keyword. A small, well-formed message can keep mail gateway, ticketing, quarantine, or archival parsing workers busy for extended periods. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.1.
CVE-2026-129295.summary_ko: mail-parser는 일반 이메일 파싱 중 공격자가 제어한 헤더로 정규식 역추적이 과도하게 발생할 수 있다. 작은 정상 형식의 메시지로도 메일 게이트웨이 등의 파싱 작업자가 장시간 점유될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129295.background_ko: 주소 파싱 대체 정규식의 겹치는 수량자와 Received 헤더에서 축약하지 않은 공백에 적용되는 절 분리 정규식이 과도한 역추적을 유발한다.

CVE-2026-129296.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.8.0 until 4.6.0, the write_attachments() and write_sample() APIs use attacker-controlled attachment filenames without sufficient sanitization and path containment validation. Directory traversal sequences and absolute filesystem paths can cause an attachment to be written outside the intended output directory. An attacker can overwrite files accessible to the parsing process when an application extracts attachments from a crafted message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.0.

CVE-2026-129297.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, get_server_ipaddress() can select an attacker-controlled address from attacker-controlled Received headers. The minimum mechanism needed to distinguish this spoofing issue, derived from the advisory's remediation analysis and verified fix evidence, is appearance-based candidate selection that can treat bracketed IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or HELO markers in sender-written text as MTA-recorded addresses and can continue past a trusted hop that names no address. Applications that rely on the returned value can attribute a message to an attacker-selected sender IP address. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.2.

CVE-2026-129299.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, multiple message-processing behaviors can raise exceptions or silently lose content. Headers colliding with methods such as Parse, Message, and Write_Attachments can place bound method objects into parsed output and raise TypeError when a caller requests JSON serialization such as mail_json. When byte input is parsed through parse_from_bytes(), an 8-bit header value returned as email.header.Header can likewise raise TypeError when an X_raw accessor passes the value to json.dumps; both exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy. Separately, rewritten names such as Subject_json and X_Spam_Flag can be substituted or disappear from mail, headers, and JSON output while has_defects remains false, and a headerless message can be treated as falsy before parser state is initialized, causing body and attachment properties to return empty values without an error signal. These behaviors can abort message processing or hide malicious indicators from downstream scanners. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.2.

CVE-2026-129300.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.7.0 until 4.6.3, receiveds_format() in src/mailparser/utils.py catches only TypeError and ValueError while converting the trailing date of an attacker-controlled Received header. An out-of-range year can cause calendar.timegm() to raise OverflowError, and a sufficiently large timezone offset can cause datetime.fromtimestamp() to raise OSError. These exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy, so one crafted header can abort the entire message parse through every parse_from_* entry point and may drop a queued batch. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

CVE-2026-129301.description: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.3, write_attachments() calls _safe_attachment_filename() and write_sample() without isolating failures for individual attacker-controlled MIME parts. An RFC 2231 filename containing a NUL, a basename exceeding NAME_MAX, or an undecodable base64 payload can raise ValueError, OSError, or binascii.Error and abort the entire save loop. Later attachments remain unwritten; when a caller catches only MailParserError, the failure is not surfaced through the expected library-exception path. If a downstream scanner or sandbox reads only the extraction directory, a payload after the crafted part can be missed even though it remains in the delivered message, and the aborted batch also causes availability loss. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

CVE-2026-129306.description: libspdm is a sample implementation that follows the DMTF SPDM specifications. Prior to 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2, libspdm_x509_verify_cert_chain() in os_stub/cryptlib_openssl/pk/x509.c and os_stub/cryptlib_mbedtls/pk/x509.c validates certificate signatures one link at a time instead of validating the complete X.509 path. In deployments using a pinned root with a constrained multi-tier PKI, an attacker holding a valid issuer credential below a constrained CA can present a subordinate certificate that exceeds pathLenConstraint or nameConstraints and may be accepted for SPDM identity validation. Exploitation requires the application to use libspdm's backend validation without an additional certificate-chain validation mechanism, the pinned root cannot be substituted, and the deployment's measurement policy must allow identity impersonation alone to satisfy its acceptance requirements. The mbedTLS backend remains unable to enforce nameConstraints because upstream mbedTLS does not implement that check. The full-chain validation changes are released in versions 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2.

CVE-2026-101327.description: A maliciously crafted DLL placed in a predictable, attacker-writable temporary directory used by the Autodesk Installer can lead to privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM due to insufficient validation of loaded libraries. An attacker with local and low-privilege access could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM.
CVE-2026-101327.summary_ko: Autodesk Installer의 취약점으로 로컬 저권한 공격자가 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM으로 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다. 이를 통해 SYSTEM 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-101327.background_ko: 예측 가능하고 공격자가 쓸 수 있는 임시 디렉터리에서 불러오는 라이브러리를 충분히 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-119346.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, Next.js applications that use NextResponse to set cookies on Edge runtime routes expose the internal x-middleware-set-cookie header in the public response. This affects App Router route handlers and Pages Router Edge API routes. The header duplicates each cookie value and its attributes, so JavaScript already running on the same origin can read values that the Set-Cookie header marks HttpOnly, including sensitive session tokens set on an affected response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.
CVE-2026-119346.summary_ko: Next.js에서 NextResponse로 쿠키를 설정하는 Edge 런타임 경로가 내부 헤더를 공개 응답에 노출한다. 같은 출처에서 이미 실행 중인 JavaScript가 HttpOnly로 설정된 세션 토큰 등의 쿠키 값을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-119346.background_ko: 쿠키 값과 속성을 복제하는 내부 x-middleware-set-cookie 헤더가 공개 응답에 포함된다.

CVE-2026-119347.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, the /_next/image optimizer in self-hosted Next.js deployments can process attacker-supplied SVG content even when dangerouslyAllowSVG is false, which is the default. The SVG reaches a parser that the application intended to keep disabled, increasing exposure to denial of service and vulnerabilities in SVG decoding. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.

CVE-2026-119348.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. Prior to 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js App Router route handlers and the fetch cache that return a fetched upstream response unchanged can emit a response whose declared framing does not match the body actually sent. When the application is behind an HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy that permits pipelined response queueing, a crafted upstream response can desynchronize responses between clients. The resulting desynchronization can inject a response into another client's queue or disclose another client's response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.
CVE-2026-119348.summary_ko: 자체 호스팅 Next.js의 App Router 라우트 핸들러와 fetch 캐시에서 응답 동기화가 어긋날 수 있다. HTTP/1.1 응답 파이프라이닝을 허용하는 역방향 프록시 환경에서는 다른 클라이언트의 응답 큐에 응답이 삽입되거나 응답이 노출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-119348.background_ko: 가져온 업스트림 응답을 그대로 반환할 때 선언된 응답 프레이밍과 실제 전송 본문이 일치하지 않을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119349.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.0.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js App Router applications that pass binary arguments, such as Uint8Array or Blob values, to functions using the 'use cache' directive can generate identical cache keys for distinct arguments. Requests with different binary arguments can therefore share a cached result, causing cross-user disclosure of cached data or allowing one request to poison results returned to another user. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
CVE-2026-119349.summary_ko: Next.js App Router에서 use cache 함수에 서로 다른 바이너리 인수를 전달해도 같은 캐시 결과가 공유될 수 있다. 이로 인해 사용자 간 캐시 데이터가 노출되거나 다른 사용자에게 반환되는 결과가 오염될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-119349.background_ko: use cache 함수에 전달된 서로 다른 바이너리 인수에 대해 동일한 캐시 키가 생성될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119350.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.4.0 until 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js applications served with next start can allow an unauthenticated request to poison a shared fallback shell when cacheComponents is true and partialPrefetching is unset or false. The affected dynamic route must have a prerenderable param declared by generateStaticParams whose requested value was not generated at build time, at least two never-prerenderable params below it, a layout that reads the shallower param inside a Suspense boundary, and a blocking fallback shell. A request-supplied placeholder route param whose path segment equals the percent-encoded bracketed name of its own deeper route param is incorrectly treated as unresolved, while the shallower concrete value is rendered into the shared shell and its HTTP status is persisted. Depending on application behavior, subsequent routes sharing that shell can receive a persistent 404 or attacker-selected substituted param text. Client hydration corrects substituted text, and the issue does not enable markup or script injection or disclose data. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.

CVE-2026-119351.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.2.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications with Cache Components enabled can reuse an outer 'use cache' entry across root param values when a nested 'use cache' call reads a root param through next/root-params and returns a value containing pending promises. React Flight can deliver the ready portion to the outer function before the inner cache finishes publishing its root-param dependencies. The outer entry can then complete and be persisted under a key that omits the root param, causing the first written value to be served for other root param values and allowing the outer entry to ignore nested cache tag invalidation and lifetimes. The leaked value is not attacker controlled and depends on which invocation writes the entry first. This variant does not require an existing inner cache entry or a slow cache handler and is not covered by the fix for CVE-2026-103004. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
CVE-2026-119351.summary_ko: Cache Components가 활성화된 Next.js에서 중첩된 use cache 호출로 인해 최초 저장된 값이 다른 루트 매개변수 요청에도 제공될 수 있다. 외부 캐시가 중첩 캐시의 태그 무효화와 수명을 무시할 수도 있다.
CVE-2026-119351.background_ko: React Flight가 내부 캐시의 루트 매개변수 의존성 게시 전에 준비된 값을 전달해, 외부 캐시가 해당 매개변수 없는 키로 저장될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119790.description: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.3.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications using the same 'use cache' function directly during rendering and through unstable_cache() can disclose cached data across root params when that function reads a root param. During the first fill after a cold process start, cross-request deduplication allows a concurrent unstable_cache() request to join the direct call's in-flight fill and receive its result before the root param mismatch is rejected. unstable_cache() then persists that result under a key that omits root params, causing later requests for other root param values to receive the same entry until revalidation or eviction. Exploitation requires the unstable_cache() request to arrive while the first fill is in flight. Outside this race, nesting 'use cache' inside unstable_cache() raises an unsupported-operation error, and avoiding that nesting prevents the issue. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
CVE-2026-119790.summary_ko: Next.js에서 루트 매개변수를 읽는 같은 use cache 함수를 렌더링 중 직접 호출하고 unstable_cache()에서도 사용하면 캐시 데이터가 다른 루트 매개변수 요청에 노출될 수 있다. 프로세스 시작 후 최초 캐시 채움 중 요청이 겹쳐야 발생한다.
CVE-2026-119790.background_ko: 요청 간 중복 제거가 루트 매개변수 불일치 거부 전에 진행 중인 결과를 공유하고, unstable_cache()가 이를 루트 매개변수 없는 키로 저장한다.

CVE-2026-125797.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Arraytics Timetics timetics allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Timetics: from n/a through 1.0.66.

CVE-2026-127218.description: Axigen Mail Server 10.3.3.67 through 10.3.3.x, 10.4.42 through 10.4.x, 10.5.29 through 10.5.x, 10.6.x before 10.6.41, and 10.7.x before 10.7.3 contains an unauthenticated denial of service vulnerability caused by uncontrolled recursion when validating query parameter and cookie values with a recursive regular expression engine before authentication in the WebAdmin and WebMail services. Attackers can send a single HTTP request with a query parameter or cookie value of a few thousand characters to exhaust the worker thread stack and crash the server process, taking down SMTP, IMAP, POP3, and web services repeatedly.
CVE-2026-127218.summary_ko: Axigen Mail Server의 WebAdmin·WebMail에 인증 없이 악용할 수 있는 서비스 거부 취약점이 있다. 작업 스레드의 스택 고갈로 서버 프로세스가 종료돼 SMTP·IMAP·POP3·웹 서비스가 함께 중단될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127218.background_ko: 인증 전에 재귀 정규식 엔진으로 쿼리 매개변수와 쿠키 값을 검증하는 과정에서 재귀 호출을 제어하지 못한다.

CVE-2026-128995.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Very Good Plugins WP Fusion Lite wp-fusion-lite allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Fusion Lite: from n/a through 3.48.0.

CVE-2026-129266.description: External control of a file path in Amazon Deep Java Library (DJL) versions 0.7.0 through 0.38.0 might allow a remote unauthenticated third party to read arbitrary files that the library process can access. To do this, the third party supplies a crafted model archive. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 0.39.0 or later.
CVE-2026-129266.summary_ko: Amazon Deep Java Library(DJL) 0.7.0~0.38.0에서 조작된 모델 아카이브로 인해 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 라이브러리 프로세스의 접근 권한 범위 내에서 임의 파일을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129266.background_ko: 모델 아카이브를 통해 파일 경로를 외부에서 제어할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129307.description: eml_parser serves as a python module for parsing eml files and returning various information found in the e-mail as well as computed information. In 3.0.3 and earlier, eml_parser.routing.parserouting() in eml_parser/routing.py builds a regular expression with multiple greedy capture groups and appends the npdate date literal extracted from a normalized copy of an attacker-controlled Received header, then searches that expression against the original unnormalized line. A formatting difference can make the trailing literal impossible to match, causing exhaustive backtracking across the greedy groups at each start position. The unsliced Received-header path is invoked by decode_email, decode_email_bytes, and parse_email, so one small unauthenticated message can pin a parser worker and create sustained queue backlog. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.4.

CVE-2026-83816.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, the ExecShellTool::approval_requirement_for path used is_parallel_readonly_command to downgrade commands to automatic approval based on a flag-stripped command allowlist. The allowlist treated fd, rg, and git grep as read-only even when fd -x or fd --exec, rg --pre, or git grep --open-files-in-pager selected an external program. registered_tool_approval_required returned without displaying a prompt for that automatic classification, and the later command-safety check also treated the base utilities as safe. Attacker-controlled content that influenced an agent tool call could therefore cause arbitrary program execution on the developer host without the approval promised by the default interactive profile, resulting in unauthorized access, modification, or disruption. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.
CVE-2026-83816.summary_ko: 터미널 코딩 에이전트 CodeWhale 0.9.0 이전 버전에 도구 명령 승인 우회 취약점이 있다. 공격자 통제 콘텐츠가 도구 호출에 영향을 주면 개발자 호스트에서 승인 없이 임의 프로그램이 실행되어 무단 접근·변조·중단이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-83816.background_ko: 옵션을 제거한 허용 목록이 외부 프로그램 실행 명령을 읽기 전용으로 오분류해 승인 요청을 생략하며, 후속 안전 검사도 기본 명령을 안전하다고 판단한다.

CVE-2026-83817.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, DEFAULT_AUTOMATION_AUTO_APPROVE caused AutomationRecord::task_auto_approve to resolve an omitted setting to true, and the automation_create schema advertised the same insecure default. enqueue_run_task converted that omission into an explicit true value, bypassing the safer task-path fallback and selecting ApprovalMode::Bypass for each scheduled run. After a user approved creation of an apparently benign recurring automation, subsequent executions could silently authorize mutating tools without a human present, and an automation created with shell access could repeatedly execute commands. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

CVE-2026-87027.description: In EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled, the key used to encrypt temporary files was incompletely initialized. The code applied sizeof() to a pointer to the key buffer rather than to the buffer itself, so only 8 of the intended 32 bytes were filled from a secure random source and the remaining 24 bytes kept whatever was already in memory. This reduces the guaranteed randomness of the temporary-file key from 256 bits to 64 bits. Exploiting this requires local read access to the server's temporary-file directory, and those files normally exist only while the server is running; they persist only after a crash and are removed at the next server start. Permanent data files and WAL are not affected. The issue is fixed in EDB Postgres Extended Server 15.20, 16.16, 17.12 and 18.7 and EDB Postgres Advanced Server 15.20.0, 16.16.0, 17.12.0 and 18.7.0; the server must be restarted after upgrading.

CVE-2026-124019.description: VB-Audio VB-CABLE before 3.5.2.0 contains out-of-bounds read and write vulnerabilities in the vbaudio_cable64_win10.sys kernel streaming driver's KSPROPSETID_Audio MUTE, VOLUMELEVEL, and PEAKMETER2 property handlers that allow a local standard user to supply an all-channels sentinel value improperly used as a loop terminator or array index instead of being bounds-checked. Attackers can exploit the accessible low-integrity KS filter device object to write attacker-controlled values sequentially into kernel memory, corrupting kernel globals and object pointers, or read past an array boundary to leak kernel memory, resulting in local privilege escalation or denial of service via a kernel bug check.

CVE-2026-124222.description: Improper authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

CVE-2026-124223.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-124223.summary_ko: Microsoft Office SharePoint에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점으로, 인가된 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124223.background_ko: 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터를 역직렬화하는 과정에서 발생한다.

CVE-2026-126526.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office OneNote allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-126526.summary_ko: Microsoft Office OneNote의 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로 취약점으로, 인가되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-126816.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory in the cost report generation tool in AWS Pricing MCP Server (aws-pricing-mcp-server) before 1.0.31 might allow an actor who can influence the MCP agent to write actor controlled content to arbitrary locations outside the intended output directory via absolute paths or directory traversal sequences in the report output path. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.0.31 or later. Users of the deprecated awslabs.cost-analysis-mcp-server package should migrate to awslabs.aws-pricing-mcp-server version 1.0.31 or later.

CVE-2026-129302.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 3.5.0 until 3.13.0, built-in penetration-detection patterns in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py execute through a direct pattern.search(content) call instead of the timeout-protected create_safe_matcher() path used for custom patterns. The built-in template-injection detector contains an unbounded expression with quadratic behavior when scanning repeated opening braces. Because penetration detection and enhanced mode are enabled by a stock SecurityConfig, an unauthenticated request can block the shared asyncio event loop, affecting all application endpoints. The triggering input does not produce a detection match, so the request can complete without incrementing ban counters or being recorded as suspicious. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

CVE-2026-129303.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 1.0.0 until 3.13.0, ContentPreprocessor.preprocess() in guard_core/detection_engine/preprocessor.py collapses all whitespace before built-in pattern matching in the default enhanced mode. This removes carriage returns and newlines required by the http_split and newline-anchored cmd_injection detectors in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py, making those detectors unable to match. Framework-decoded CRLF can therefore pass through Guard Core unflagged while the downstream application still receives the raw newline-bearing value. Direct security impact requires a downstream stack or application that persists or re-emits the value into a CRLF-tolerant response or command context. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

CVE-2026-129304.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 1.0.0 until 3.13.0, _extract_from_forwarded_header() in guard_core/utils.py returns the selected X-Forwarded-For entry without validating that it is an IP address. In deployments configured with trusted_proxies where the selected entry is attacker-controlled, the arbitrary client_ip string reaches BehaviorTracker in guard_core/handlers/behavior_handler.py and is interpolated into Redis key names and blocking KEYS glob patterns. Glob metacharacters can cause one request to count other clients' behavior events, embedded separators can disturb key parsing, and rotating identities can create unbounded keys while repeatedly scanning the shared Redis keyspace. A non-IP identity can also reach a ban action and cause an uncaught validation error. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

CVE-2026-45016.description: EGroupware is a web-based groupware server written in PHP. Prior to 23.1.20260601 and 26.5.20260507, the processURL2InlineImages logic in api/src/Mail.php treats non-HTTP image sources in an HTML mail body as local paths and passes a decoded attacker-controlled file:// URI to file_get_contents. Any authenticated user with mail access can cause files readable by the web server process to be embedded as inline MIME attachments in outgoing email, exposing local configuration, credentials, private keys, or other server files. This issue is fixed in versions 23.1.20260601 and 26.5.20260507.

CVE-2026-53998.description: Phoenix is an AI observability and evaluation platform. From 13.0.0 until 15.7.0, the applyChatTemplate GraphQL query passed attacker-controlled F-string templates to FStringTemplateFormatter._format, while DotDict.__getattr__ did not prevent traversal through Python private attributes. A crafted field could traverse object internals such as __class__, __init__, and __globals__ to read process environment variables and internal module state. The endpoint is unauthenticated on default installations, and any account can reach it when authentication is enabled. Exposure of PHOENIX_SECRET can allow administrative session-token forgery and decryption of credentials protected by keys derived from that secret. This issue is fixed in version 15.7.0.
CVE-2026-53998.summary_ko: Phoenix의 GraphQL 템플릿 처리 취약점으로 프로세스 환경 변수와 내부 모듈 상태가 노출될 수 있다. PHOENIX_SECRET이 유출되면 관리자 세션 토큰 위조와 해당 비밀값에서 파생된 키로 보호된 자격 증명의 복호화가 가능하다.
CVE-2026-53998.background_ko: 공격자가 제어하는 F-string 템플릿을 처리하면서 DotDict.__getattr__가 Python 비공개 속성을 통한 객체 내부 접근을 차단하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-62336.description: qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.27, the privileged createFile helper followed attacker-controlled symbolic links during file creation. A local unprivileged user whose account is managed by the SSH Keys bundle could replace ~/.ssh with a link to /root/.ssh, causing the agent to write an authorized key for root. On systems using RAUC download mode with ineffective kernel symlink protection, the predictable /tmp/.bundle.raucb.part path could be linked to a system file and then overwritten or truncated during an update. A file-distribution destination beneath an attacker-controlled directory could similarly redirect the partial-download path so the agent changed ownership of a sensitive file. These vectors could result in root privilege escalation, arbitrary file modification, or denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 2026.27.

CVE-2026-63672.description: EGroupware is a web-based groupware server written in PHP. Prior to 23.1.20260601 and 26.6.20260616, login() in api/src/Auth/Saml.php accepts the unauthenticated idp request parameter when it merely begins with the HTTPS scheme and passes it to SimpleSAMLphp's requireAuth() without checking the configured trusted identity providers. A malicious actor can redirect the sign-in flow to an attacker-controlled identity provider, enabling credential phishing and, when the SimpleSAMLphp deployment does not strictly validate identity-provider metadata, forged SAML assertions as arbitrary users, including administrators. This issue is fixed in versions 23.1.20260601 and 26.6.20260616.

CVE-2026-69221.description: Faust.js is a headless WordPress toolkit. Prior to 1.8.12, the FaustWP generateAuthorizationCode GraphQL mutation called wp_authenticate_username_password and wp_authenticate_email_password directly instead of using wp_authenticate. This bypassed callbacks registered on WordPress's outer authenticate filter, including policies for multifactor authentication, single sign-on, IP allowlists, or disabled accounts. On a site using FaustWP local login and one of those policies, an attacker with a valid username or email and password could obtain an authorization code and exchange it through /api/faust/auth/token for access and refresh tokens even when the normal WordPress login path would deny access. This issue is fixed in version 1.8.12.

CVE-2026-95839.description: containerd is an open-source container runtime. From 2.2.0 until 2.2.10, 2.3.7, and 2.4.2, image manifest processing through the transfer service can encounter a child descriptor containing the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest. Pulling or importing such an image, including through a default CRI PullImage request, can trigger an unrecovered panic and crash the containerd daemon. In Kubernetes, kubelet retries can repeatedly trigger the crash and disrupt container operations on the worker node. This issue is fixed in versions 2.2.10, 2.3.7, and 2.4.2.
CVE-2026-95839.summary_ko: containerd에서 특정 이미지를 내려받거나 가져오는 중 복구되지 않는 패닉이 발생해 데몬이 종료될 수 있다. Kubernetes에서는 kubelet의 재시도로 충돌이 반복되어 작업자 노드의 컨테이너 운영이 중단될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-95839.background_ko: 전송 서비스가 io.containerd.manifest.subject 주석과 잘못된 다이제스트가 포함된 하위 설명자를 처리할 때 복구되지 않는 패닉이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-102892.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260416.0, public TAXII 2.1 collections configured with taxii_public set to true are served under the high-privilege SYSTEM_USER context rather than a restricted public-sharing user context. Unauthenticated requests can therefore bypass object markings, organization segregation, and authorized_members restrictions and retrieve restricted threat-intelligence objects that match the collection filters; a broad or absent filter can expose most of the database. Version 7.260416.0 remediates this issue for new configurations, but public-sharing configurations created before that version are not covered and are tracked separately in GHSA-25r9-q6rp-j7jw.

CVE-2026-104253.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260715.0, a ProfileQuery response can expose the user's TOTP MFA secret after activation. A person who can access the profile response can recover the secret, enroll a duplicate authenticator, and generate valid one-time codes, undermining the account's second-factor protection. This issue is fixed in version 7.260715.0.

CVE-2026-104258.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. In 7.260722.0 and earlier, a user with the SETTINGS_SETCUSTOMIZATION capability can configure a webhook notifier with an arbitrary destination URL and invoke notifierTest to make the OpenCTI server send the request immediately. The request can target internal services or cloud metadata endpoints that are reachable from the server, enabling server-side request forgery without waiting for a notifier event. No fixed release is verified by the available evidence; later releases remain unclassified.

CVE-2026-104840.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260428.0, the token GraphQL mutation used for primary login has no endpoint-specific rate limit, while the global Express limiter defaults to permitting 10,000 requests in a one-second window. An unauthenticated remote attacker can make password guesses at network speed against a chosen user account and, if a credential is recovered, access the account's threat-intelligence data and permitted operations. This issue is fixed in version 7.260428.0.

CVE-2026-111760.description: Git is a fast, scalable, distributed revision control system with an unusually rich command set that provides both high-level operations and full access to internals. Prior to 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1, an attacker-controlled repository hosted by the attacker rather than on a normal forge site can exploit git clone --recurse-submodules by causing Git to overwrite a submodule gitfile with a symbolic link. The symbolic link can point to a directory containing attacker-controlled Git configuration or hooks, allowing those hooks or configuration to execute code on the cloning user's system. The issue requires the recursive-submodule option, and users should avoid cloning repositories from untrusted sources. This issue is fixed in versions 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1.
CVE-2026-111760.summary_ko: Git의 하위 모듈 재귀 복제 기능에 취약점이 있어, 공격자가 직접 호스팅하는 저장소를 복제한 사용자의 시스템에서 코드가 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-111760.background_ko: 하위 모듈의 gitfile이 심볼릭 링크로 덮어써져 공격자가 제어하는 Git 설정이나 훅이 있는 디렉터리를 참조할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114505.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260722.0, the GraphQL endpoint accepts query operations over HTTP GET because CSRF prevention is disabled (csrfPrevention: false), placing the complete GraphQL query and its arguments in the request URL. Server and reverse-proxy logs, browser history, and shared caches can retain sensitive filters, marking-restricted identifiers, and investigation search arguments, allowing a person with access to those records to recover legitimate users' query contents. GraphQL mutations are not accepted over GET, and the issue does not permit code execution. This issue is fixed in version 7.260722.0.

CVE-2026-115563.description: The Model Context Protocol Python SDK is the official Python SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients. From 1.9.1 until 1.30.0 and 2.2.0, OAuth client support in mcp.client.auth can send credentials to an authorization server chosen by an untrusted MCP server. ClientCredentialsOAuthProvider and PrivateKeyJWTOAuthProvider cannot identify the authorization server that owns their credentials. Affected HTTP clients using those providers, OAuthClientProvider, or the deprecated 1.x RFC7523OAuthClientProvider can disclose a client_secret, authorization code, PKCE code_verifier, or signed client assertion. MCP servers, stdio clients, and clients that attach their own tokens or headers are not affected. Interactive OAuthClientProvider use requires a person to start sign-in, while the unattended providers do not. For ClientCredentialsOAuthProvider and PrivateKeyJWTOAuthProvider, callers must configure issuer= after upgrading because omission still follows the MCP server's advertised authorization server, and the deprecated RFC7523OAuthClientProvider must be replaced because it has no issuer option. A stored client registration without an issuer remains unbound after upgrading, so stored OAuth client information must be cleared once to register again or a manually pre-registered record must be updated with its issuer. This issue is fixed in versions 1.30.0 and 2.2.0.
CVE-2026-115563.summary_ko: Model Context Protocol Python SDK의 일부 OAuth HTTP 클라이언트가 신뢰할 수 없는 MCP 서버가 선택한 인증 서버에 클라이언트 비밀값과 인증 코드 등을 유출할 수 있다. MCP 서버와 stdio 클라이언트는 영향을 받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-115563.background_ko: 일부 OAuth 제공자가 자격 증명의 소유 인증 서버를 식별하지 못하고 MCP 서버가 알린 인증 서버를 따른다.

CVE-2026-120699.description: CubeSandbox is an instant, concurrent, secure, and lightweight sandbox for AI agents. Prior to 0.5.1, any authenticated tenant permitted to call POST /sandboxes can supply metadata["host-mount"] with an arbitrary existing host path because the control plane performs no authorization check or allowed-prefix validation for the path. injectHostDirMounts forwards the path to prepareHostDirVolume, where Cubelet uses mount --rbind through the function to perform a recursive bind mount as root and exposes the host subtree to the tenant's MicroVM through virtio-fs, read-write by default. This allows host-root file access and modification, host code execution, access to the container runtime, and compromise of co-resident tenants without a kernel or virtual-machine-monitor flaw. This issue is fixed in version 0.5.1.
CVE-2026-120699.summary_ko: CubeSandbox에서 샌드박스 생성 권한이 있는 인증된 테넌트가 임의의 호스트 경로에 접근할 수 있다. 이를 통해 호스트 파일을 읽거나 수정하고 호스트에서 코드를 실행하며 같은 호스트의 다른 테넌트까지 침해할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120699.background_ko: 호스트 마운트 경로에 대한 권한 확인과 허용 접두사 검증이 없고, 해당 경로가 루트 권한으로 마운트되어 테넌트에 기본적으로 읽기·쓰기가 가능하게 노출된다.

CVE-2026-121708.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260513.0, Draft Workspace identifiers are accepted without verifying that the authenticated user can access the referenced draft. Any authenticated user can enumerate draftWorkspaces, use a disclosed DRAFT_ID with draftWorkspaceEntities to read unpublished reports, descriptions, observables, and other staged intelligence, or place the identifier in the opencti-draft-id header and run mutations that inject entities and relationships into another user's private workspace. The flaw permits cross-user disclosure and tampering but does not cause a denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 7.260513.0.

CVE-2026-124017.description: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into the unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page read by the BootROM. By overwriting a fuse-derived RAM variable via a crafted patch entry using Phison Vendor Specific Commands, an attacker can force CRC-only firmware verification instead of signature checking, enabling an unsigned firmware image to load and creating a persistent controller-level implant that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host operating system.
CVE-2026-124017.summary_ko: Phison E12·E18 PCIe SSD 컨트롤러의 Secure Boot 우회 취약점으로 권한 있는 로컬 공격자가 서명되지 않은 펌웨어를 로드할 수 있다. 펌웨어 재설치 후에도 유지되고 호스트 운영체제 아래에서 동작하는 컨트롤러 수준 임플란트를 심을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124017.background_ko: BootROM이 서명 없이 CRC로만 보호된 플래시 ID 페이지의 부팅 패치를 적용하며, 이 패치가 서명 검증 방식을 제어하는 RAM 변수를 덮어쓸 수 있다.

CVE-2026-126681.description: Improper restriction of intended endpoints in the connection configuration handling of the AWS Labs Timestream for InfluxDB MCP Server (awslabs.timestream-for-influxdb-mcp-server) before 0.0.19 might allow a remote unauthenticated actor (via prompt injection) to obtain the InfluxDB API token configured on the server, sent to a crafted endpoint controlled through an InfluxDB URL introduced in the MCP client context. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 0.0.19 or later and rotate any InfluxDB API tokens configured for the server.
CVE-2026-126681.summary_ko: AWS Labs Timestream for InfluxDB MCP Server 0.0.19 미만에서 연결 대상 제한이 부적절해, 비인증 원격 공격자가 프롬프트 인젝션으로 서버에 설정된 InfluxDB API 토큰을 탈취할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-126681.background_ko: 연결 설정 처리 과정에서 접속 대상 엔드포인트에 대한 제한이 부적절하다.

CVE-2026-57150.description: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. Prior to 10.0.28, 11.0.10, and 12.0.1, authenticated users can craft a URL that invokes massive actions without all required object- and action-specific authorization checks. The bypass permits operations outside the user's granted rights, including unauthorized plugin activation, deactivation, and uninstallation for plugins already present on the filesystem and other state-changing maintenance actions. This issue is fixed in versions 10.0.28, 11.0.10, and 12.0.1.
CVE-2026-57150.summary_ko: GLPI 10.0.28·11.0.10·12.0.1 이전 버전에서 인증된 사용자가 권한 범위 밖의 일괄 작업을 수행할 수 있다. 파일시스템에 이미 있는 플러그인의 무단 활성화·비활성화·제거와 상태를 변경하는 유지보수 작업이 가능하다.
CVE-2026-57150.background_ko: 일괄 작업을 호출하는 URL에서 필요한 객체별·작업별 권한 검사가 모두 수행되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-57151.description: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. From 11.0.0 until 11.0.10 and 12.0.1, an authenticated technician can modify the two-factor authentication security of a user with higher privileges because the affected operations do not enforce all required authorization checks for the target user. This allows the technician to disable or take control of the higher-privileged user's two-factor authentication protection. This issue is fixed in versions 11.0.10 and 12.0.1.

CVE-2026-63477.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260624.0, an Organization Administrator with VIRTUAL_ORGANIZATION_ADMIN and KNOWLEDGE_KNUPDATE can use organizationFieldPatch to replace the administered organization's grantable_groups without a SETTINGS_SETACCESSES authorization check. The administrator can add the built-in Administrators group to that grant scope and then bypass the grantable_groups guard added by the incomplete CVE-2026-44730 remediation to add their own account to Administrators. Membership grants the BYPASS capability after session cache refresh, escalating the tenant-scoped account to global administrator with access across organizations, users, settings, markings, connectors, and ingestion. This issue is fixed in version 7.260624.0.
CVE-2026-63477.summary_ko: OpenCTI에서 특정 관리 권한을 가진 조직 관리자가 권한을 상승시켜 전역 관리자가 될 수 있다. 이 경우 다른 조직과 사용자, 설정, 커넥터, 데이터 수집 등에 조직 경계를 넘어 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-63477.background_ko: 조직의 부여 가능 그룹을 변경할 때 SETTINGS_SETACCESSES 권한을 확인하지 않아 기존 보완책의 그룹 할당 제한을 우회할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-71306.description: Mikochi is a minimalist file manager with streaming capabilities. Prior to 1.10.1, authenticated users of bare-metal instances configured with a non-default trailing-slash DATA_DIR can use the Move endpoint to supply traversal-containing source or destination paths. The affected path validation can resolve those paths outside the configured data directory, allowing files to be written beyond Mikochi's intended storage boundary. Docker deployments that confine the data directory to a mounted volume and configurations whose DATA_DIR lacks a trailing slash are not affected by the described attack. This issue is fixed in version 1.10.1.

CVE-2026-76822.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260701.0, the caseIncidentAdd, caseRfiAdd, and caseRftAdd GraphQL mutations require only authentication and do not require a capability check. An authenticated user with reader-level permissions can therefore create incident, request-for-information, and request-for-takedown case objects regardless of the user's assigned role, causing unauthorized changes to platform data. This issue is fixed in version 7.260701.0.

CVE-2026-76823.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260706.0, the logsWorkerConfig GraphQL query is authorized with the broad CONNECTORAPI capability and returns Elasticsearch connection details including elasticsearch_username, elasticsearch_password, elasticsearch_api_key, the URL, index, proxy, and TLS-verification setting. A holder of any connector API bearer token can retrieve this credential material. If the returned credentials are valid and Elasticsearch is reachable, the caller can directly read, modify, or delete OpenCTI indices and audit history outside application-layer role, marking, organization, and audit controls, with the practical impact bounded by the credentials' privileges and network reachability. This issue is fixed in version 7.260706.0.

CVE-2026-77597.description: iSponsorBlockTV is a SponsorBlock client for YouTube TV clients. Prior to 2.11.0, src/iSponsorBlockTV/dial_client.py trusts the SSDP LOCATION URL supplied by a local-network responder without validating its destination. During automatic discovery, this can cause an attacker-directed GET request and a constrained POST request to a path ending in /YouTube; the POST uses application-defined headers and an application-defined payload rather than attacker-selected request contents. The requests can reach internal services, but the detailed request behavior states that response data and errors are not returned to the attacker, making the demonstrated behavior blind SSRF with bounded integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 2.11.0.

CVE-2025-71471.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a use of uninitialized memory vulnerability in stbl_AddCTS() that allows attackers to corrupt sample table data via crafted MP4 files. Attackers can supply an MP4 with out-of-order composition time offsets for MP4Box import, triggering invalid memory access in gf_list_get() and crashing the process.

CVE-2026-110339.description: The Libreswan pluto daemon dereferences a NULL pointer when a CERT payload is received with an empty PKCS#7 payload, causing the daemon to crash and restart. The NSS function SEC_PKCS7GetCertificateList() was used to check whether the content was empty, but this check did not trigger if the non-empty content of the PKCS#7 wrapped payload was an empty list. Continued triggering of this vulnerability can lead to a denial of service. Remote code execution is not possible. Authentication is not required to trigger this vulnerability.
CVE-2026-110339.summary_ko: Libreswan의 pluto 데몬에 인증 없이 충돌과 재시작을 유발할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 반복 악용하면 서비스 거부가 발생할 수 있으나 원격 코드 실행은 불가능하다.
CVE-2026-110339.background_ko: PKCS#7 내부의 빈 목록을 기존 내용 검사로 감지하지 못해 NULL 포인터를 역참조한다.

CVE-2026-115846.description: The Libreswan IKEv2 state machine did not verify that an IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange was required to satisfy the addke= PostQuantum algorithm component of the exchange. A connecting client could (maliciously or by implementation error) skip the IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange and start an IKE_AUTH exchange prematurely. The result is as if the addke= option had not been specified, and such connections are only protected by the classic key exchange algorithm (such as P-256 or Curve25519), allowing "store now, decrypt later" attacks once a quantum computer becomes available. Only connections with the addke= keyword in the ike= and/or esp= configuration option are affected. PostQuantum Hybrid Key Exchange support was added in version 5.4.

CVE-2026-120697.description: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. Prior to 2.5.315, an authenticated user with write:pages can store JavaScript expressions in the v-slot:tabs or v-slot:content attributes of page HTML because server/modules/rendering/html-security/renderer.js adds those executable Vue directives to DOMPurify's allowlist. The sanitized output is inserted as rendered page HTML and later compiled by the Vue 2 runtime compiler, so the expressions execute in the Wiki.js origin when another user views the page even when the author lacks write:scripts and administrative permissions. The script runs with the viewer's browser session and can read same-origin data, modify displayed content, present phishing content, or perform actions available to that viewer, including privileged GraphQL operations when a privileged user opens the page. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.315.

CVE-2026-120698.description: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. Prior to 2.5.315, an authenticated account with only manage:users can use users.update to change the password of any local account, including the Root administrator and other accounts with manage:system, by omitting the optional groups argument, which is automatically allowed and bypasses destination-group authorization without checking the target's current privileges. The attacker can use users.disableTFA to clear the same target's tfaIsActive state and TFA secret without a target-privilege check, then authenticate with the replacement password. Supplying groups: [] to users.update can remove every group relationship from a selected administrator and leave the installation without a legitimate account holding manage:system. Additional administrators with IDs greater than 2 can also be deactivated or deleted. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.315.
CVE-2026-120698.summary_ko: Wiki.js 2.5.315 이전 버전에서 사용자 관리 권한만 가진 계정이 관리자 비밀번호를 바꾸고 2단계 인증을 해제해 계정을 탈취할 수 있다. 관리자 그룹 연결 제거로 정상적인 시스템 관리 계정이 사라질 수 있고, 일부 관리자 계정의 비활성화·삭제도 가능하다.
CVE-2026-120698.background_ko: 사용자 갱신 시 그룹 인수를 생략하면 대상 그룹 인가 검사를 우회하고 현재 권한도 확인하지 않으며, 2단계 인증 해제에도 대상 계정의 권한 검사가 없다.

CVE-2026-123353.description: Docmost is open-source collaborative wiki and documentation software. Prior to 0.96.0, two concurrent role-demotion requests from a space admin or workspace owner can each pass the last-admin or last-owner count check before either update is committed because the validation and role update are not serialized in one transaction. The requests can therefore demote the final two space admins or workspace owners and leave the affected space without an admin or the workspace without an owner, preventing normal administrative recovery. This issue is fixed in version 0.96.0.

CVE-2026-126828.description: A vulnerability in Phison SSD controller firmwares (Phison E18; EIFM80.0, Phison E18; EIFK51.2) allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. By successfully completing the authentication, an attacker can access vendor-specific commands that permit arbitrary memory read and write operations. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

CVE-2026-127219.description: WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1.4.6 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke the admin claim-offer action by reusing the publicly exposed wpchat_frontend nonce without any capability check. Attackers can call SmartSearchManagerService::claimOffer() via POST /wp-json/wpchat/v1/smart-search/claim-offer to register an attacker-controlled email against the site's domain using the site's stored api_token, corrupting the WPChat account and newsletter identity bound to the installation.

CVE-2026-129187.description: A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E16; EGFM13.2 allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. By successfully completing the authentication, an attacker can access vendor-specific commands that permit arbitrary memory read and write operations. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

CVE-2026-129190.description: A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E12; ECFM32.2 allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. By successfully completing the authentication, an attacker can access vendor-specific commands that permit arbitrary memory read and write operations. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

CVE-2026-130061.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in gf_sg_sfcommand_del() that allows attackers to crash the process via crafted XMT scenes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/MP4 file where a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer references a command freed twice during scene teardown, causing MP4Box to crash.

CVE-2026-130062.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_node_get_tag() that allows attackers to crash the process via crafted XMT connect elements. Attackers can supply an XMT scene file whose connect element has a parent with no node, crashing MP4Box during processing and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-130063.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via discarded nodes left on the parser node stack. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file processed by MP4Box, causing xmt_text_content() to call gf_node_get_tag() on a freed node and crash the process.

CVE-2026-130064.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_command_del() that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed memory through aliased XMT-A SFCommandBuffer command ownership. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file processed by MP4Box, causing commands freed during node destruction to be reaccessed during access unit cleanup, crashing the process.

CVE-2026-130065.description: msgpack-c through 7.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in msgpack_vrefbuffer_migrate() in src/vrefbuffer.c that checks capacity against the source array's end pointer. When migrating between vrefbuffers of unequal size, the realloc is skipped and memcpy() writes iovec entries past the destination array, corrupting adjacent heap memory or crashing the application.

CVE-2026-130066.description: Alinto SOGo before 5.12.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SQLSource contact lookup that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by placing a backslash before a quote in the object name. Attackers can send requests under a SQL-backed address book path on MySQL or MariaDB to perform UNION or boolean-based reads of the user-source table, including password hashes.

CVE-2026-130067.description: 7-Zip File Manager before 26.03 fails to detect archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters, allowing attackers to bypass the deceptive file name warning in CPanel::IsVirus_Message. Attackers can craft archive entries like a PDF name followed by ideographic spaces and .hta to hide the real extension, executing script content via ShellExecuteExW when opened.
CVE-2026-130067.summary_ko: 7-Zip File Manager 26.03 이전 버전에는 압축 항목의 기만적 파일명 경고가 우회되는 취약점이 있다. 실제 확장자가 가려진 항목을 사용자가 열면 스크립트가 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-130067.background_ko: 압축 항목 이름에 덧붙은 유니코드 공백 문자를 탐지하지 못해 기만적 파일명 경고가 우회된다.

CVE-2026-130068.description: Umbraco CMS 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Management API document version endpoints that skip per-document ContentPermissionByResource checks. Authenticated back-office users restricted to a start node can list and read document versions outside their tree by GUID, exposing unpublished values and altering prevent-cleanup flags.

CVE-2026-130069.description: Frappe Framework before 15.123.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the frappe.email.email_body.get_email_html method, which lacks role checks. Authenticated users, including portal Website Users, can inject stylesheet link tags into unescaped email templates, causing Premailer to fetch internal or external hosts and return the content.

CVE-2026-130070.description: Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted ghost.api.ghost.convert_to_real_user method that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip OTP verification by setting the client-supplied bypass_otp parameter. Attackers can obtain a ghost session from the guest-accessible create_ghost_session endpoint, then call convert_to_real_user with an arbitrary real_email and bypass_otp=1 to receive OAuth tokens for existing accounts and take them over.

CVE-2026-130071.description: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. Attackers can supply a doctype, name and arbitrary fields that are saved with ignore_permissions=True, altering User records to escalate privileges, take over accounts or tamper with business data.
CVE-2026-130071.summary_ko: TridotsTech go1cms의 인증 누락으로 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의 문서를 수정할 수 있다. 사용자 기록을 변경해 권한을 높이거나 계정을 탈취하고 업무 데이터를 변조할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-130071.background_ko: 게스트 접근이 허용된 update_doc 메서드에 인증 검사가 없고, 전달받은 필드를 권한 검사를 무시한 채 저장한다.

CVE-2026-130072.description: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

CVE-2026-130073.description: CBoard before commit 7bd8180 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to reach admin functions because AdminController and DashboardController methods bypass AOP role checks. Attackers with no role grants can call deleteUser, deleteRole, getUserList, getAllWidgetList and getAllDatasetList to read query configurations and delete accounts including the administrator.

CVE-2026-130074.description: free5GC WebConsole through 1.4.6 contains an authorization flaw in the ChangePasswordInfo handler that allows authenticated tenant users to change other members' passwords. Attackers can send POST /api/change-password with another tenant member's email and a new password, without the current password, to take over that account.

CVE-2026-130075.description: SplitPro through 2.1.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the addOrEditExpense and addOrEditCurrencyConversion tRPC mutations that allows authenticated users to assign expenses to arbitrary users. Attackers can enumerate sequential user IDs and supply them in participants or paidBy fields to fabricate debts on victims' balances, even in unseen groups.

CVE-2026-130076.description: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by supplying an unvalidated baseUrl to the /v1/scrape endpoint. Attackers can set llmApiKey and request the summary format, making the server POST to loopback or private addresses and use returned warnings as a reachability oracle.

CVE-2026-130077.description: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal hosts via caller-controlled proxy and proxy_list fields in /v1/scrape. Attackers can supply proxy entries pointing to loopback, private-network or link-local hosts, bypassing page URL checks to open HTTP-proxy or SOCKS connections internally.

CVE-2026-130078.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in B3Receiver.receiveArticle that allows visitor accounts to modify any article via the POST /apis/symphony/article endpoint. Attackers can supply their username as userB3Key, since OAuth-created visitors receive it as their B3 key, and overwrite any article's title, content and tags.

CVE-2026-130079.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject script by setting a malicious article title rendered without escaping. Attackers can set titles, including via the B3 sync endpoint, so admin/article-pwd.ftl, skin templates, and js/page.js article lists execute script in visitors' and administrators' browsers.

CVE-2026-130080.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the console article update API that allows authenticated authors to inject SQL through unvalidated JSON property names. Attackers can send a PUT request to /console/article/ with crafted property names used as UPDATE column names, then read query results back through the updated article.

CVE-2026-130081.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain article view passwords by querying the public GET /articles API. The ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage handler leaves the articleViewPwd property in JSON responses, letting attackers read passwords for encrypted articles and access their protected content.
