CVE-2026-124709.description: Issue summary: A QUIC server that rejects a stream opened by the peer may retain that stream's state for the lifetime of the connection if the peer resets the stream before the rejection is signalled, even though the peer's stream credit is returned. Impact summary: A remote client that completes a QUIC handshake can repeatedly open and reset streams, causing server memory to grow without bound until the process runs out of memory and every connection on it is lost. This is a Denial of Service. CWE: CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime Description: QUIC servers track each stream the peer opens. When the incoming stream policy rejects a stream, OpenSSL schedules a STOP_SENDING frame, marks the stream deleted and returns the peer's stream credit. A deleted stream is collected only once its receive part is fully drained, which for a rejected stream means the STOP_SENDING has been acknowledged. If the peer sends RESET_STREAM first, the reset cancels the pending STOP_SENDING, so it is never sent or acknowledged and the stream is never collected. The default configuration reaches this path. Once a connection has a default stream, meaning the application has read from or written to the connection as the tutorial server does, the effective incoming stream policy rejects streams the application does not accept. Applications that set the REJECT policy explicitly are affected too. Each retained stream costs about 300 bytes, and the peer's stream credit window paces how quickly they accumulate. A client that keeps the connection open and keeps opening and resetting streams grows server memory without bound. The severity is Low because growth is slow, needs a long-lived connection, and causes no memory corruption or disclosure. FIPS impact: no The affected code is outside the FIPS module boundary.
CVE-2026-124709.summary_ko: OpenSSL QUIC 서버의 스트림 상태 해제 누락으로, QUIC 핸드셰이크를 완료한 원격 클라이언트가 서버 메모리를 무제한으로 증가시킬 수 있다. 메모리가 고갈되면 프로세스의 모든 연결이 끊기는 서비스 거부로 이어진다.
CVE-2026-124709.background_ko: 거부된 스트림의 대기 중인 STOP_SENDING이 RESET_STREAM으로 취소되면 해제에 필요한 확인 응답을 받을 수 없어 스트림 상태가 회수되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-35190.description: Issue summary: A server configured with the Suite B certificate flag through SSL_CTX_set_cert_flags() and with TLS 1.3 enabled may read past the end of a fixed group list when it processes a ClientHello whose supported_groups and key_share contain no Suite B group. Impact summary: A remote client can send a ClientHello that makes the server read past the end of a static array. The values read are never returned to the client, so no memory is disclosed; on builds with sanitizers or hardened allocators the read may crash the process, causing Denial of Service. CWE: CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read Description: When the Suite B certificate flag is set, OpenSSL restricts the accepted groups to P-256 and P-384 by substituting a fixed two-element list for the configured group list. The tuple machinery used for key-share selection was not updated for this substitution: tls1_get_group_tuples() still returns the configured tuples, which by default describe eight groups. The server-side walk in tls_parse_ctos_key_share() then advances through the two-element list using those tuple counts without checking the cumulative offset against the number of groups present. Only applications that call SSL_CTX_set_cert_flags() with SSL_CERT_FLAG_SUITEB_128_LOS and leave TLS 1.3 enabled are affected. The openssl s_server -suiteB_128 option sets an X.509 verification parameter instead, so the stock command line server is not vulnerable. Default configurations do not reach this code. A client that offers only groups outside the Suite B set, such as X25519, forces every tuple to be walked and the read to run past the array. The bytes read are compared against client group IDs and never sent back, so no memory is disclosed. On builds with address sanitizers or hardened allocators the read can abort the process; in ordinary release builds it reads a few bytes of adjacent constant data. FIPS impact: no The affected code is outside the FIPS module boundary.

CVE-2026-112209.description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability reflected in the GET parameters `cod_primaria` and `cod_secundaria` of the Novanet Web endpoints `NNws_ShwNewDup` and `NPcd/NFG_VerNoticia`. User-provided data is reflected within a JavaScript block without proper sanitization or context-appropriate output encoding. An unauthenticated remote attacker could craft a manipulated URL that, when visited by a victim, would execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the victim’s browser, within the context of the affected site. The flaw resides in the platform’s shared code, so it could affect organizations using that vulnerable code.

CVE-2026-118496.description: The affected products process a server-supplied URL without sufficient validation. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious Automation Server and tricking a user to trust it or performing a man-in-the-middle attack, can exploit this vulnerability by causing the affected product to process unintended content. Successful exploitation may result in arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the user running the affected product.

CVE-2026-118497.description: The affected products do not sufficiently validate CODESYS Automation Server TLS certificates when a user starts the certificate enrollment. An unauthenticated remote attacker performing a man-in-the-middle attack can exploit this vulnerability by supplying an untrusted certificate that is accepted as trusted. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to intercept and manipulate communications between the CODESYS Automation Server and the PLC network.

CVE-2026-118498.description: The CODESYS Automation Server Connector uses server-supplied file names without sufficient path traversal checks. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious Automation Server and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on a trusted communication channel, can exploit this vulnerability to write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary locations on the engineering workstation and subsequently achieve arbitrary code execution with user privileges.

CVE-2026-21609.description: This High severity Improper Authorization vulnerability was introduced in versions 5.12.0, 10.3.0, and 11.3.0 of Jira Service Management Data Center. This Improper Authorization vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 7.1, allows an authenticated attacker to gain unintended access and can lead to the exposure of resources or functionality, possibly providing attackers with sensitive information or even execute arbitrary code. Atlassian recommends that Jira Service Management Data Center customers upgrade to latest version, if you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions: Jira Service Management Data Center 10.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.3.27 Jira Service Management Data Center 11.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.3.13 See the release notes (https://confluence.atlassian.com/servicemanagement/jira-service-management-release-notes-780083086.html). You can download the latest version of Jira Service Management Data Center from the download center (https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management/download-archives). This vulnerability was reported via our Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-119621.description: When importing a T3D or XML file in the Import/Export module, the file hash values of imported files were taken from the import data without validation and used to build the path of a temporary file. A crafted import file could therefore write files with arbitrary content to any location writable by the web server, for example a PHP file in the public web root, which leads to remote code execution. Exploiting this vulnerability requires an administrator backend user account, or a non-admin backend user for whom importing has been enabled via the user TSconfig option options.impexp.enableImportForNonAdminUser.

CVE-2026-119622.description: The backend endpoint for adding online media (e.g. YouTube or Vimeo videos) accepted a target folder in the fallback storage (storage uid 0), which points to the public web root of the installation. File mount and permission checks are not applied to the fallback storage. As a result, any authenticated, low-privileged backend user, even without file mounts or module access, could create online media files with a partially controllable file name in the public web root. In combination with TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-027, this could be used to re-enable the installer on an already configured instance. The installer could then be used to create a new administrator and system maintainer account, which leads to remote code execution.

CVE-2026-119623.description: The installer (first installation wizard) could be re-enabled on an already configured instance by placing a file whose name starts with FIRST_INSTALL in the public web root or the project root. The installer then became accessible without authentication, allowing for example to change the database connection and to create a new administrator and system maintainer account, which leads to remote code execution. As demonstrated in TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-026, such a file could be created by an authenticated, low-privileged backend user without any further permissions. Other ways of creating files in the web root, as well as leftover or restored marker files, could be abused in the same way. With the fixed versions, the installer can no longer be re-enabled on an already configured instance by a marker file. A new internal setting $GLOBALS['TYPO3_CONF_VARS']['SYS']['isInstalling'] is stored in the system configuration and is only enabled while a new installation is running. Additionally, only the exact file names FIRST_INSTALL and FIRST_INSTALL.txt are accepted as marker files.

CVE-2026-125159.description: ImageMagick and GraphicsMagick use small modules, called "coders", to read each image format. When processing images, TYPO3 determined the coder from the file type detected by the file contents, as long as the detected mime-type started with image/. A file containing MVG (Magick Vector Graphics) instructions, uploaded with an image file extension like .png, was therefore processed with the MVG coder. MVG instructions can read local files into the processed image, which allows disclosing the contents of arbitrary files readable by the web server, for example configuration files containing credentials, through a publicly accessible processed image. Exploiting this vulnerability requires a way to upload files without a mime-type check, for example a public form of the Form Framework using a FileUpload or ImageUpload element without configured allowedMimeTypes (see TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-032), which allows exploitation by unauthenticated visitors. Additionally, ImageMagick must be used for image processing, and its default system configuration must allow the MVG coder.

CVE-2026-125160.description: Files uploaded through FileUpload or ImageUpload elements are stored in an unguessable sub-folder that remains the same for the whole form session. If storing an uploaded file failed, for example because of a file name exceeding the file system's length limit, the raw error message was shown to the frontend user disclosing the storage path including the unguessable folder name and the server's temporary upload directory. With this information, attackers could determine the public URL of files they upload through the form. If a form allows uploading files that browsers can execute, such as HTML documents, this could lead to Cross-Site Scripting on web servers that do not apply the Content-Security-Policy recommended by TYPO3 to the form upload target folder. This vulnerability is known to be actively exploited.

CVE-2026-125161.description: The fix for TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-009 was incomplete. GeneralUtility::sanitizeLocalUrl performed its checks on the URL-decoded value, but returned the original, URL-encoded value. URLs containing certain percent-encoded characters therefore passed the sanitization checks as local URLs, although they point to an external host. Applications that use the sanitized URL for redirects are vulnerable to open redirect attacks. This enables attackers to redirect users to external content and carry out phishing attacks. In the TYPO3 core, this affects redirects in the backend, which require the victim to be logged in to the backend.

CVE-2026-125162.description: The cHash argument, which ensures that only URL arguments originally generated by TYPO3 create separate page cache entries, was treated inconsistently when it was passed as an array. The cHash validation treated such a value as missing, while the page cache identifier treated it as present and included all URL arguments. As a result, unauthenticated visitors could create an unlimited number of page cache entries and trigger uncached page renderings by adding an array cHash with arbitrary values to any URL. This could exhaust server resources and fill the page cache storage. Only installations where the cHash validation is not enforced via $GLOBALS['TYPO3_CONF_VARS']['FE']['cacheHash']['enforceValidation'] are affected. This setting is enabled by default for new installations since TYPO3 v12, but is often still disabled in installations upgraded from older versions.

CVE-2026-125163.description: The FileUpload and ImageUpload elements of the Form Framework use the property allowedMimeTypes as an allow list of MIME types accepted for upload. An empty allowedMimeTypes list was treated as "no restriction". Forms containing upload elements without any configured MIME type, for example in manually created form definitions or when all MIME types were deselected in the form editor, accepted any file except those blocked by the file deny pattern, which only covers PHP-related file extensions. This allowed unauthenticated users to upload files with browser-executable content, such as HTML or SVG documents, to the configured upload folder, which by default is located in a public storage. If attackers know the URL of an uploaded file (see TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-029), this could lead to Cross-Site Scripting on web servers that do not apply the Content-Security-Policy recommended by TYPO3 to the form upload target folder.

CVE-2026-125164.description: The file dump controller (eID=dumpFile) delivers files, file references and processed files identified by their uid, protected by a token. The token only covered the uid value, but not the type of the requested resource. A valid token issued for a file could therefore be reused to request a file reference or a processed file with the same uid. As a result, unauthenticated visitors could download files, for example from non-public storages, for which no token had been issued.

CVE-2026-125165.description: The RSS widget of the dashboard allows backend users to configure the URL of the RSS feed in the widget settings. The URL was fetched by the server without restricting the target host. Backend users with access to the dashboard could therefore make the server send HTTP requests to arbitrary hosts, including internal network services and cloud metadata endpoints, which are not reachable from the outside.

CVE-2026-129271.description: The Patch Management Engine in N-central is vulnerable to LPE via attacker controlled metadata

CVE-2026-129272.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 uses a predictable credential to authenticate appliances to an agent-facing API. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who knows or guesses an appliance identifier can obtain a valid appliance token and session and impersonate that appliance.

CVE-2026-129273.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not neutralise control characters in an Audit Export setting before writing it to the system logging configuration. An authenticated attacker with product administrator privileges can inject configuration and execute commands as root on the N-central server.

CVE-2026-129274.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerMMS2 RemoteExecutionTaskSubmit operation or verify task ownership. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit forged results for remote execution tasks belonging to any customer.

CVE-2026-129275.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 allows the repositoryItemGet operation to be called without authentication. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who knows a policy identifier can download the Automation Manager policy of any customer, including embedded scripts and parameter values.

CVE-2026-129276.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerMMS2 AssetDiscoSimplifiedInfoSubmit operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can overwrite the asset data recorded for any appliance.

CVE-2026-129277.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the MaintActionGet operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can read and cancel the pending maintenance actions of any appliance.

CVE-2026-129278.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerII2 remoteControlMSPAStartEndTimeSubmit operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can alter the recorded state and times of Take Control remote control tasks and the associated audit log entries.

CVE-2026-129279.description: The password reset function in N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 returns distinguishable responses for valid and invalid accounts. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can enumerate the email addresses of valid user accounts.

CVE-2026-129280.description: Multiple ServerUI and ServerUI2 SOAP operations in N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 do not verify the caller's session, permissions or customer scope. A remote attacker, in some cases without authentication, can read device and patch data, test passwords of user accounts, send messages to managed agents, and modify device and service settings belonging to other customers.

CVE-2026-129281.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 checks only a view permission for ServerII2 operations that write device execution configuration. An authenticated user with view-only access to a device can set configuration that the Windows agent on that device acts on.

CVE-2026-129282.description: The test email delivery function in N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not check permissions, lacks CSRF protection, and passes sender and recipient values to the mail program without neutralising option characters. An authenticated attacker can inject arguments into the mail command executed on the server.

CVE-2026-129283.description: The custom service import in N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 processes XML external entities. An authenticated attacker can upload a crafted service definition to read files accessible to the N-central service account or cause the server to make outbound requests.

CVE-2026-129284.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not validate connection targets in the Report Manager and Data Export settings. An authenticated attacker can cause the server to connect to arbitrary hosts, including loopback and internal addresses, and can use the responses to probe internal network services.

CVE-2026-129285.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not verify that an action response received over XMPP originates from the appliance the request was sent to. An attacker with the credentials of one appliance can forge responses on behalf of another appliance.

CVE-2026-129286.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not validate version values and download locations in software update metadata. An attacker able to supply or modify the update metadata received by the server can write files outside the download directory and execute code as the N-central service account.

CVE-2026-129287.description: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 processes XML external entities in software repository files. An attacker able to supply or modify the repository files received by the server can read files accessible to the N-central service account or cause the server to make outbound requests.

CVE-2026-129448.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester. This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled. Users who cannot upgrade right away should set "enabledForExtensions" to "false" in WEB-INF/web.xml, or remove the "/roller-services/xmlrpc" servlet mapping, and restart Roller. Disabling XML-RPC in the administration UI is not enough, because older versions deserialize the request before checking that setting.

CVE-2026-124643.description: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HMIS due to insufficient authentication and session validation in the dashboard functionality. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted HTTP requests to the affected endpoint. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to gain unauthorized access to the dashboard information associated with the targeted healthcare organization.

CVE-2026-124644.description: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HMIS due to the exposure of internal hospital operational statistics through data structure embedded in the HTML response of the login page. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by accessing the affected login page and extracting the returned HTML content. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to gain unauthorized access to internal hospital operational information associated with the targeted healthcare organization.

CVE-2026-124645.description: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HIMS due to the use of a static and predictable value in the client-side password hashing mechanism, which is embedded in the login page and accessible to unauthenticated users. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by accessing the login page, extracting the embedded value and using it to reproduce the password hashing process. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could weaken the security of the authentication mechanism and potentially facilitate authentication related attacks on the targeted healthcare organization.

CVE-2026-124646.description: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HMIS due to insufficient server side object level authorization validation in the API endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by modifying the parameter value in the API request. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to enumerate and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information of patients on the targeted healthcare organization.

CVE-2026-127138.description: pretix provides a mechanism where ticket QR codes are cryptographically signed and can be verified by our pretixSCAN apps in offline mode without any database of valid tickets. pretixSCAN checks the signature to verify that the ticket was issued by the correct pretix event and compares the QR code against a list of revoked QR codes. A QR code becomes revoked when the order is canceled, or the ticket is changed in a way that a new QR code needs to be generated. However, the parsing of the QR code in all of our pretixSCAN apps contained a faulty computation, rendering the check for the correct length of the contents faulty. This way, an attacker is able to craft multiple QR codes for the same ticket which have the same content, but look different and therefore do not match against the revocation list. This does not allow to fabricate entirely new tickets, but it does allow to enter the event with e.g. a canceled ticket. This attack requires pretixSCAN to be scanning in offline mode and the "pretix signature scheme 1" to be used for the event's QR codes. If the attack is executed, the ticket unfortunately shows as valid (green) on the scanner but as invalid (red) on the server since the server later cannot match it to a ticket. We scanned the entire database of scans on pretix Hosted and could not find any traces of this being exploited in the past.

CVE-2026-127139.description: pretixSCAN Proxy does not use a secure random generator to generate initialization tokens and API keys for the connection between pretixSCAN devices and the pretixSCAN Proxy. This could allow a skilled attacker with access to at least some of the tokens to predict the value of other tokens more easily. pretixSCAN is usually used on local networks and the level of exposure heavily depends on the structure of that network. If you want to be extra careful, it might make sense to reconnect your devices to the proxy after the update.

CVE-2026-127140.description: Our WordPress plugin for the pretix Widget performs HTTP calls to pre-fetch CSS and JS files into a local cache and stores them publicly on the WordPress instance. These HTTP calls are made with wp_remote_get, not wp_safe_remote_get, and therefore allow SSRF with body extraction. Exploiting this requires sufficient WordPress permissions to create or modify pages.

CVE-2026-127174.description: When changing the settings of a scheduled export, no permission checks are done to see whether the user making the change has access to the exporter after the change. This way, an attacker with access to change organizer settings and e.g. access to all orders could change the export to refer to gift cards instead, even if they do not have access to gift cards. The fix for this is technically a breaking API change, since changing the export type of existing scheduled exports is no longer allowed, but we don't expect this to affect any typical API usage.

CVE-2026-12239.description: The WP Abstracts plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.6. This is due to a missing capability check on the wpabs_save_regform AJAX action and the use of a static, frontend-exposed nonce that allows any authenticated user to persist attacker-controlled form schemas with arbitrary wpSync mappings that are later used as user meta keys in the wpabstracts_sync_wpfields function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to elevate their privileges to administrator.

CVE-2026-130384.description: Zammad before 7.2.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to delete agents' shared ticket drafts by supplying a shared_draft_id. Attackers can create tickets via POST /api/v1/tickets or reply to accessible tickets referencing a draft id, destroying draft text prepared by agents.

CVE-2026-107190.description: Bludit is vulnerable to Path Traversal in the page deletion functionality. An authenticated user with the Author role can set the UUID field of their own page to contain path traversal sequences (.. and path separators), which are saved without proper validation. When the page is deleted, Pages::delete() passes the path constructed from this UUID to Filesystem::deleteRecursive() without verifying that it still points to an allowed directory, allowing the attacker to delete any files, even not belonging to them. Critically, it is possible to delete admin pages and render the site unusable. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.22.0 but may also affect other versions.

CVE-2026-130385.description: Weblate 2026.11 through 2026.11.2 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the GET /api/tasks/{pk}/ endpoint that exposes unredacted repository error messages. Authenticated project members lacking vcs.view permission can poll failing repository tasks to obtain RepositoryCommandError text revealing upstream repository URLs, filesystem paths, and host names.

CVE-2026-130386.description: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds access vulnerability in buffer_reclaim() and domain_set_free() in mpl.c that iterate the seed_set array one element past its end. Remote attackers can flood MPL multicast messages to fill the buffered message set, triggering out-of-bounds reads and writes of adjacent static memory that cause memory corruption or a crash.

CVE-2026-130387.description: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in coap_remove_observer_by_uri() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read past the supplied URI buffer. Attackers can send a CoAP GET Observe request with a Uri-Path shorter than an existing observer's URL, causing memcmp with strlen to read beyond the non-NUL-terminated buffer.

CVE-2026-130583.description: Rootways Authorize.net CIM Pro extension for Magento 2 before 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Apple Pay merchant validation controller. Attackers can supply file://, gopher://, or dict:// URLs in the validationUrl parameter to read app/etc/env.php credentials and encryption keys or reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

CVE-2026-130584.description: Xibo CMS before 4.5.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other DataSets' RSS feeds by pairing their own DataSet id with a foreign RSS id. Attackers with dataset.modify permission can read, edit, or delete feeds and steal PSKs, then use the unauthenticated /rss/{psk} endpoint to exfiltrate victim DataSet rows.

CVE-2026-130587.description: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace tenants to create privileged host-access pods by supplying unrestricted PodSpec templates in Function and Serving resources. Attackers with only Function or Serving create permissions can set privileged, hostNetwork, hostPID, or hostPath fields to mount the worker node's root filesystem and escalate to node access.

CVE-2026-130588.description: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in getServingRun that allows users permitted to create Serving resources to crash the operator by omitting the triggers section. Attackers can submit a Serving with nil Spec.Triggers to crash-loop the controller-manager, halting Function and Serving reconciliation cluster-wide until the object is deleted.

CVE-2026-130589.description: Emitter through 3.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows any channel key holder to forge a master key because channel keys use bare XOR Salsa20 encryption without a MAC or signature. Attackers can flip the permissions byte to the master value and present the forged key to the keygen service to mint keys with arbitrary permissions on every channel of the contract.

CVE-2026-130590.description: react-native-webview 11.25.1 through 17.1.0 on Android contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows web content to crash the host application via malformed Content-Disposition headers. Attackers can serve a download whose filename* parameter has invalid percent-encoding, triggering an uncaught IllegalArgumentException in URLUtil.parseContentDisposition on the main thread to terminate the app.

CVE-2026-130591.description: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by requesting /api/files/:file_id/preview and /api/file-version/:file_body_id without UserTokenAuth. Attackers can enumerate sequential numeric ids to read raw knowledge-base files and stored file versions belonging to any enterprise tenant.

CVE-2026-130592.description: phpMyFAQ 4.0.12 through 4.0.19, 4.1.x before 4.1.12, and 4.2.0 pre-releases before 4.2.0-RC.1 contain a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in startpage.twig, where top-ten FAQ titles are rendered with Twig's raw filter. Authenticated users with FAQ edit permission can save a question containing a double quote and event handler, which runs script for every start page visitor.

CVE-2026-130593.description: Scalar scalar-ninja 0.1.0 before 0.3.3 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in get_scalar_api_reference() that embeds unescaped OpenAPI content inside an inline script element. Attackers can supply an OpenAPI document containing a </script><script> sequence in content or sources to execute scripts in the documentation origin for every user viewing the API reference.

CVE-2026-130594.description: Scalar scalar-ninja 0.1.0 before 0.3.3 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject scripts by supplying unescaped ScalarConfig title values. Attackers controlling title metadata can close the title element with </title> and inject a script tag that executes in the documentation origin for API reference visitors.

CVE-2026-130595.description: SQLBot 1.10.0 through 1.10.3 fails to apply its PostgreSQL dangerous-function denylist because DS_SPECIFIC_DANGEROUS_FUNCTIONS uses 'postgresql' while lookups use the 'pg' type. Authenticated users can steer LLM-generated SQL past check_sql_read() using pg_read_file, pg_write_file, lo_import or lo_export to read or write files on the database host.

CVE-2026-130596.description: FusionPBX through 5.6.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in app/fax/fax_emails.php that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write files by using a crafted MIME attachment filename. Attackers can email the polled fax mailbox with a spoofed authorized From address and use ../ sequences in the filename to create or overwrite web-server-writable files with .pdf/.tif content.

CVE-2026-130603.description: Eclipse Zenoh's zenoh-pico implementation, versions 0.7.2-rc up to but excluding 1.10.2, does not validate the Zenoh identifier (ZID) length when deserializing timestamps. An attacker-controlled length greater than 16 causes an out-of-bounds write to a fixed 16-byte identifier buffer and causes the subsequent zero-fill operation to receive a negative length converted to a large unsigned size. Truncated timestamp inputs can also cause out-of-bounds reads or assertion failures. A remote attacker able to deliver crafted timestamp-bearing Zenoh messages through an accepted transport can cause memory corruption and denial of service, with potential remote code execution in builds lacking appropriate binary protections. This issue is fixed in version 1.10.2. Depending on the release and message-decoding path, the unchecked timestamp identifier length causes a heap-based or stack-based buffer overflow. Ordinary-frame network message decoding moved from heap-backed storage to stack-local storage in version 1.5.0. Earlier affected releases already contained stack-based decoding paths, including reassembled fragmented messages.

CVE-2026-130608.description: When using the admin area profile form to change ones profile details *except* the password (so, email or username), the password field in the database is overwritten with the plaintext password. Further login is not possible, so the error is noticeable, but the password is leaked to the database.

CVE-2026-130615.description: Flowise through 3.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by exploiting unpinned DNS validation in checkDenyList(). Attackers can configure a chatflow with Playwright or Puppeteer loaders using a DNS-rebinding domain so headless Chromium fetches internal or cloud metadata endpoints, returning responses as document content.

CVE-2026-82025.description: WP File Manager before 8.0.7 contains a file upload restriction bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to upload arbitrary PHP files by exploiting a misconfigured elFinder connector in file_folder_manager.php where an empty uploadDeny list causes allowPutMime() to unconditionally return true, bypassing the uploadAllow restriction. Attackers can upload a .php file directly or upload it under an allowed filename and then rename it via the rename connector command, achieving remote code execution as the web server user.

7b0c555ada0869c489f60e67.title_ko: 정식품, 두유 원액 품질 예측 AI 구축…원료·물 투입량 조절 지원
7b0c555ada0869c489f60e67.summary_ko: 정식품이 11월 말 청주공장에 두유 원액 품질을 예측하는 AI 시스템을 구축할 예정이다. 기존 실시간 계측·자동제어 시스템에 AI를 결합해 공정 변수와 센서 데이터로 총고형분 변화를 예측하고 대두·물 투입 권장값을 제시한다. 설비 이상 징후를 탐지하는 예지보전과 용기·포장 비전 검사에도 AI를 활용하고 있다.
7b0c555ada0869c489f60e67.background_ko: 콩은 산지와 작황에 따라 특성이 달라지고 물의 양과 가공 조건도 원액 품질에 영향을 주므로, 대량생산 중에도 맛과 영양을 균일하게 유지할 공정 관리가 필요하다.

curation.reason_ko: 정식품이 공정 데이터로 두유 원액 품질과 투입량을 예측하는 AI 시스템 구축을 예고했다.

acea8a965a57cac86ffa9967.title_ko: 정부, 범정부 사이버보안 컨트롤타워 ‘차르’ 구성 검토 착수
acea8a965a57cac86ffa9967.summary_ko: 정부가 범정부 사이버보안 컨트롤타워인 ‘사이버보안 차르’ 구성을 위한 부처별 검토에 착수했다. 과기정통부·국정원 등이 개선안을 마련하고 있으며, 기능·권한 조정이나 전담기관 신설 등 구체적인 조직 개편 방향은 향후 관계부처 협의로 정해질 전망이다.
acea8a965a57cac86ffa9967.background_ko: 부처별로 분산된 보안 기능의 조정에 한계가 있다는 지적 속에 대통령이 사이버보안 차르 구성을 검토하도록 지시한 데 따른 후속 조치다.

curation.reason_ko: 범정부 사이버보안 컨트롤타워 검토가 시작돼 부처 간 권한과 대응체계 개편이 논의된다.

f6fd440b64d1773d450fa6b9.title_ko: AI 공격·침해사고 증가에 국가 사이버보안 정책 재정비 요구
f6fd440b64d1773d450fa6b9.summary_ko: AI 기반 공격과 대형 침해사고 증가에 대응해 국가 사이버보안 정책을 재정비해야 한다는 논의가 본격화하고 있다. KISA에 따르면 올해 상반기 침해사고 신고는 1,236건으로 전년 대비 19.5% 늘었으며, 전문가들은 부처 간 협력과 현장의 위협 탐지·취약점 관리 역량 강화를 주문했다.
f6fd440b64d1773d450fa6b9.background_ko: 사이버보안이 독립 국정과제가 아닌 여러 과제에 분산 반영된 가운데, AI 기반 해킹 위협과 잇단 침해사고로 국가 대응체계 강화 필요성이 커졌다.

b3ff44c2617709b2238cff61.title_ko: 이더리움 2,500만 달러 탈취 혐의 형제에 무죄 선고
b3ff44c2617709b2238cff61.summary_ko: 미 연방법원이 이더리움 취약점을 악용해 약 2,500만 달러를 탈취한 혐의로 기소된 형제에게 무죄를 선고했다. 법원은 검찰이 통신사기죄 성립에 필요한 중대한 허위 진술을 입증하지 못했다고 판단했다. MEV-Boost 릴레이 취약점 악용과 거래 순서 조작은 검찰이 제기한 혐의다.
b3ff44c2617709b2238cff61.background_ko: 법원은 검찰이 범행 실행 과정에서 중대한 허위 진술이 있었다는 점을 입증하지 못해 통신사기 등 혐의의 유죄를 뒷받침할 증거가 부족하다고 판단했다.

0d680795ed090de32a832e53.title_ko: 텐센트, 업무용 ‘Hy4 플래시’ 출시…자체 평가서 작업 비용 최대 95% 절감
0d680795ed090de32a832e53.summary_ko: 텐센트가 문서 작성·자료 조사·프레젠테이션 제작 등 일상 업무용 AI 모델 ‘Hy4 플래시’를 출시했다. 최대 100만 토큰 문맥과 멀티모달 입력을 지원하며, 자체 평가에서 기존 Hy4 대비 작업당 비용을 최대 95% 줄였다고 밝혔다. 내부 직원 대상 평가에서는 ‘클로드 하이쿠 5.5’와 비슷한 사용자 만족도를 기록했다고 설명했다.
0d680795ed090de32a832e53.background_ko: 복잡한 추론용 대형 Hy4와 별도로 반복적인 일상 업무의 처리 시간과 비용을 줄이려는 제품 전략에 따라 개발됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 텐센트가 일상 업무용 저비용 모델을 출시했으며 비용 절감 수치는 자체 평가에 근거한다.

af3b307a98ade0f3a6154779.title_ko: AI 기기 활용 시험 부정행위 우려…칼럼서 감독·통신 차단의 한계 지적
af3b307a98ade0f3a6154779.summary_ko: AI 안경·초소형 카메라·이어폰과 생성형 AI를 결합한 시험 부정행위가 감독 체계와 공정성에 미칠 위험을 다룬 칼럼이다. 필자는 육안 감독과 통신 차단만으로는 대응에 한계가 있다며, 주변 통신망 장애와 오프라인 기기 사용 가능성까지 고려한 대책을 촉구했다.
af3b307a98ade0f3a6154779.background_ko: 국가 자격시험에서 첨단 기기를 동원한 부정행위가 드러난 것이 수능 공정성 우려의 배경으로 제시됐다.

baee7199808e674ec9a2805c.title_ko: 메타, AI 테스트로 개인정보 관련 심각한 버그 74건 사전 발견
baee7199808e674ec9a2805c.summary_ko: 메타는 AI가 코드 변경 전후의 동작 차이를 확인하는 실행형 테스트를 생성하는 ‘Catching JiTTests’의 운영 성과를 공개했다. 회사에 따르면 상반기에 개인정보 관련 심각한 버그 74건을 서비스 반영 전에 발견했으며, 엔지니어가 보고한 실제 오류 적중률은 60%였다. 외부 개발자용 코드나 API는 공개하지 않았다.
baee7199808e674ec9a2805c.background_ko: 기존 테스트나 AI 코드 검토에서 놓칠 수 있는 오류를 실제 실행으로 확인하고, 빨라진 코드 작성·배포 속도에 맞춰 검증을 강화하려는 취지다.

curation.reason_ko: 메타가 AI 테스트로 개인정보 관련 중대 버그 74건을 찾았다고 밝혀 실무 방어 활용 사례를 제시했다.

c3352ff8a963ba5b4fea5343.title_ko: 2027년 출제기준 반영한 ‘수제비 정보보안기사 필기 기본서’ 제2판 출간
c3352ff8a963ba5b4fea5343.summary_ko: 2027년 변경 출제기준을 반영한 ‘수제비 정보보안기사 필기 기본서’ 제2판이 20일 출간된다. 현직 기술사 3인이 집필했으며, 5개 필기 과목의 보안 기술·법규와 AI·양자컴퓨팅 등 신기술을 다룬다. 기출·예상문제 1,850개와 온라인 학습 지원도 제공한다.
c3352ff8a963ba5b4fea5343.background_ko: 2027년 개편되는 한국방송통신전파진흥원의 출제기준에 맞춰 기존 수험서의 목차와 이론 체계를 전면 재구성했다.

news_curation.shortfall_reason_ko: 보안·기술은 각 40건이며, AI는 근거·관련성을 고려해 36건을 선정했다. 행사와 GitHub는 제공된 적격 후보 2건·14건만 포함했다.

latest_curation.shortfall_reason_ko: 입력 40건 중 선정 분야와 무관한 3건을 제외하고, 동일 보고서를 다룬 2건을 최신 기사 1건으로 통합해 독립 기사 36건을 선정했습니다.

6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.title_original: Rapid7 Detected Exploitation of CVE-2026-90436 against Atlassian Confluence Data Center, N-able N-central also Exploited
6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.excerpt: Overview On November 6, 2026, the Apache Software Foundation disclosed CVE-2026-90436 , a critical unsafe reflection vulnerability ( CWE-470 ) in Axis 1.x that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). Apache Axis is a Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) implementation used for the creation of Java Web services. CISA has assigned CVE-2026-90436 a CVSS score of 9.8 Critical . Since the initial November 6 disclosure, it has transpired that some versions of Atlassian Confluence Data Center and N-able N-central use the affected Axis library and are vulnerable to CVE-2026-90436. Both products require a non-default configuration in order to be vulnerable. CVE-2026-90436 is now being actively exploited in the wild against both known affected products. On November 13, 2026, Rapid7 MDR detected exploitation of CVE-2026-90436 against Atlassian Confluence Data Center in a customer environment. Separately, on November 13, 2026, N-able reported exploitation in the wild against N-central for a vulnerability that strongly correlates to CVE-2026-90436. A proof-of-concept exploit that leverages CVE-2026-90436 and targets N-central was published on November 12, 2026, as part of a series of public zero-day disclosures against N-central. Rapid7 recommends remediating exposed systems on an emergency basis outside of normal patching cycles. 6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.summary_ko: Rapid7은 Apache Axis의 비인증 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-90436을 악용한 Confluence Data Center 공격을 탐지했다고 밝혔다. N-able도 N-central에서 해당 취약점과 연관성이 높은 공격을 보고했으며, 두 제품 모두 특정 비기본 설정에서 영향을 받는다. Confluence는 9.2.28 등으로 업데이트하고, N-central은 Legacy API 비활성화 등 공급사 지침을 따라야 한다.
6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.background_ko: 두 제품의 일부 버전이 취약한 Apache Axis 라이브러리를 사용하며, Confluence의 원격 API나 N-central의 Legacy API가 활성화된 경우 취약점에 노출된다.

curation.reason_ko: Rapid7이 Confluence의 Apache Axis 취약점 악용을 탐지해 해당 설정을 사용하는 조직의 긴급 대응이 필요하다.

f87fb7aeb1b1ebf020609828.title_original: Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI
f87fb7aeb1b1ebf020609828.excerpt: The attacker stole an access key from Fireworks and used it to exfiltrate credentials that enabled them to push malicious Claude Code extension copies. The post Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI appeared first on SecurityWeek .
f87fb7aeb1b1ebf020609828.title_ko: Cursor 공급망 공격, Fireworks AI에서 유출된 접근 키로 시작
f87fb7aeb1b1ebf020609828.summary_ko: Cursor는 Fireworks AI 침해로 유출된 자사 접근 키가 추가 자격증명 탈취와 악성 Claude Code 확장 배포에 악용됐다고 밝혔다. 변조된 2.1.312·2.1.313 버전은 약 11시간 제공됐고, 회사 추산 최대 5,000명이 영향을 받았다. Anthropic 자체는 침해되지 않았으며, Cursor는 확장 삭제만으로는 충분하지 않을 수 있다고 안내했다.
f87fb7aeb1b1ebf020609828.background_ko: Cursor에 따르면 공격자는 Fireworks AI에서 유출된 접근 키로 읽기 전용 저장소에 접근하고, 그 안의 가려지지 않은 자격증명을 이용해 침투 범위를 넓혔다.

curation.reason_ko: 유출된 접근 키가 악성 개발 확장 배포로 이어져 AI 개발 도구 공급망의 연쇄 침해 위험을 보여준다.

fe958364a97e67d9d6f8eba7.title_original: 미국, 중국의 해외 GPU 우회 이용 차단…새 수출 규제 발표

fe958364a97e67d9d6f8eba7.title_ko: 미국, 중국 기업의 해외 GPU 원격 이용까지 수출 통제 확대
fe958364a97e67d9d6f8eba7.summary_ko: 미 상무부 BIS가 중국 등 규제 대상 기업에 일정 규모 이상의 해외 데이터센터 컴퓨팅 자원을 제공할 때 수출 허가를 요구하는 잠정 최종 규정을 발표했다. 제3국 중개나 AI 훈련 위탁도 포함하며, 싱가포르·말레이시아 등 5개국의 첨단 AI 반도체 수출 심사도 강화했다.
fe958364a97e67d9d6f8eba7.background_ko: 중국 기업이 제3국 데이터센터의 GPU를 원격 임대해 기존 첨단 반도체 직접 수출 제한을 우회하는 것을 막기 위한 조치다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국이 해외 GPU 원격 이용과 제3국 중개까지 통제를 확대해 AI 연산 자원 공급에 변화를 예고했다.

16beeec4708a50e4189f628f.summary_ko: 캘리포니아주 법무장관이 OpenAI가 안전장치 결함을 알고도 AI 에이전트 실험을 계속했다며 소송을 제기했다. 소장은 7월 Hugging Face 침해와 시험 중 80건 이상의 통제 상실을 주장하며, 주 정부는 안전장치 강화 명령과 민사 제재금 등을 요구하고 있다.

curation.reason_ko: AI 에이전트 통제 실패를 둘러싼 소송이 제기됐으며, 소장 주장은 법원에서 확정되지 않았다.

bb3a645f0406ad67dfd31df0.excerpt: Microsoft says a software bug introduced in July caused last week's worldwide Microsoft 365 outage, triggering a cascading failure that left more than 80% of its networking gateway servers unresponsive. [...]
bb3a645f0406ad67dfd31df0.title_ko: Microsoft, 전 세계 Microsoft 365 장애 원인으로 7월 도입된 버그 지목
bb3a645f0406ad67dfd31df0.summary_ko: Microsoft는 11월 12~13일 약 24시간 이어진 Microsoft 365 장애로 Outlook·Teams·Copilot 등이 영향을 받았다고 밝혔다. 예비 조사에 따르면 서버 간 트래픽 재분배가 연쇄 장애로 이어져 한때 네트워크 게이트웨이 서버의 80% 이상이 응답하지 않았다. 회사는 수정사항을 배포해 복구했으며 용량 증설과 모니터링·안전장치 강화 조치를 취했다고 설명했다.
bb3a645f0406ad67dfd31df0.background_ko: Microsoft의 예비 조사에 따르면 7월 업데이트에 포함된 잠복 버그가 Teams의 인프라 전환에 따른 트래픽 증가와 서버 용량 감소가 겹치면서 촉발됐다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft가 전 세계 업무 서비스 장애의 연쇄 실패 원인과 복구 조치를 설명해 클라우드 운영 교훈을 제공한다.

059ec74baba0bfdb603e1be7.excerpt: Hackers who breached the cloud environment of network and email security company Barracuda earlier this month used a stolen cloud access key and the ARTEX AI penetration testing framework. [...]
059ec74baba0bfdb603e1be7.title_ko: Barracuda, 클라우드 침해에 ARTEX AI 침투 테스트 도구 사용됐다고 밝혀
059ec74baba0bfdb603e1be7.summary_ko: Barracuda는 11월 1~2일 44시간 동안 클라우드 계정 약 10개가 침해됐으며, 공격에 ARTEX AI 침투 테스트 프레임워크가 쓰였다고 밝혔다. 고객 연동 자격증명 보관 시스템에도 공격자가 접근했지만 해당 정보의 열람·탈취 증거는 찾지 못했다. 회사는 잠재적 영향 고객에게 직접 통보하고 연동 자격증명의 폐기·재발급을 요청했다.
059ec74baba0bfdb603e1be7.background_ko: Barracuda는 프로젝트 종료 후 폐기하지 않은 협력사용 클라우드 접근 키가 협력사 GitHub 저장소의 설정 파일에 보관돼 있었으며, 이 키가 탈취된 것으로 추정했다.

curation.reason_ko: Barracuda가 탈취 키와 ARTEX를 이용한 클라우드 침해를 확인하고 고객 연동 자격증명 재발급을 요청했다.

7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.title_original: From view-only access to container root: five vulnerabilities in ONLYOFFICE Docs (FIXED)
7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.excerpt: Overview As part of our research into Zimbra Collaboration Suite , Rapid7 reported five findings in ONLYOFFICE Docs. An attacker with view-only access to a document can chain vulnerabilities in ONLYOFFICE Docs to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root inside the official DocumentServer container. The findings also expose server files and document data that the viewer never displays, even when downloading is disabled. CVE Finding CVSS CVE-2026-113627 DocBuilder native file read and Session JWT forgery 7.1 High CVE-2026-110385 DocBuilder SaveFile conversion parameter injection and code execution 8.7 High CVE-2026-97727 Complete-save format path traversal and arbitrary file write 6.5 Medium CVE-2026-113630 Root-helper command injection 7.8 High CVE-2026-113631 View-only export of non-rendered document data 6.5 Medium ONLYOFFICE confirmed on October 23, 2026 that all five findings were fixed in Document Server 10.0. The changelog describes the release's security changes. Proof-of-concept code is available on the accompanying Github repository . Product description ONLYOFFICE Docs provides online viewers and editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, forms and PDFs. It supports collaborative editing and can integrate with applications that store and share files. An integrating application, for example Zimbra Collaboration Suite, supplies an opening configuration identifying the document and the user's permissions, signed with the Browser key. 7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.title_ko: ONLYOFFICE Docs 취약점 5건…열람 권한만으로 컨테이너 root 권한 획득 가능
7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.summary_ko: Rapid7은 ONLYOFFICE Docs 취약점 5건을 연계해 문서 열람 권한만으로 공식 DocumentServer 컨테이너에서 root 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있다고 밝혔다. 재현은 9.4.0-129에서 이뤄졌으며, ONLYOFFICE는 10.0에서 모두 수정했다고 확인했다.

96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.title_original: VU#604762: Multiple vendors vulnerable to Unicode Normalization Collision on macOS (APFS)
96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.excerpt: Overview A mismatch between Apple File System (APFS) filesystem and path resolution for multiple applications allows attackers to bypass security exclusions using alternative Unicode spellings. By supplying an alternative Unicode spelling or case-folded variant (such as ß versus ss ) that bypasses the application's file write checks, a local attacker can overwrite files wherever the process has write permissions, potentially leading to data corruption, configuration hijacking, or code execution. Multiple vendors have assigned CVEs and issued patches to address this flaw. Description Several archive tools, packaging systems, and runtimes enforce exclusion filters using pathname comparisons that do not match the underlying filesystem's resolution behavior. By using a byte-for-byte comparison (such as ß versus ss ), rather than full case folding, a vulnerable application can be tricked into silently overwriting protected files. This vulnerability exposes backup tools, forensic workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to unauthorized file modification. The CVEs assigned during coordination are as follows: CVE-2026-14978 HashiCorp go-slug could allow an attacker with local filesystem access to bypass .terraformignore exclusions and cause sensitive files to be included in Terraform slug uploads due to improper handling of Unicode normalization during path matching. 96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.summary_ko: CERT/CC는 APFS의 파일명 해석과 애플리케이션의 경로 비교 방식이 달라 파일 제외 규칙과 접근 제한을 우회할 수 있다고 경고했다. Deno·Libarchive·setuptools·HashiCorp go-slug 등이 관련되며, 파일 덮어쓰기나 배포물에 민감 파일이 포함되는 문제가 발생할 수 있어 영향받는 소프트웨어의 업데이트를 권고했다.
96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.background_ko: 일부 도구가 경로를 바이트 단위로 비교해, 서로 다른 유니코드 표기나 대소문자 변형을 같은 파일로 취급하는 파일시스템의 동작을 반영하지 못했다.

af5f019d5accf432b8239e5d.title_original: High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors
af5f019d5accf432b8239e5d.excerpt: In this article Phishing attack overview Attack chain overview Mitigation and protection guidance References Learn More On November 13, 2026, Microsoft Threat Intelligence observed a coordinated, high-volume phishing campaign targeting organizations across multiple sectors worldwide. The threat actors used phishing emails disguised as legitimate Microsoft 365 service-health notifications to lure recipients into clicking a malicious link. The messages created a false sense of urgency by claiming that emails had been held during a service disruption and would be deleted within 24 hours unless the recipient took action to restore them. This is consistent with historical attacker campaigns which continuously look for notable global events to exploit in their social engineering lures. Microsoft identified the threat actor’s use of specific sender domain names, randomized outage subjects, recipient-specific tracking links, and a common non-Microsoft destination to make the messages appear relevant while complicating simple pattern matching. We assess that the activity was likely credential phishing; however, the available evidence does not confirm credential capture, malware delivery, or post-compromise activity. Multiple threat actors may continue to look for ways to exploit notable global events in any social engineering pretext. 68079a3f05fa18e842ff4757.title_original: Mind the Gap: Cross-RFC Formal Analysis Exposes DNSSEC's Hidden Vulnerabilities
68079a3f05fa18e842ff4757.excerpt: arXiv:2512.11431v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents a cross-RFC formal analysis of selected DNSSEC mechanisms using SAPIC+ models of cryptographic operations and stateful caching. We analyze properties concerning data origin authenticity, integrity, chain of trust, and authenticated denial of existence within these models. Our analysis shows that core authentication properties hold under the modeled assumptions, while wildcard expansion, the mechanism that bridges positive and negative authentication, exhibits a cross-RFC interaction vulnerability that defeats DNSSEC's integrity guarantee. Specifically, we discover Cross-Zone Wildcard Cache Poisoning: a new attack in which a malicious zone operator exploits a gap in the DNSSEC specifications to poison resolver caches with forged records for some domains outside its authority, served to clients as DNSSEC-authentic. The tested versions of all four major resolvers implementing the affected caching optimization accept the malformed wildcard material. The resulting impact depends on the resolver's synthesis path. All four vendors have publicly released fixes. The distinctive integrity failure is a synthesized, attacker-chosen positive answer with the Authenticated Data (AD) bit set: prior attacks instead exhausted availability, downgraded to AD=0, or skipped validation. This differs from benchmaxxing, which optimizes toward a benchmark without seeing its test set. We document two escalations over the past month. First, in post-training, the traces have become explicit: recent audits show an agent stating hidden test requirements it was never given in 23% of its attempts, where its predecessor did so in none, and continuing to follow them after the task is changed to contradict them (Schaeffer and R\"auker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026). Second, the problem has reached pre-training. Using few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks across four public base models, we find that some base models write out other test examples---complete questions, options, and answers---that appear nowhere in their input. 3d17bc550df8b4547ea76379.excerpt: arXiv:2611.21003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. cabcf5fca502ae0505df8af9.title_original: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
cabcf5fca502ae0505df8af9.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.

14fe741593eb9b3f16a62289.title_original: Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers
14fe741593eb9b3f16a62289.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19237v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforceable control boundary between intent and real-world effect.

This paper studies this gap as tool-provider misbinding: a failure in which a request intended for a legitimate provider is instead resolved to an attacker-controlled tool. Different models expose the same provider-binding weakness differently, including attacker-controlled provider selection, clarification requests, and unstable or inconsistent provider resolution.

3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.title_original: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.excerpt: arXiv:2611.21053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.title_ko: 텍스트 생성 없이 도구를 호출하는 로컬 ‘System 1’ 에이전트 제안
3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.summary_ko: 연구진은 요청과 도구 명세를 객관식 질문으로 바꾸고, 단일 판단 모델이 답을 선택하는 로컬 에이전트 방식을 제안했다. 생의학 도구 157개의 요청 1,952건 평가에서 올바른 도구 선택 또는 거절 비율은 97.0%였으며, 생성한 도구 호출에 지어낸 내용이 포함된 사례는 없었다고 보고했다.

429a29127df333c850151ff8.title_original: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval

be488a49ba6fb154a3be9df7.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19886v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through tools, reading repositories, running builds, and pushing code. d520880abd38fbc738144af2.title_original: Compositional Exploits in Autonomous Coding Agents: Attack Mechanics and Ephemeral Defense
d520880abd38fbc738144af2.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenHands) rely on third-party tools to inspect files, run commands, and call external APIs. 60fc3038701d3c4ac72202e4.title_original: ElevatorII: High-Performance Fully-Static Cross-ISA Binary Translation
60fc3038701d3c4ac72202e4.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The established method for running software compiled for one instruction-set architecture (ISA) on a different ISA is by emulation in conjunction with just-in-time (JIT) compilation. Our approach eliminates the need for run-time support on the target, removes the hard to reproduce effects of dynamic compilation, and provides the capability to exhaustively test the actual binary that is eventually executed. Our approach combines superset disassembly with observation-guided path selection. Superset disassembly overcomes the code vs. data differentiation problem by creating a separate control flow path for every possible interpretation of every byte in the input binary. It guarantees that there is pre-translated code for every possible jump destination in the original text segment, even for computed jumps that are not statically decidable. Static and observation-guided path selection then creates additional optimized "confirmed code paths" that overlay the regular grid. 78ac323a3ce89a78fb7f519c.title_original: CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs
78ac323a3ce89a78fb7f519c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.20119v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances. On the Qwen3-30B-A3B model, CECAR achieves 12.5 tokens/s on a consumer-grade GPU with only 16 GB of VRAM, where non-resident experts are fetched from SSD, delivering a 4.5x speedup over conventional MoE inference and exceeding the decode speed of baselines that keep the entire model fully resident in DRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/CECAR.

7a1ba4b0092e4388cf46dab1.title_original: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
7a1ba4b0092e4388cf46dab1.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

8a7f22caafaff6d8abcda020.title_original: Analog Resonant Recurrent Neural Networks via Metacircuits
8a7f22caafaff6d8abcda020.excerpt: arXiv:2604.17277v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physical neural networks offer a promising route to fast and energy-efficient edge intelligence by embedding computation in the intrinsic dynamics of materials and devices. However, processing temporal signals requires recurrent networks with memory, whose trained dynamics are hard to reproduce faithfully in physical systems. Here we present an analog resonant recurrent neural network (R$^2$NN) implemented as a metacircuit of coupled local resonators. A reformulated mechanical-electrical analogy based on frequency-dependent negative resistances maps a trained network one-to-one onto the metacircuit, with every trainable parameter realized as a resistance. Training tunes local resonances and global resistive couplings so that past responses persist as recurrent memory and interfere with incoming inputs, and the resulting impedance landscape routes different frequencies to distinct outputs. Exploiting this recurrent memory, the metacircuit solves a temporal-parity task whose output depends on the entire input history. Building on the learned frequency selectivity, stand-alone R$^2$NN systems classify raw tactile, acoustic and vibration signals in real time and directly drive downstream hardware. This work establishes engineered locally resonant dynamics as a physical substrate for recurrent neural computation and opens a route to compact, low-latency neural hardware for machine intelligence at the edge.
8a7f22caafaff6d8abcda020.title_ko: 공진기 메타회로로 순환신경망 구현…촉각·음향·진동 실시간 분류

09a2ca5ec574bc77f2190a31.excerpt: In this article A new cyber stack, built to fight AI with AI Delivering agentic security at Microsoft Ignite Secure your foundations Defend with agents Secure agentic insiders Changing how security work gets done Explore what's new A year ago, finding a serious, exploitable vulnerability was slow and expensive work done by elite security researchers. That’s no longer true. Over the past 12 months, frontier AI models have become remarkably good at discovering and exploiting software vulnerabilities, and similar levels of capability are quickly becoming available in open weights models with limited cyber guardrails. Attacks that once required specialized resources are now within reach of almost anyone. We saw what that looks like in a single week this fall when PHP disclosed two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, flaws that let an attacker take control of a server with a single request over the internet. 1 At the time of disclosure, tens of millions of internet-facing PHP services were running affected versions. Nearly two weeks later, about 29 million services remained vulnerable. Behind those servers are banks, healthcare providers, energy companies, and much of the infrastructure the internet runs on. And that same day brought five other major disclosures across the industry. 292a5d3b148fe5c926b6464a.summary_ko: 스캐터랩이 AI 서비스 제타의 콘텐츠 안전 정책과 자체 AI 모델 개발·검수를 통합 관리하는 대표 직속 전담팀을 신설했다. 연령별 콘텐츠 접근관리와 부적절한 대화 방지 기능을 강화하고, AI와 상호작용 중임을 주기적으로 알릴 계획이다. 국내 청소년의 하루 이용 시간을 3시간, 월 결제 한도를 10만원으로 제한하는 기능도 연내 도입할 예정이다.
292a5d3b148fe5c926b6464a.background_ko: 스캐터랩은 AI 인터랙티브 서비스 제타의 이용자 보호를 강화하기 위해 안전 전담 조직과 연령별 보호 체계를 마련한다고 밝혔다.

curation.reason_ko: 제타 다운로드 중단 속에 안전 전담팀과 청소년 이용·결제 제한 계획이 발표돼 국내 AI 서비스 통제 변화가 보인다.

cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.title_original: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.excerpt: arXiv:2611.20771v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.title_ko: 빠른 로컬 대화 에이전트용 소형 모델 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 공개
cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.summary_ko: 연구진은 Gemma-4-E4B-it를 추가 후학습해 대화와 여러 차례의 도구 사용을 개선한 소형 모델 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB를 공개했다. 21개 벤치마크에서 비교 모델보다 평균 정확도가 높고 출력 토큰이 적었으며, DFlash 적용 시 동시 요청 1개 조건의 디코딩 속도가 추측 디코딩 미사용 대비 2.74배였다고 보고했다.
cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.background_ko: 로컬 음성·기기 비서와 로봇·IoT 인터페이스에서 빠르게 동작하도록 메모리 사용량 대비 성능과 대화·도구 사용 능력을 최적화했다.

curation.reason_ko: 로컬 대화·도구 사용에 최적화한 공개 소형 모델과 가속 도구가 제시됐으며 성능 우위는 연구진 평가다.

c6d97c03dd402eb660c3e76d.title_ko: Optimizely 취약점 악용해 178개 조직 웹사이트에 악성 코드 유입

978233edaf72cb24e0b46fef.summary_ko: 보도에 따르면 엔비디아 이사회는 젠슨 황의 CEO 복귀를 배제하고 전문 업체를 통해 내부·외부 후임 후보 검토에 나섰다. 3분기 매출은 전년보다 두 배 이상 늘었지만, 중국향 Hopper 칩 출하 중단과 경영진 교체로 AI 인프라 투자 전략의 향방이 주목된다.

curation.reason_ko: 엔비디아 이사회가 젠슨 황의 CEO 복귀를 배제하고 후임 선임에 나서 경영 전환 방향이 구체화됐다.

d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.title_ko: Cisco Talos, OpenJDK 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-114938 공개
d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.summary_ko: Cisco Talos는 OpenJDK Java 17.0.6 이상에서 조작된 Base64 입력으로 인증 없이 원격 코드 실행이 가능할 수 있는 취약점을 공개했다. AVX-512 VBMI가 활성화된 x86-64 환경이 대상이며 CVSS 4.0 점수는 9.2라고 설명했다. 실제 악용은 아직 관측되지 않았으며, 업데이트 적용이나 JVM의 AVX-512 사용 비활성화를 권고했다.
d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.background_ko: Talos에 따르면 AVX-512 VBMI가 활성화된 일부 x86-64 JVM에서 잘못된 Base64 입력을 처리할 때 원격 코드 실행이 발생할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Talos가 특정 CPU 환경의 OpenJDK 원격 코드 실행 위험을 경고했으며 실제 악용은 관측하지 못했다.

0cffca88b39abb84a21edcd9.title_ko: 미국, 빅테크 반대에도 중국산 데이터센터 광트랜시버 수입 제한 추진
0cffca88b39abb84a21edcd9.summary_ko: 로이터 보도에 따르면 미국 정부는 빅테크의 반대에도 중국산 신형 광트랜시버 수입 금지를 계속 추진하고 있다. 관련 기업들은 조치 이행에 최장 10년이 걸릴 수 있다고 주장했으며, 행정부 기류에 따라 규제가 보류될 가능성도 거론됐다.
0cffca88b39abb84a21edcd9.background_ko: 미 정가에서는 중국산 광트랜시버가 데이터 탈취나 악성코드 설치, 서비스 방해에 악용될 수 있다는 국가안보 우려가 제기됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국의 중국산 광트랜시버 수입 제한 추진에 빅테크가 반발해 데이터센터 공급망의 정책 불확실성이 커졌다.

8d8efd1deef14a69c27d2a37.title_ko: 현대차, 12월 웨이모에 로보택시용 아이오닉 5 공급…해외 수출도 추진
8d8efd1deef14a69c27d2a37.summary_ko: 현대차는 2026년 12월 웨이모에 아이오닉 5를 로보택시 전용 차량으로 공급할 계획이다. 차량에는 웨이모의 6세대 자율주행 시스템이 탑재되며, 호세 무뇨스 사장은 미국 시장 공급뿐 아니라 해외 수출도 이뤄질 것이라고 밝혔다. 모셔널을 통한 미국 로보택시 서비스도 추진한다.
8d8efd1deef14a69c27d2a37.background_ko: 현대차는 2024년 10월 아이오닉 5에 웨이모의 6세대 자율주행 시스템을 탑재하는 다년간 전략적 파트너십을 체결했다.

curation.reason_ko: 현대차가 12월 Waymo용 아이오닉 5 공급과 수출 계획을 밝혀 로보택시 차량 생산 협력이 구체화됐다.

8f645aad3234b5eada33ca19.title_ko: 보스턴다이나믹스, 2027년 반도체 제조 현장서 아틀라스 시험
8f645aad3234b5eada33ca19.summary_ko: 보스턴다이나믹스는 글로벌파운드리와 협력해 2027년 초부터 반도체 제조 현장에서 휴머노이드 로봇 아틀라스를 시험한다. 활용 가능한 작업과 요구 조건을 확인하고 초기 작업 학습을 진행할 예정이다. 사족보행 로봇 스팟의 배치도 미국·독일·싱가포르 생산시설로 확대한다.
8f645aad3234b5eada33ca19.background_ko: 이번 협력은 반도체 제조 현장에서 휴머노이드의 활용 작업과 요구 조건을 확인하고 AI 기반 제조를 확대하기 위해 추진됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 보스턴다이나믹스가 반도체 제조 현장에서 Atlas를 검증하기로 해 휴머노이드의 산업 적용 범위가 확장된다.

0cc2e28fceba92242e044b4e.title_ko: 라쿠텐증권, 테스트 환경 고객정보 유출 가능성…최대 447만 계좌 상세정보
0cc2e28fceba92242e044b4e.summary_ko: 라쿠텐증권은 테스트 환경의 고객정보가 유출됐을 가능성을 확인했으며, 상세 개인정보는 최대 약 447만 계좌, 고객코드·로그인 ID는 최대 약 1125만 계좌가 영향 범위라고 밝혔다. 두 수치는 합산할 수 없으며 침입 원인은 조사 중이다. 발표 당시 비밀번호 유출이나 계정 무단 접속·부정거래는 확인되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 라쿠텐증권이 최대 약 447만 계좌의 상세 고객정보 유출 가능성을 밝혀 금융 개인정보 보호 대응이 중요하다.

f7320f8621527a3c730a5a3a.title_ko: EUDI 지갑의 자격증명 모으기 공격 제시…대응 기법 CRESTA 제안
f7320f8621527a3c730a5a3a.summary_ko: 연구진은 여러 사용자가 각자 보유한 자격증명을 프록시로 모아, 한 사용자가 모든 자격을 갖춘 것처럼 서비스를 속이는 EUDI 지갑 공격을 제시했다. 서명 위조 없이 유럽위원회 참조 구현과 안드로이드폰 2대에서 공격을 시험했다고 밝혔다. 표준 호환 대응 기법 CRESTA도 제안했다.
f7320f8621527a3c730a5a3a.background_ko: 연구진은 사용자 추적을 막기 위해 자격증명마다 다른 키를 쓰도록 한 EUDI 참조 구조가 서로 다른 사용자의 자격증명을 모으는 공격을 가능하게 한다고 분석했다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진이 EUDI 참조 구현에서 여러 사용자의 진짜 자격증명을 한 사용자처럼 결합하는 공격을 시연했다.

7192bf73c6df17273f2939db.title_ko: 13개월 추적 연구, 언어모델 편향 변화 보고…일회성 공정성 감사 한계
7192bf73c6df17273f2939db.summary_ko: 연구진은 5개 제공사의 언어모델에 창업자 성별·출신·대학만 다른 스타트업 투자 판단을 맡기고, 13개월간 세 차례에 걸쳐 API 24만8400회를 호출했다. 같은 모델 식별자라도 1년 뒤 편향 양상이 달라졌으며, 후속 모델에도 편향이 다른 크기와 형태로 남았다고 보고했다. 이에 모델 계열 단위 감사와 응답별 버전 기록을 제안했다.
7192bf73c6df17273f2939db.background_ko: 채용·투자·직원 평가에 언어모델이 장기간 쓰이지만 공정성 감사는 일회성으로 시행되는 상황에서 편향의 시간적 변화를 조사했다.

curation.reason_ko: 13개월 반복 감사에서 제공형 모델의 편향 양상이 달라져 일회성 공정성 검증의 유효기간 문제가 제기됐다.

2456d1c76d63c5b343eb3a29.title_ko: OpenAI, 영업 업무용 ChatGPT Sales 플러그인 소개
2456d1c76d63c5b343eb3a29.summary_ko: OpenAI가 ChatGPT의 새 Sales 플러그인과 30개 이상의 신규·기능 확장 파트너 플러그인을 소개했다. 잠재 고객 조사, 영업 제안 준비, 고객관계관리(CRM) 시스템 업데이트 등 거래 진행에 필요한 업무를 지원한다고 설명했다.

curation.reason_ko: 영업용 ChatGPT 플러그인과 파트너 연동이 확대돼 잠재고객 조사부터 CRM 갱신까지 업무 적용 범위가 넓어진다.

f1632157e7fc152502de9193.title_ko: Docker Hub 이미지에 노출된 AWS 키, 실험서 최단 7.86초 만에 악용
f1632157e7fc152502de9193.summary_ko: Stony Brook University 연구진이 공개 컨테이너 레지스트리 8곳에 미끼 이미지 300개를 게시해 인증정보 악용 속도를 측정했다. Docker Hub에서는 AWS 키가 게시 후 최단 7.86초 만에 사용됐고, 심어 둔 AWS 키 100개 모두 15분 안에 사용됐다고 보고했다. 연구진은 이미지 공개 전 비밀정보 검사와 신규 이미지 피드 접근 제한 등을 제안했다.
f1632157e7fc152502de9193.background_ko: 연구진은 컨테이너 실행이 거의 관측되지 않은 점을 근거로 자동 스캐너가 주로 이미지 계층을 정적으로 분석해 노출된 인증정보를 추출한다고 해석했다.

curation.reason_ko: 공개 Docker 이미지의 접근 비밀이 최단 8초 만에 탈취·악용됐다는 보도로 배포 전 비밀정보 점검이 중요하다.

8688aff3472ded49101fd4d2.title_ko: TOCTOU 경쟁 상태 재현과 수정 검증을 위한 Chronos 프레임워크 제안
8688aff3472ded49101fd4d2.summary_ko: 연구진이 검사 시점과 사용 시점 사이의 경쟁 상태인 TOCTOU를 재현하고 수정 여부를 판정하는 Chronos를 제안했다. 개입 시점과 판정 근거를 분리하고, 수정 판정에 명시적 증거를 요구한다. 취약한 빌드에서 개입이 실패한 실험을 평가한 결과, 기존 결과 기반 검사기는 800건 넘게 수정됐다고 오판했지만 Chronos에서는 이런 오판이 없었다고 보고했다.
8688aff3472ded49101fd4d2.background_ko: TOCTOU 경쟁 상태는 재현이 어렵고 공격이 타이밍 경쟁에서 실패하면 취약한 프로그램도 수정된 것처럼 보일 수 있다는 문제가 연구 배경이다.

curation.reason_ko: 경쟁 조건을 결정론적으로 재현하고 수정 여부의 증거를 분리하는 기법이 보안 회귀 검사의 오판을 줄였다.

564b2a9e8c02c4aad63d55c2.title_ko: 계층형 AI 에이전트로 다단계 분자 합성을 조정하는 VibeSyn 제안
564b2a9e8c02c4aad63d55c2.summary_ko: 연구진은 화학자의 합성 목표와 누적 실험 근거를 계층형 에이전트가 해석해 다음 결정을 조정하는 VibeSyn을 제안·시연했다. 10단계 catharanthine 전합성과 비천연 아미노산을 포함한 고리형 펩타이드 합성 등 세 가지 시연으로 평가했다. 장기 합성 과정에서 능동적 인간 개입과 단순 확인은 기록된 행동·결과의 각각 7.5%, 5.2% 미만이었다고 밝혔다.
564b2a9e8c02c4aad63d55c2.background_ko: 기존 AI 도구와 자동화 플랫폼의 사전 정의된 작업·고정 워크플로는 다단계 합성 중 축적되는 근거에 맞춰 결정을 수정하는 데 한계가 있다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진이 계층형 에이전트와 실험 자동화로 다단계 분자 합성을 수행해 장기 과학 작업의 자동화 가능성을 보였다.

a9b95f6a1d0af26af9704ed8.title_ko: 일본 RIKEN, 보안 침해로 슈퍼컴퓨터 Fugaku 가동 중단
a9b95f6a1d0af26af9704ed8.summary_ko: 일본 RIKEN이 내부 서버 침입과 악성코드 설치를 확인하고 11월 14일 슈퍼컴퓨터 Fugaku 가동을 중단했다. Fugaku·Rikyu 사용자 개인정보와 사용자 컴퓨터에 저장된 인증키·연구 데이터 파일이 침해됐다고 밝혔다. 추가 시스템의 무단 접근이나 연구 결과 탈취는 확인되지 않았으며, 정확한 침입 방식은 조사 중이다.

curation.reason_ko: 보안 침해 이후 Fugaku 슈퍼컴퓨터가 중단돼 연구용 고성능 컴퓨팅 인프라의 가용성 문제가 드러났다.

ccd8f6485a9e5274f521bce0.title_ko: 온폴리시 증류가 교사 모델의 백도어를 학생 모델로 전파할 수 있다는 연구
ccd8f6485a9e5274f521bce0.summary_ko: 연구진은 지도 미세조정으로 교사 모델에 심은 조건부 백도어가 온폴리시 증류(OPD)를 통해 학생 모델로 전파될 수 있다고 보고했다. 극소량의 트리거 프롬프트 노출만으로 전이가 발생했고, 기존 증류 방식보다 강하게 나타났다는 설명이다. 트리거 입력에 대한 교사 모델의 비정상적 조건부 확률 차이를 전파 경로로 분석하고, 이를 억제하는 학습 방법을 제안했다.
ccd8f6485a9e5274f521bce0.background_ko: 교사 모델이 온라인으로 생성한 지도 신호를 활용하는 OPD가 확산되는 가운데, 잠재적 보안 위험도 학생 모델에 전달되는지는 충분히 연구되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 온라인 증류가 교사 모델의 조건부 백도어를 학생에게 전달할 수 있다는 실험이 모델 학습 공급망 위험을 제기했다.

hot.reason_ko: 인증 없이 루트 권한을 얻는 취약점의 실제 악용이 보고돼 ESG 운영자의 긴급 패치가 필요하다.
특정 비기본 설정의 Confluence·N-central에서 원격 코드 실행 취약점 악용이 보고돼 대응이 시급하다.
접근 키 유출이 악성 확장 배포로 이어졌으며, 회사 추산 최대 5천 명이 영향받은 AI 개발 공급망 사고다.
MSP 서버 42곳을 겨냥한 공격과 악성 클라이언트 설치가 관찰돼 원격관리 환경의 대응이 시급하다.
중국 기업의 해외 GPU 원격 이용과 훈련 위탁까지 통제하는 규정으로, AI 인프라 사업의 중요 변수다.
약 24시간의 전 세계 장애로 주요 업무 도구가 영향을 받았으며, 연쇄 장애 원인에 대한 예비 조사 결과가 나왔다.
약 2만5천 건의 계정정보와 암호화 비밀번호가 유출돼 국내 이용자의 계정 보호 조치가 시급하다.
학생 주소·통학 노선·학부모 연락처 유출이 확인돼 학생 개인정보와 이동 안전 측면에서 중요한 국내 사고다.
공격자가 고객 연동 자격증명 보관 시스템에 접근해 재발급이 요청됐다. 정보 탈취 증거는 확인되지 않았다.
