CVE-2026-118789.description: Farmasimplex retrieves a CIP News file over HTTP and executes embedded SQL statements against the local FarmaCIP database with administrative privileges. An attacker able to tamper with network communications or compromise vendor infrastructure can inject arbitrary SQL commands, leading to unauthorized access to, modification or deletion of database contents and potentially operating system command execution.
CVE-2026-118789.summary_ko: Farmasimplex에 네트워크 통신 변조나 공급업체 인프라 침해를 통해 임의 SQL 명령이 주입될 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 로컬 FarmaCIP 데이터베이스의 무단 접근·수정·삭제와 잠재적인 운영체제 명령 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-118789.background_ko: HTTP로 내려받은 CIP News 파일에 포함된 SQL 문을 로컬 FarmaCIP 데이터베이스에서 관리자 권한으로 실행한다.

CVE-2026-123050.description: Multiple Farmasimplex healthcare integration modules do not properly validate TLS certificates, allowing an attacker who can intercept network traffic to impersonate trusted healthcare services and perform man-in-the-middle attacks, potentially leading to disclosure or modification of sensitive data.

CVE-2026-123051.description: The REV.exe module distributed with Farmasimplex contains embedded OAuth client credentials for integration with the IZS platform. An attacker with access to the executable could extract and reuse the credentials, potentially leading to unauthorized access to integration resources or manipulation of associated information, depending on the privileges granted and authentication controls in place.

CVE-2026-123052.description: The CeliachiaRL integration component distributed with Farmasimplex uses shared OAuth credentials across multiple customer installations. An attacker who obtains the credentials from one installation could reuse them against services associated with other installations, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information or modification of integration data.

CVE-2026-130626.description: The core JDK HTTP client (a2a-java-sdk-http-client) applies the GHSA-9rhm redirect-neutralization only to the POST path. JdkGetBuilder.get(), JdkGetBuilder.getAsyncSSE(), and JdkDeleteBuilder.delete() call the injected httpClient directly, with no redirect gate. An application that supplies a redirect-capable HttpClient (Redirect.NORMAL/ALWAYS) — which is the SDK-documented way to enable POST redirects — silently follows cross-authority redirects on every credentialed GET/DELETE request. The JDK strips Authorization cross-origin, but forwards the four allowlisted custom credential headers (X-API-Key, API-Key, X-Auth-Token, X-Authentication) to the attacker-controlled authority. This is an incomplete-fix variant of GHSA-9rhm: the fix hardened the default client and added a POST-only two-step opt-in, but never covered GET/DELETE.
CVE-2026-130626.summary_ko: a2a-java-sdk-http-client의 JDK 전송은 리디렉션을 허용하는 HttpClient를 사용할 때 GET·DELETE 요청의 사용자 정의 자격 증명 헤더를 다른 서버로 전달해 유출할 수 있다. Authorization 헤더는 다른 출처로 전달되지 않는다.
CVE-2026-130626.background_ko: 기존 리디렉션 방어가 POST에만 적용되고, GET·DELETE 처리 경로는 리디렉션 통제 없이 주입된 HttpClient를 직접 호출한다.

CVE-2026-130627.description: The Vert.x HTTP client transport (a2a-java-sdk-http-client-vertx) hand-rolls a POST redirect follower that, when the documented PostBuilder.followRedirects(true) opt-in is enabled, re-issues the redirected request with the full request header map copied verbatim and performs no credential stripping and no same-authority check. A malicious, compromised, or mistyped agent that returns a 30x response with an absolute cross-host Location causes the client to forward the standard Authorization header (Bearer/Basic/OAuth) — plus every other header, including the allowlisted API-key headers — to the attacker-controlled authority. This breaks the project's own cross-transport invariant (SECURITY.md §8, OkHttpPostRedirectHeaderLeakTest) that credentials are stripped on cross-authority redirects even when redirects are followed. The sibling JDK and OkHttp/Android transports strip Authorization; Vert.x uniquely does not. This is a "fix introduced the bug" variant — the follower was added by the GHSA-9rhm hardening PR (3ae82912, refined by a5e76a0b).
CVE-2026-130627.summary_ko: a2a-java-sdk-http-client-vertx의 Vert.x 전송에서 POST 리디렉션 추적을 활성화하면, 다른 호스트로 이동할 때 Authorization과 API 키 등 요청 헤더의 자격 증명이 공격자에게 유출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-130627.background_ko: POST 리디렉션을 직접 처리하면서 요청 헤더 전체를 그대로 복사하고, 자격 증명 제거와 대상 서버 일치 여부 검사를 수행하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-130628.description: react-native-webview 13.7.0 through 17.1.0 on Windows contains an unrestricted URI scheme launch vulnerability in the WebView2 OnCoreWebView2NewWindowRequested handler, which passes requested URIs to LaunchUriAsync without scheme or user-initiation checks. Malicious web content can call window.open() or use target=_blank links with schemes like ms-settings: to launch Windows protocol handlers without the external-protocol confirmation prompt.

CVE-2026-130629.description: react-native-webview 13.8.0 through 17.1.0 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute JavaScript by placing unescaped backticks or ${} sequences in injectedJavaScriptObject string values. Attackers who control values like profile fields or API responses can break out of the template literal to access the page DOM, non-HttpOnly cookies, and the ReactNativeWebView message bridge.

CVE-2026-130630.description: GPAC 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in dasher_configure_pid() in src/filters/dasher.c that dereferences ds2->set without checking for NULL. Attackers can supply a crafted MPEG-2 TS file processed with MP4Box -dash to disconnect a PID and crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-130631.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an uninitialized pointer access vulnerability in GetESD() in src/isomedia/track.c that allows attackers to trigger invalid memory reads via crafted MP4 files. Attackers can supply an MP4 with an rvcc box having predefined_rvc_config set to 0 and no meta item index, causing strcmp() on an uninitialized mime_type pointer and crashing MP4Box -add.

CVE-2026-130632.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in m2tsdmx_send_packet() in src/filters/dmx_m2ts.c caused by double-skipping the VC-1 start-code offset. Attackers can supply a crafted MPEG-2 TS VC-1 stream that underflows the remaining length, causing memcpy() to over-read and crash MP4Box on import.

CVE-2026-130633.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_filter_pid_set_args_internal() that leaves a stale pointer after gf_props_reset_single() frees a parsed PID property value. Attackers can supply a crafted filelist input processed by MP4Box with -add, causing gf_props_del_property() to access freed memory and crash the application.

CVE-2026-130634.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in gf_mpd_resolve_url() in src/media_tools/mpd.c that allows attackers to write past a heap buffer via crafted DASH manifests. Attackers can supply a crafted MPD whose segment template expands beyond the allocation through unchecked strcat() calls, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-130635.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in dasher_gather_deps() in src/filters/dasher.c that fails to detect cyclic stream dependency chains. Attackers can supply a crafted MPEG-2 TS file that MP4Box processes with -dash, exhausting the stack and crashing the process for denial of service.

CVE-2026-77224.description: Camunda 7.24.0 before 7.24.14 and 7.23.0 before 7.23.17 contains an XML External Entity (XXE) injection vulnerability in the camunda-external-task-client's DomXmlDataFormat.defaultDocumentBuilderFactory(), which fails to disable external entity resolution when parsing object variables serialized with application/xml. An attacker able to write a process variable can trigger arbitrary file read and out-of-band outbound HTTP requests from every worker JVM that deserializes the variable, enabling exfiltration of credentials, service-account tokens, and private key material from network segments deeper than the engine itself.
CVE-2026-77224.summary_ko: Camunda의 camunda-external-task-client에 XML 외부 엔티티(XXE) 주입 취약점이 있다. 프로세스 변수를 쓸 수 있는 공격자는 이를 역직렬화하는 작업자 JVM에서 임의 파일 읽기와 외부 HTTP 요청을 유발해 자격 증명 등 민감 정보를 유출할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-77224.background_ko: DomXmlDataFormat.defaultDocumentBuilderFactory()가 application/xml로 직렬화된 객체 변수를 파싱할 때 외부 엔티티 해석을 비활성화하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-100963.description: NVIDIA TensorRT for Linux contains a vulnerability where a user could cause an integer overflow issue. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service and data tampering.
CVE-2026-100963.summary_ko: Linux용 NVIDIA TensorRT에 사용자가 정수 오버플로를 유발할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 악용되면 서비스 거부와 데이터 변조로 이어질 수 있다.

CVE-2026-100970.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the network policy hot-reload component where a local attacker with low privileges could bypass updated network policy restrictions through existing L7-inspected tunnels that continue to use the previous policy after a reload. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.

CVE-2026-100971.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the L7 path allowlist enforcement component where a local attacker with low privileges could cause path traversal by using semicolon-dot path sequences to bypass allowlist restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.
CVE-2026-100971.summary_ko: Linux용 NVIDIA OpenShell의 L7 경로 허용 목록 적용 구성요소에 저권한 로컬 공격자가 제한을 우회해 경로 순회를 유발할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 악용되면 정보 유출, 데이터 변조, 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-100971.background_ko: L7 경로 허용 목록의 제한이 세미콜론과 점을 조합한 경로 표현으로 우회될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-100972.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in resource-level authorization for create, read, update, and delete operations where an authenticated remote attacker with low privileges could access or modify resources without the required authorization checks. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
CVE-2026-100972.summary_ko: Linux용 NVIDIA OpenShell에서 인증된 저권한 원격 공격자가 필요한 인가 검사 없이 리소스에 접근하거나 이를 수정할 수 있다. 악용되면 정보 유출과 데이터 변조로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-100972.background_ko: 리소스 생성·읽기·수정·삭제 작업에 필요한 리소스 단위 인가 검사가 누락되어 있다.

CVE-2026-100973.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in L7 policy enforcement for HTTP CONNECT tunnels where a local attacker with low privileges could cause a protection mechanism failure by using nonstandard HTTP methods to bypass policy restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.

CVE-2026-100974.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the sandbox SSH authentication component where a remote attacker with high privileges could gain unauthorized access to other sandboxes by using an SSH handshake secret shared across sandboxes. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.

CVE-2026-100975.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the Kubernetes sandbox SSH authentication configuration where a local attacker with low privileges could obtain sensitive authentication information by accessing an SSH handshake secret stored in a plaintext environment variable and reuse the shared secret to gain unauthorized access to other sandboxes. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.
CVE-2026-100975.summary_ko: Linux용 NVIDIA OpenShell의 Kubernetes 샌드박스 SSH 인증 설정에 저권한 로컬 공격자가 인증 비밀을 얻어 다른 샌드박스에 무단 접근할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 정보 유출, 데이터 변조, 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-100975.background_ko: SSH 핸드셰이크용 공유 비밀이 평문 환경 변수에 저장되며, 이를 다른 샌드박스 접근에 재사용할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-100976.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in Kubernetes network policy enforcement where a local attacker with low privileges could cause the proxy to attribute network traffic to a different process due to TCP source-port identity confusion, allowing the attacker to bypass process-based network policy restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.

CVE-2026-100977.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in L7 REST policy enforcement where a local attacker with low privileges could exploit inconsistent HTTP interpretation by using cleartext HTTP/2 (h2c) over an HTTP CONNECT tunnel to bypass policy restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.

CVE-2026-100978.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its gateway-to-sandbox transport where a network attacker positioned on the internal path could intercept credentials and tamper with commands and data because the transport accepts any host key without verification, permitting a machine-in-the-middle to impersonate the sandbox endpoint. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and code execution.

CVE-2026-100979.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its gateway connection-proxy component where an attacker who can manipulate a sandbox's status metadata could cause the control-plane server to initiate connections to arbitrary internal hosts because the connection target is derived from that metadata and used without validation against the expected address range. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.

CVE-2026-100980.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its command-line diagnostic interface where an attacker could cause OS command injection because user- or configuration-supplied values are incorporated into a command that is interpreted by two successive shell layers in the remote path while being escaped for only one layer. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.

CVE-2026-100981.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its layer-7 REST proxy where a sandboxed actor could bypass the proxy's policy enforcement by sending a request whose body framing is interpreted differently by the proxy and the upstream server, allowing a second request to be smuggled past policy checks. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to data tampering and information disclosure.

CVE-2026-100982.description: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its inference-interception request parser where a sandboxed actor could exhaust processing resources by sending a chunked request that lacks body-size and chunk-count limits, causing excessive parsing work. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service.

CVE-2026-121590.description: Mattermost Desktop App versions <=6.3 6.0.3 6.3.2.0 fail to validate the SiteURL value returned in a server's client configuration before constructing a server object from it which allows an operator of a server configured in the Desktop app to render the application persistently unusable across restarts via an unparseable SiteURL that triggers an uncaught exception reaching the process-level critical error handler. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00770

CVE-2026-122055.description: ICRTouch PocketTouch version 1.700 build 2025.3726 contains a default socket password set to the literal value password. Where the default value remains unchanged and is accepted by a TouchPoint POS terminal, an attacker with network access to the terminal’s socket service may authenticate using publicly known credentials.

CVE-2026-122122.description: The order-tracking functionality in ICRTouch ByTable and TouchTakeaway does not adequately verify that a requester is authorized to access the specified order. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify an order identifier to retrieve information associated with other customers’ orders.

CVE-2026-122125.description: ICRTouch ByTable and TouchTakeaway do not consistently implement anti-CSRF protections for state-changing web requests. The affected functionality does not require a per-session CSRF token or otherwise verify that requests originated from an authorized application context. An attacker who convinces an authenticated user to visit a malicious website may cause the user’s browser to submit unauthorized requests to the platform using the user’s active session.

CVE-2026-122141.description: The wallet top-up functionality in ICRTouch ByTable and TouchTakeaway does not adequately protect state-changing requests against CSRF. An attacker-controlled website can cause an authenticated customer’s browser to submit a wallet top-up request and add an attacker-selected charge to the customer’s active cart.

CVE-2026-122142.description: ICRTouch Commander administrative login interface does not adequately restrict repeated authentication attempts. The interface also returns distinguishable responses for multiple authentication states, including different behavior when a `siteID` value is supplied.

CVE-2026-122143.description: ICRTouch Commander administrative interface performs security-sensitive operations through HTTP GET requests and includes an API key in the request query string. GET requests are commonly retained in browser history, proxy logs, server logs, analytics systems, referrer headers, and other intermediary records.

CVE-2026-122145.description: ICRTouch PocketTouch version 1.700 build 2025.3726 transmits the POS socket password in plaintext XML over an unencrypted TCP connection. The protocol does not provide transport-layer encryption to protect credentials from interception. An attacker able to observe network traffic between a PocketTouch device and a TouchPoint POS terminal can recover the socket password from captured packets.

CVE-2026-122147.description: ICRTouch PocketTouch version 1.700 build 2025.3726 defines hard-coded default values for multiple credential fields, including a socket password and configuration and shutdown passwords. An additional email-related password field is initialized without a value.
CVE-2026-122147.summary_ko: ICRTouch PocketTouch 1.700 빌드 2025.3726은 소켓·설정·종료 비밀번호 등 여러 자격 증명 필드에 하드코딩된 기본값을 사용한다. 추가 이메일 관련 비밀번호 필드는 값 없이 초기화된다.
CVE-2026-122147.background_ko: 여러 자격 증명 필드의 기본값이 하드코딩되어 있고, 이메일 관련 비밀번호 필드는 값 없이 초기화된다.

CVE-2026-122149.description: The PocketTouch and TouchPoint POS protocol includes a `SAVECONFIG` command that appears capable of overwriting till configuration files remotely. An attacker with network access to the POS socket service may be able to submit a crafted `SAVECONFIG` command and replace or modify terminal configuration data.

CVE-2026-122150.description: The PocketTouch and TouchPoint POS `CHECKPAYMENT` workflow accepts a caller-supplied clerk number without adequately verifying that the requesting client is authorized to act as that clerk. An attacker with access to the POS protocol may be able to specify another employee’s clerk identifier and submit payment-related requests under that identity.

CVE-2026-122152.description: The ICRTouch white-label TouchTakeaway Cordova applications do not implement certificate or public-key pinning for backend HTTPS connections. The applications therefore rely exclusively on the device’s system trust store when validating server certificates. An attacker who can cause a device to trust an attacker-controlled certificate authority, or who operates through a compromised or improperly issued trusted certificate, may be able to intercept and modify application traffic.

CVE-2026-122153.description: The TouchOffice API `clerkList` endpoint appears to return sensitive clerk authentication data, including clerk PINs and iButton serial numbers. If the endpoint is accessible to callers who do not require access to these values, the API exposes reusable authentication material beyond the minimum information necessary for clerk-list functionality.

CVE-2026-65106.description: NVIDIA Transformer Engine for Linux contains a vulnerability where a user could cause deserialization by loading untrusted data. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, information disclosure, and denial of service.
CVE-2026-65106.summary_ko: Linux용 NVIDIA Transformer Engine에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터 로드 시 역직렬화가 발생하는 취약점이 있다. 악용되면 코드 실행, 정보 유출, 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-65106.background_ko: 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터를 로드할 때 역직렬화가 수행된다.

CVE-2026-65167.description: NVIDIA TensorRT contains a vulnerability where a user could cause memory allocation with excessive size value by crafting a malicious TRT engine. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service.

CVE-2026-100968.background_ko: 데이터셋 로딩 과정에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터가 역직렬화된다.

CVE-2026-119726.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in PocketBook / Obreey Products PocketBook Reader (Android) allows Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor. This issue affects PocketBook Reader (Android): 5.65.0.39561.release (com.obreey.reader).

CVE-2026-120287.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Plug.Parsers.MULTIPART in elixir-plug plug allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exhaust memory via a multipart request body built from parts without headers, or from header lines without a name and a value. The parser charges the :length limit only with the name and value bytes of each part header and the bytes of each part body. The part delimiter, the header separator, and the line endings cost nothing. In lib/plug/parsers/multipart.ex, Plug.Parsers.MULTIPART.parse_multipart_headers/5 keeps an entry for every part without a content-disposition header, together with its header list, until the whole body is read. A request made of such parts does not reach the limit at any size, and the parser process holds a multiple of the request size in memory until parsing completes. Any endpoint that uses Plug.Parsers with the :multipart parser is reachable. This issue affects plug: from 1.13.0 before 1.20.4.
CVE-2026-120287.summary_ko: elixir-plug의 Plug.Parsers.MULTIPART에는 자원 할당 제한이 불완전한 취약점이 있다. multipart 파서를 사용하는 엔드포인트에서 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 메모리 고갈을 유발할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120287.background_ko: 크기 제한 계산에서 구분자·줄바꿈 등이 제외되고, Content-Disposition 헤더가 없는 파트의 항목과 헤더 목록을 본문을 모두 읽을 때까지 보관한다.

CVE-2026-126547.background_ko: 기능 접근에 대한 인가가 누락돼 있다.

CVE-2026-126550.summary_ko: Windows·Linux용 Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation의 WCC 모듈에 민감정보 로그 기록 및 자격 증명 보호 미흡 취약점이 있어 세션 ID 재사용을 통한 세션 재전송이 가능하다. 영향 버전은 12.1.00부터 24.2.00까지다.

CVE-2026-126551.summary_ko: Windows·Linux용 Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation의 WCC 모듈에서 하드코딩된 암호화 키를 사용해 세션 자격 증명을 위조할 수 있다. 영향 버전은 12.1부터 24.2.00까지다.

CVE-2026-126553.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation (Workload Control Center (WCC) modules) on Windows, Linux allows Object Injection.This issue affects AutoSys Workload Automation: from 12.1 through 24.0.01.

CVE-2026-129246.description: Due to a Debian-specific patch, the directory used to share data between the LightDM and the users logging in was writable by the lightdm user of the unprivileged greeter process. A process running under the lightdm identity could leverage write access to that directory to force the LightDM process (running as root) to change ownership and permissions on other root-owned directories and escalate privileges from the lightdm user to root.
CVE-2026-129246.summary_ko: Debian 전용 패치가 적용된 LightDM에서 lightdm 계정의 프로세스가 공유 디렉터리 쓰기 권한을 악용할 수 있다. root로 실행되는 LightDM이 다른 root 소유 디렉터리의 소유권과 권한을 변경하도록 유도해 root 권한을 획득할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-130801.description: The device's command parser does not require asymmetric cryptographic signatures to validate incoming APDU packets. This enables an attacker to inject forged, unauthorized commands to manipulate device features and configurations once the initial handshake is bypassed.

CVE-2026-130802.description: The NFC authentication handshake relies on a fixed, static challenge instead of a unique, random value for every session. This allows an attacker to perform a "replay attack," successfully authenticating by simply sending the same pre-recorded response.

CVE-2026-130803.description: The firmware and flash memory store critical cryptographic secrets, such as global AES keys and network master keys, in unencrypted formats. Additionally, active session tokens (Store Pairing Tokens) are written to the flash in plaintext, exposing live network credentials.

CVE-2026-130804.description: The microcontroller lacks enabled debug lock bits, leaving the physical Single-Wire (SWS) debugging interface completely unrestricted. This allows an attacker with physical access to use a hardware programmer to dump the entire production firmware.

CVE-2026-65132.description: NVIDIA Megatron-LM contains a vulnerability in checkpoint loading where an attacker could cause deserialization of untrusted data. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, information disclosure, and data tampering.
CVE-2026-65132.summary_ko: NVIDIA Megatron-LM의 체크포인트 로딩 과정에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터가 역직렬화되는 취약점이 있다. 악용되면 코드 실행, 정보 유출, 데이터 변조로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-65132.background_ko: 체크포인트 로딩 과정에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터가 역직렬화된다.

CVE-2026-67455.description: NVIDIA Model Optimizer for Linux and Windows contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a deserialization of untrusted data. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.
CVE-2026-67455.summary_ko: Linux 및 Windows용 NVIDIA Model Optimizer에는 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 있다. 악용되면 코드 실행, 데이터 변조, 서비스 거부, 정보 노출로 이어질 수 있다.

CVE-2026-104100.description: Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business. Prior to release.2026-07-21T11-27-40Z.2320, a registered user can supply path traversal sequences in the hash field accepted by POST /api/attachments/signature when the default local storage provider is in use. In apps/nestjs-backend/src/features/attachments/plugins/local.ts, LocalStorage.presigned uses the client-controlled hash as the storage filename, and LocalStorage.save resolves that path and copies the uploaded request body without calling assertPathWithinStorage on the write path. The read path uses the jail, but the write path does not, allowing the resolved destination to escape the configured storage directory. Because the backend container runs as uid 0, the attacker can write or overwrite arbitrary root-owned files, which can corrupt the instance or lead to root code execution. Object-storage deployments that do not use LocalStorage.save are not affected by this sink. This issue is fixed in release.2026-07-21T11-27-40Z.2320.
CVE-2026-104100.summary_ko: Teable의 기본 로컬 저장소 구성에서는 등록된 사용자가 경로 순회 취약점으로 root 소유 임의 파일을 쓰거나 덮어쓸 수 있어 인스턴스 손상이나 root 권한 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다. LocalStorage.save를 사용하지 않는 객체 저장소 구성은 이 경로의 영향을 받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-104100.background_ko: 사용자 제어 hash를 파일명으로 쓰면서 쓰기 경로의 저장 디렉터리 이탈을 검사하지 않고, 백엔드 컨테이너가 uid 0으로 실행된다.

CVE-2026-110782.description: The SimpleSAMLphp SAML2 library is a PHP library for SAML2 related functionality. From 6.2.2 until 6.2.4 and 7.0.0-rc2, HTTPArtifact::receive() in src/Binding/HTTPArtifact.php verifies a signed outer ArtifactResponse but returns an unsigned embedded SAML Response before calling verifyMessageSignature(). The signed path verifies with the artifact issuer's metadata keys without requiring the embedded Response issuer to match that artifact issuer. In a multi-IdP federation, an attacker controlling one trusted IdP can therefore return a validly signed outer ArtifactResponse containing an unsigned Response that claims a different IdP, bypassing the binding's embedded-message authentication. End-to-end impersonation requires a service provider using HTTP-Artifact and a downstream consumer that relies on the binding to authenticate the embedded Response rather than independently requiring a signature. This issue is fixed in versions 6.2.4 and 7.0.0-rc2.
CVE-2026-110782.summary_ko: SimpleSAMLphp SAML2 라이브러리의 HTTP-Artifact 처리에서 내장 응답 인증을 우회할 수 있다. 여러 IdP가 연결된 환경에서 신뢰된 IdP를 제어하는 공격자는 내장 응답의 서명을 별도 검증하지 않는 서비스 제공자에서 다른 IdP를 사칭할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-110782.background_ko: 외부 ArtifactResponse의 서명을 확인한 뒤 내장 응답의 서명을 검증하기 전에 반환하며, 서명 검증 경로에서도 내장 응답과 아티팩트 발급자의 일치를 요구하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-21590.description: This High severity Information Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability was introduced in versions 9.12.0, 10.3.0, and 11.3.0 of Jira Software Data Center. This Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 8.7, allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to read files from the Jira web application root. Atlassian recommends that Jira Software Data Center customers upgrade to latest version, if you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions: Jira Software Data Center 9.12: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 9.12.40 Jira Software Data Center 10.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.3.26 Jira Software Data Center 11.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.3.12 See the release notes (https://confluence.atlassian.com/jirasoftware/jira-software-data-center-release-notes.html). You can download the latest version of Jira Software Data Center from the download center (https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/download-archives). This vulnerability was reported via our Bug Bounty program.
CVE-2026-21590.summary_ko: Jira Software Data Center의 경로 탐색 취약점으로 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 Jira 웹 애플리케이션 루트의 파일을 읽을 수 있다. 이 취약점은 9.12.0, 10.3.0, 11.3.0에서 도입됐다.

CVE-2026-21591.description: This High severity PrivEsc (Privilege Escalation) vulnerability was introduced in versions 10.2.0, 11.0.0, 12.0.0, and 12.1.0 of Bamboo Data Center. You can download the latest version of Bamboo Data Center from the download center ([https://www.atlassian.com/software/bamboo/download-archives]). CVE-2026-21592.description: This High severity Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability known as CVE-2026-21592 was introduced in version 4.9.0. The following description summarizes the vulnerability reported via our Penetration Testing program: Crucible do not account for path parameters when validating protected paths requested through the static-resource route. CVE-2026-80322.description: Under specific conditions, PingAuthorize in Gateway mode can continue an asynchronous upstream request after its 30-second gateway timeout. If the underlying keep-alive connection is reused for another request before the original response arrives, the late response can be written to the newer exchange. This could cause a subsequent caller to receive response data intended for an earlier request. This behaviour affects all releases and primarily risks unauthorized information disclosure between separate requests.
CVE-2026-80322.summary_ko: PingAuthorize의 Gateway 모드에서는 특정 조건에서 이전 요청의 응답이 후속 호출자에게 전달돼 요청 간 정보가 무단으로 노출될 수 있다. 이 문제는 모든 릴리스에 영향을 준다.

CVE-2026-84974.description: code16 Sharp is a Laravel-based framework for building content-management and administrative interfaces. Prior to 9.23.0, an authenticated attacker can submit an arbitrary PHP class name through the embed_key parameter to multiple embed API endpoints. The application passes the selected class to the Laravel service container, which invokes the class's __construct() method and recursively instantiates constructor dependencies, potentially causing unauthorized integrity or availability effects. The attacker cannot supply constructor parameter values or invoke an arbitrary method. This issue is fixed in version 9.23.0.

CVE-2026-84987.description: code16 Sharp is a Laravel-based framework for building content-management and administrative interfaces. Prior to 9.23.0, an authenticated attacker can call the autocomplete API with a request endpoint that contains the configured remote endpoint only as a substring. The endpoint validation uses an unanchored regular expression, so a different internal route can satisfy the check and be invoked server-side through the autocomplete request. The vulnerable path uses SharpFormAutocompleteRemoteField::setRemoteEndpoint(); applications using SharpFormAutocompleteRemoteField::setRemoteCallback() are not affected by this endpoint-selection flaw. This issue is fixed in version 9.23.0.

CVE-2026-86061.description: Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business. Prior to release.2026-07-17T05-20-38Z.2264, the routes for PluginService::regenerateSecret and PluginService::delete carry no @Permissions decorator, and the methods omit plugin ownership checks. An authenticated attacker can directly target another plugin's identifier to rotate and disclose its OAuth secret or delete the plugin, including system plugins. Separately, PermissionGuard authorizes several nested API requests using a caller-controlled parent tableId, baseId, or spaceId, while the services resolve the requested child object only by its globally unique identifier. An authenticated attacker can provide a parent resource the attacker owns together with a victim's child identifier. ViewService::getViewById can then disclose another tenant's view configuration, embedded filter values, field layout, and shareId. DashboardService::updatePluginStorage and the view-position updatePluginStorage path can overwrite another tenant's plugin storage because the plugin installation is not rebound to the authorized base, dashboard, table, or view. This issue is fixed in release.2026-07-17T05-20-38Z.2264.
CVE-2026-86061.summary_ko: Teable에서는 인증된 공격자가 다른 플러그인의 OAuth 비밀값을 재발급해 알아내거나 시스템 플러그인을 포함한 다른 플러그인을 삭제할 수 있다. 또한 테넌트 간 권한 검증 문제로 다른 테넌트의 뷰 설정·공유 식별자 등이 노출되거나 플러그인 저장소가 덮어써질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-86061.background_ko: 일부 플러그인 경로에 권한·소유권 검사가 없고, 중첩 API에서 호출자 지정 상위 리소스로 권한을 확인하면서 하위 객체와 플러그인 설치가 그 리소스에 속하는지 확인하지 않는다.

CVE-2024-43361.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.4, detaintPath() in web/includes/functions.php can be bypassed with a PHP stream-wrapper path when sanitizing modal.php input. A remote unauthenticated attacker can submit such a path through the affected input and potentially read unauthorized local files through local file inclusion. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.4.

CVE-2026-104868.description: A maliciously crafted DWG file, when parsed by Autodesk AutoCAD, can trigger an Integer Overflow vulnerability in RLE bitmap decompression, resulting in an undersized heap allocation and subsequent heap buffer overflow. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or potentially execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.
CVE-2026-104868.summary_ko: Autodesk AutoCAD가 악성 DWG 파일을 분석할 때 RLE 비트맵 압축 해제 과정에서 정수 오버플로와 힙 버퍼 오버플로가 발생할 수 있다. 이로 인해 프로그램이 비정상 종료되거나 현재 프로세스 권한으로 임의 코드가 실행될 가능성이 있다.
CVE-2026-104868.background_ko: RLE 비트맵 압축 해제 중 정수 오버플로로 힙 메모리가 필요한 크기보다 작게 할당돼 힙 버퍼 오버플로가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-113781.description: ESP-IDF is the Espressif Internet of Things (IoT) Development Framework. Prior to 5.2.8, 5.3.6, 5.5.6, and 6.0.3, the Bluedroid BLE Mesh GATT server read handler bt_mesh_bta_gatts_cb in esp_ble_mesh stores a signed attribute-read callback length in an unsigned 16-bit variable. A negative ATT error code is therefore interpreted as a very large successful length and used for a memory copy from a small stack buffer into the GATT response structure. A remote attacker within Bluetooth LE range who can connect to an exposed PB-GATT provisioning or Mesh Proxy service can trigger a failed attribute read with a crafted request. On devices where the affected attributes are accessible without pairing, exploitation requires neither pairing nor user interaction; access requirements depend on device configuration. The resulting out-of-bounds read and stack-based buffer overflow corrupts the Bluetooth host task stack, causing a crash and device restart and potentially further memory corruption. The issue affects devices built with CONFIG_BT_BLUEDROID_ENABLED=y and BLE Mesh GATT enabled; the NimBLE host path is not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 5.2.8, 5.3.6, 5.5.6, and 6.0.3.
CVE-2026-113781.summary_ko: Espressif ESP-IDF의 Bluedroid BLE Mesh GATT 서버에 범위 밖 읽기와 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. Bluetooth LE 범위 내에서 노출된 서비스에 연결 가능한 원격 공격자가 악용하면 충돌, 기기 재시작 및 추가 메모리 손상이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-113781.background_ko: 부호 있는 속성 읽기 길이를 부호 없는 16비트 변수에 저장해 음수 ATT 오류 코드가 큰 길이로 해석되고, 이 값이 메모리 복사에 사용된다.

CVE-2026-119793.description: libp2p is a JavaScript implementation of the libp2p networking stack. Prior to 17.0.0, the @libp2p/gossipsub default configuration allows a connected remote peer to submit unsigned subscription RPC metadata for arbitrarily many distinct topic strings. handleReceivedSubscription in packages/gossipsub/src/gossipsub.ts creates a persistent topics-map entry for each accepted topic, while allowedTopics is unset by default, decodeRpc maxSubscriptions limits only one RPC rather than aggregate topic bytes, and peer scoring has no subscription-volume penalty. A single peer can therefore grow the topics map and committed heap toward out-of-memory conditions, and disconnecting additionally causes removePeer to scan all accumulated topic entries. This issue is fixed in version 17.0.0.
CVE-2026-119793.summary_ko: JavaScript libp2p의 @libp2p/gossipsub 기본 설정에서는 연결된 원격 피어 하나가 토픽 맵과 힙 메모리를 계속 늘려 메모리 고갈을 유발할 수 있다. 연결 해제 시에도 누적된 모든 토픽 항목을 순회한다.
CVE-2026-119793.background_ko: 수락한 토픽을 지속 보관하지만 기본 토픽 허용 목록이 없고, 구독 제한은 RPC별로만 적용되며 누적 토픽 바이트 제한이나 구독량에 따른 피어 점수 감점이 없다.

CVE-2026-130621.description: A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the local port selection in AWS efs-utils (amazon-efs-utils) before 3.3.5 might allow a user that can start EFS mounts on a shared host to read and write a different Amazon EFS or S3 Files file system that is mounted on that same host, under that mount's IAM identity and access point, via concurrent mount operations. Only file systems mounted on the same host at the same time can be affected. Every mount involved was configured by the owner of that host, using credentials and access points that owner controls, against file systems whose owners had already granted that host access, so the issue grants no access beyond what the host was already permitted and does not cross AWS account boundaries unless the host's owner configured a cross-account mount. The practical risk is lateral access between workloads on the same host at the same time, for example one container reading another container's file system under that container's identity. The issue does not expose the other mount's IAM credentials or TLS session keys. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade amazon-efs-utils to version 3.3.5 or later. Users of the Amazon EFS CSI Driver should upgrade to version 3.5.4 or later, and users of the Amazon EKS EFS CSI add-on should update to v3.5.4-eksbuild.1 or later.
CVE-2026-130621.summary_ko: AWS efs-utils의 경쟁 상태로, 공유 호스트에서 EFS 마운트를 시작할 수 있는 사용자가 동시에 마운트된 다른 EFS 또는 S3 Files 파일 시스템을 해당 마운트의 권한으로 읽고 쓸 수 있다. 영향은 같은 호스트의 동시 마운트 사이로 제한되며 호스트에 이미 허용된 접근 범위를 넘지 않는다.
CVE-2026-130621.background_ko: 로컬 포트 선택 과정에 검사 시점과 사용 시점 사이의 경쟁 상태(TOCTOU)가 존재한다.

CVE-2026-16780.description: A maliciously crafted DXF file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force a Heap-Based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-18826.description: A maliciously crafted DXF file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force a Type Confusion vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-18827.description: A maliciously crafted DWG file containing an attacker-controlled Excel Data Link connection string, when processed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can cause AutoCAD to execute an attacker-controlled program. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.
CVE-2026-18827.summary_ko: Autodesk AutoCAD가 공격자 제어 Excel Data Link 연결 문자열이 포함된 악성 DWG 파일을 처리하면 공격자가 지정한 프로그램이 실행될 수 있다. 이를 통해 현재 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-18827.background_ko: DWG 파일에 포함된 공격자 제어 Excel Data Link 연결 문자열이 AutoCAD에서 공격자가 지정한 프로그램 실행으로 이어진다.

CVE-2026-28273.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.4, any authenticated user can use the /api/configs/edit/{name}.json endpoint to modify protected configuration settings because ConfigsController::edit() does not enforce the System=Edit authorization requirement and its system-variable protection is ineffective. An attacker can set ZM_PATH_FFMPEG to a command-bearing value and trigger an exec() sink in web/views/image.php or web/includes/Event.php by requesting frame extraction. This permits arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the web server user and can expose private camera feeds, recordings, and database data or establish persistence. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.4.
CVE-2026-28273.summary_ko: ZoneMinder에서는 인증된 사용자가 보호된 설정을 변경해 웹 서버 사용자 권한으로 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다. 이로 인해 비공개 카메라 영상·녹화물·데이터베이스 데이터가 노출되거나 지속적인 접근 수단이 마련될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-28273.background_ko: ConfigsController::edit()가 System=Edit 권한 요건을 강제하지 않고 시스템 변수 보호도 제대로 작동하지 않아, 명령 실행에 쓰이는 설정을 변경할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-62267.description: matrix-hookshot is a Matrix bot for connecting to external services like GitHub, GitLab, JIRA, and more. Prior to 7.3.3, Hookshot can crash in src/Bridge.ts while processing a modern Matrix reply whose m.relates_to.m.in_reply_to.event_id identifies an event that the bot cannot read. Bridge event handling calls botClient.getEvent() for the parent event without catching the resulting M_NOT_FOUND error, allowing the rejected request to escape reply processing and terminate the service. This issue is fixed in version 7.3.3.

CVE-2026-69241.description: Filament Curator is a media picker plugin for Filament panels. From 3.0.0 until 3.7.9, 4.1.2, and 5.1.2, the Curator media panel accepts image/svg+xml files by default and stores and serves their markup inline without sanitization. An authenticated user with media-upload permission can store an SVG containing scripts, event-handler attributes, or javascript: URIs. When another panel user selects the View action, the SVG opens as a top-level browser document and its active content executes in the Filament application's origin. The script can perform authenticated same-origin actions as the viewing user and read same-origin data and script-accessible tokens. Panel thumbnails are not affected because they render through an image element that does not execute SVG script. This issue is fixed in versions 3.7.9, 4.1.2, and 5.1.2.

CVE-2026-77940.description: A maliciously crafted DWG file containing an attacker-controlled network path, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Information Disclosure vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to disclose NTLM authentication information from the current user.

CVE-2026-77941.description: A maliciously crafted DWG or DXF file containing an external reference with an attacker-controlled network path, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Information Disclosure vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to disclose NTLM authentication information from the current user.

CVE-2026-77942.description: A maliciously crafted IES file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Out-of-Bounds Write vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-77943.description: A maliciously crafted DXF file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Out-of-Bounds Write vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-77944.description: A maliciously crafted DXF file containing a scene-background object with an attacker-controlled network path, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Information Disclosure vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to disclose NTLM authentication information from the current user.

CVE-2026-84855.description: A maliciously crafted DGN file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force a Heap-Based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-85646.description: A maliciously crafted DWF file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force a Heap-Based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-85647.description: A maliciously crafted DWG file containing a malformed embedded image, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force a Heap-Based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-85648.description: A maliciously crafted DDS file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force a Heap-Based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

CVE-2026-93297.description: A maliciously crafted DWG or DXF file containing a crafted field format string, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Out-of-Bounds Read vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to read sensitive data from process memory.

CVE-2026-93298.description: A maliciously crafted DXF file containing crafted VBA project data, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Out-of-Bounds Read vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to read sensitive data from process memory.

CVE-2026-93299.description: A maliciously crafted DWG file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD or processed by the installed DWG thumbnail handler, can force an Out-of-Bounds Write vulnerability resulting in heap corruption. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.
CVE-2026-93299.summary_ko: Autodesk AutoCAD 또는 설치된 DWG 썸네일 처리기가 악성 DWG 파일을 처리할 때 범위 밖 쓰기로 힙이 손상될 수 있다. 공격자는 이를 악용해 충돌을 일으키거나 현재 프로세스의 실행 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-95849.description: Linkwarden is a self-hosted, open-source collaborative bookmark manager to collect, organize and archive webpages. Prior to 2.15.0, .github/workflows/check-branch.yml runs on the privileged pull_request_target event and interpolates the attacker-controlled github.head_ref source branch name unquoted into a run: shell script. An unauthenticated attacker can open a pull request from a fork with shell metacharacters in its branch name, causing arbitrary commands to execute in the base repository's privileged CI job before the branch comparison result matters. The job has access to GITHUB_TOKEN and any exposed secrets, allowing secret exfiltration and, when workflow token permissions allow repository writes, modification of repository content. This issue is fixed in version 2.15.0.

CVE-2026-100397.description: Rucio is a scientific data management framework. From 1.14.0 until 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1, validate_auth_token in lib/rucio/core/authentication.py does not distinguish short-lived SSH challenge nonces from authentication tokens stored in the same token table. An unauthenticated attacker can request /auth/ssh_challenge_token for an arbitrary account by supplying X-Rucio-Account, then present the returned X-Rucio-SSH-Challenge-Token as X-Rucio-Auth-Token to authenticate to other API endpoints as that account, including an administrative account. This issue is fixed in versions 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1.

CVE-2026-107853.description: tiny-secp256k1 is a tiny secp256k1 native/JS wrapper. From 2.1.0 until 2.2.5 for tiny-secp256k1 and from 2.2.2 until 2.2.5 for @bitcoin-js/tiny-secp256k1-asmjs, the three-argument xOnlyPointAddTweakCheck path ignores the backend failure return from xOnlyPointAddTweak when a tweak produces the point at infinity. The shared X_ONLY_PUBLIC_KEY_INPUT buffer then still contains the original point, so a caller-controlled resultToCheck equal to that point can make the stale-buffer comparison return true even though no tweaked key exists. Protocols that rely on this helper to validate caller-controlled internal keys, tweaks, and comparison values can accept an invalid derived key. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.5.

CVE-2026-110789.description: libp2p is a JavaScript implementation of the libp2p networking stack. Prior to 5.1.22, the @libp2p/crypto code reached by the default Identify service accepts a remote peer’s crafted publicKey before peer-id or signature verification and passes it through publicKeyFromProtobuf to the ASN.1 DER decoder. readLength in packages/crypto/src/keys/rsa/der.ts accepts long-form element lengths larger than the remaining buffer, causing readInteger and related readers to loop synchronously over an attacker-claimed length from a very small key blob. Because decoding occurs in one event-loop tick before the remotePeer equality check in packages/protocol-identify/src/identify.ts, the Identify timeout cannot interrupt it, allowing repeated unauthenticated connections to stall all timers and peers and transiently exhaust memory. This issue is fixed in version 5.1.22.

CVE-2026-119192.description: Forge, also called node-forge, is a native implementation of Transport Layer Security in JavaScript. Prior to 1.4.1, publicKey.verify() with the default RSASSA-PKCS1-V1_5 scheme in lib/rsa.js parses the recovered DigestInfo with the lenient BER parser asn1.fromDer() and validates its structure with digestInfoValidator without requiring canonical DER bytes. Non-minimal or indefinite lengths, malformed parameter values, and non-canonical object identifier encodings with padded subidentifiers or trailing bytes can leave attacker-controlled data inside an accepted DigestInfo. When the verifying RSA public key uses a low exponent such as e=3, an attacker can use that encoding slack to forge a signature without the private key. The same path is used by X.509 certificate and PKCS#7 signature verification. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.1.

CVE-2026-119292.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.2, after FreeSWITCH has learned and closed source learning for an RTP peer, read_rtp_packet() and rtp_common_read() in src/switch_rtp.c reject RTP from an unrecognized source only after packet classification and, for encrypted calls, SRTP processing. An unauthenticated attacker with UDP reachability to an active RTP or SRTP media port can sustain a foreign-source packet flood that occupies the media read path and prevents legitimate media from entering FreeSWITCH on calls that consume incoming media for relay or echo. The resulting one-way audio allows the affected endpoint to continue hearing the other party, but the other party loses that endpoint's audio, leaving SIP signaling established while the call is unusable for conversation. Transmit-only playback was unaffected in testing. A caller can learn the media port from the SDP answer, while a third party must first discover an active port, and no valid SRTP key is required. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.2.

CVE-2026-119293.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. In 1.11.2 and earlier, rtp_common_read() in src/switch_rtp.c uses one session-wide autoadj_tally to learn RTP sources that differ from the address negotiated in SDP. An unauthenticated remote attacker who sends plaintext RTP during call setup can make packets from one or more non-advertised sources reach the threshold before the legitimate endpoint, causing FreeSWITCH to adopt the source of the threshold-crossing packet as the media peer. The attacker can then receive call audio, inject media, and deny media to the legitimate endpoint without being on the media path. FreeSWITCH 1.11.2 adds two opt-in controls, but both default to zero and the release remains affected unless both are configured before RTP session creation. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.11.2.

CVE-2026-121707.description: Effect is a TypeScript framework that consists of several packages that work together to help build TypeScript applications. Prior to 3.22.1, Schema.TemplateLiteral schemas containing at least two Schema.String spans compile each span to the ambiguous lazy wildcard [\s\S]*?. Decoding a non-matching untrusted string causes cubic regular expression backtracking, which can block the JavaScript event loop. The issue affects Schema.decodeUnknown, Schema.decodeUnknownSync, Schema.is, and consumers such as HttpApi and @effect/rpc payload decoding. This issue is fixed in version 3.22.1.

CVE-2026-121716.description: fzf is a command-line fuzzy finder. Prior to 0.74.5, bin/fzf-tmux validates separately supplied layout sizes but does not validate attached -l and -u layout values before Bash arithmetic expansion, allowing command substitution in a crafted operand to execute as the invoking user during option parsing. The same validation failure lets space-bearing popup geometry options -x, -y, -w, -h, and -p reach an unquoted tmux popup option string and inject additional tmux flags. Exploitation requires less-trusted project configuration, a wrapper, or a plugin to supply the poisoned value and requires the victim to invoke fzf-tmux; normal values are usually trusted, and the script has been superseded by built-in tmux options. This issue is fixed in version 0.74.5.

CVE-2026-121717.description: fzf is a command-line fuzzy finder. Prior to 0.74.5, trigger-driven zsh completion in shell/completion.zsh uses _fzf_feed_fifo to create a FIFO at the predictable shared path ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fzf-complete-fifo-$$ and continues after removal or creation errors. On a multi-user host, a local attacker can pre-create that path as a symlink so the victim's completion stream overwrites a victim-writable file, potentially enabling code execution when that file is later sourced. A pre-created FIFO can instead disclose a bounded stream of completion candidates or block completion. On default modern hosts, fs.protected_symlinks blocks the overwrite variant, and protected_fifos and protected_regular further limit the FIFO disclosure and blocking variants, so exploitation depends on the relevant kernel protections being disabled and on the victim invoking the affected completion. This issue is fixed in version 0.74.5.

CVE-2026-123351.description: HomeBox is a home inventory and organization system. Prior to 0.27.0, the unauthenticated GET /swagger/doc.json endpoint copies the client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host header into the OpenAPI host field without requiring a trusted proxy or validating the value. An attacker can therefore make the served OpenAPI document direct Swagger UI Try it out requests to an attacker-controlled host. When a shared cache or CDN stores and serves that poisoned document to an authenticated user, Swagger UI sends the user's API requests and bearer token to the attacker, enabling disclosure and modification of the user's HomeBox data. Without a shared cache, the attacker can affect only the attacker's own response. This issue is fixed in version 0.27.0.

CVE-2026-123352.description: HomeBox is a home inventory and organization system. Prior to 0.27.0, a HomeBox password change revokes the user's other session tokens but does not revoke the user's API keys, and API keys have no default API-key expiration. An attacker who has obtained an API key can therefore retain full API-level access after the account owner changes the password and can keep that access indefinitely unless the owner discovers and manually deletes the key by ID. Because the password change terminates other sessions, the surviving API credential can evade the owner's expected containment and detection. This issue is fixed in version 0.27.0.

CVE-2026-127220.description: Kadence Security plugin for WordPress (better-wp-security) before 10.0.6.1 contains a brute-force protection bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade per-host login lockouts by exploiting IPv6 address handling in ITSEC_Lib::get_ip(), which keys failed-login counters on the full 128-bit IPv6 address rather than a /64 prefix. Attackers who control a routed IPv6 /64 can send each login attempt from a new address within that prefix, resetting the per-host counter each time to perform password spraying and username enumeration, and can similarly evade the auto_ban_admin immediate ban via address rotation.

CVE-2026-127221.description: WPS Limit Login (wps-limit-login) before 1.5.9.5 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass login lockout protections by keying the per-attempt login counter and lockout map on the raw, non-canonicalized IPv6 client address. Attackers controlling a routable IPv6 /64 prefix can send each login attempt from a fresh address within that range, preventing any counter from reaching the lockout threshold and enabling effectively unlimited brute-force password guessing against WordPress accounts.

CVE-2026-128073.description: gosaml2 is a Pure Go implementation of SAML 2.0. Prior to 0.12.0, ValidateEncodedResponse() calls decryptAssertions() on an EncryptedAssertion before signature or content validation completes, and EncryptedAssertion.DecryptBytes() in types/encrypted_assertion.go slices decoded ciphertext without first validating the required nonce or initialization-vector length. A CipherValue shorter than the 12-byte AES-GCM nonce causes a slice-bounds panic, and an empty AES-CBC CipherValue passes the modulo block-size check before causing a slice-bounds panic at the 16-byte initialization-vector split. An attacker needs only the service provider's public certificate to wrap a symmetric key, and no valid identity-provider signature or relationship is required. The unrecovered panic can terminate the request goroutine or the service process. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.0.

CVE-2026-130622.description: Incorrect authorization in the credential loading logic in AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes (aws-privateca-issuer) before 1.12.0 might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to create namespace-scoped issuers to obtain certificates, including subordinate CA certificates, signed by another namespace's AWS Private CA with that namespace's stored AWS credentials, via a namespace-scoped issuer that references a credentials Secret in that namespace. To remediate this issue, users should first copy any credentials Secret they intend a namespace-scoped issuer to use into that issuer's namespace and update the issuer's secretRef.namespace to match. Then, upgrade aws-privateca-issuer to version 1.12.0 or the AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes EKS add-on to version v1.12.0-eksbuild.1.

CVE-2026-130623.description: Incorrect authorization in the credential handling for namespace-scoped issuers in AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes (aws-privateca-issuer) before 1.12.0 might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to create namespace-scoped issuers to obtain certificates, including subordinate CA certificates, from every AWS Private CA and certificate template reachable by the controller's own AWS identity or by any IAM role that identity can assume. This happens because a namespace-scoped issuer that supplies no credentials, or sets only a role, falls back to the controller's own identity. To remediate this issue, users should first update any namespace-scoped issuers that rely on the controller's identity to use their own credentials. Then, upgrade aws-privateca-issuer to version 1.12.0 or the AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes EKS add-on to version v1.12.0-eksbuild.1.

CVE-2026-130792.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow in gf_xml_sax_parse_intern() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that causes a heap-based buffer overflow when completing partially buffered entities. Attackers can convince a user to process a crafted XML or XMT file with MP4Box, overflowing xml_sax_append_string() size arithmetic to corrupt heap memory and crash the process.

CVE-2026-130793.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in gf_filter_pid_resolve_file_template_ex() in src/filter_core/filter_pid.c that allows local attackers to write past fixed GF_MAX_PATH stack buffers. Attackers can convince a user to segment a crafted NHML input referencing an overly long media file name with MP4Box -dash to crash the process.

CVE-2026-130794.description: Frappe HR (hrms) before 16.9.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the hrms.api.roster.get_events method that allows authenticated employees to view other employees' leave and shift data by bypassing User Permissions. Attackers with the Employee role can call get_events with empty filters for any date range to retrieve every employee's approved leave applications and shift assignments, including leave types, dates, shift locations and times.

CVE-2026-130795.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows local attackers to corrupt memory by supplying unbalanced command buffer closing elements. Attackers can convince a user to open a crafted XMT-A file with MP4Box, causing xmt_node_end() to treat a GF_Command as an SFCommandBuffer and crash the process.

CVE-2026-130796.description: Flowise 3.1.3 through 3.1.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read MCP server bearer tokens via the GET /api/v1/public-chatflows/:id handler. Attackers can use the leaked mcpServerConfig token on the POST /api/v1/mcp/:chatflowId route to invoke chatflows, bypassing API key protection and consuming the owner's model quota.

CVE-2026-130797.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in xmt_parse_element() that allows local attackers to corrupt memory by supplying duplicate PROTO field names. Attackers can trick a user into opening a crafted XMT file with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_sf_field() to write through an uninitialized pointer and crash the process.

CVE-2026-130798.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that leaves dangling MFURL pointers when xmt_node_end() discards nodes. Attackers can convince a user to open a crafted XMT file with MP4Box, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to access freed heap memory and crash the process.

CVE-2026-130799.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_parse_element() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that frees a node when a DEF attribute names a previously referenced undefined node. Attackers can convince a user to process a crafted XMT file with MP4Box, causing freed heap memory to be used and crashing the process.

CVE-2026-130829.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_new_od_link_from_node() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash the process. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file with an MFURL object-descriptor link lacking an OD ID and name, crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

CVE-2026-130830.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in load_xmt_done() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that releases references for duplicate node stack entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT-A scene file encoded with MP4Box to crash the process and potentially corrupt heap memory.

CVE-2026-130831.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_parse_element() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying XMT-A elements that define and use the same node identifier. Attackers can craft an XMT scene file processed by MP4Box so xmt_text_content() accesses the freed node, crashing the process and possibly corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-130832.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_element() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash the process via ROUTE elements. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT-A scene file placing a ROUTE element before any scene command creates an access unit, crashing MP4Box during encoding and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-130833.description: Phoboslab pl_mpeg through commit c871f2b contains an integer underflow in plm_demux_seek() that allows attackers to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads via crafted MPEG-PS files. Attackers can supply a PES packet with payload under 6 bytes, wrapping the packet->length - 6 loop bound during force_intra seeking to crash applications.

CVE-2026-130834.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to access freed memory via a dangling command buffer pointer. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file whose Replace command frees a Conditional node, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting the heap.

CVE-2026-130835.description: Storyden before 1.26.17 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AccountRemoveRole handler that allows non-administrator users with MANAGE_ROLES to remove administrator roles. Attackers can send DELETE requests to the account roles endpoint to demote other administrators, potentially leaving the instance with no administrator.

CVE-2026-130836.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an invalid pointer free vulnerability in gf_sg_command_del() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that allows attackers to corrupt the heap via crafted XMT scene files. Attackers can supply an XMT-A file whose command field_ptr references the embedded new_node member, causing free() on an interior address and crashing MP4Box.

CVE-2026-130837.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xmt_parse_mf_field() in loader_xmt.c caused by unchecked cursor advancement when splitting multi-value XMT-A fields. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file opened with MP4Box to make xmt_parse_string() read past the heap buffer and crash the process.

CVE-2026-130838.description: Radicale 3.3.0 before 3.8.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inherit group-based rights by reusing group memberships never reset between requests. Attackers can send credential-less requests after a group member logs in to read and write group-shared calendar and address book collections evaluated by the from_file rights backend.

CVE-2026-130839.description: ModelScope 1.11.0 to before 1.40.1 contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability in the image-to-3D SyncDreamer pipeline that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted model configuration. Attackers can publish a model whose syncdreamer.yaml target field makes instantiate_from_config() import and instantiate any class with controlled params, without an allowlist or trust_remote_code check, executing code when victims load it.

CVE-2026-130840.description: BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to impersonate administrators by abusing a hard-coded default jwt_secret used by AuthJwt. Attackers can forge an HS256 token offline naming user_id 1 with the admin role, send it as access_token_cookie, and gain full administrative access to users, workspaces, knowledge bases and workflows.

CVE-2026-130841.description: ioBroker.lovelace before 7.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the onCards() request handler that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files via unsanitized dot-dot segments. Attackers can send crafted requests to the /cards/_static_/, /hacsfiles/, or /local/custom_ui/ routes to read files including ioBroker configuration and stored credentials.

CVE-2026-130842.description: HyperFrames before 0.8.73 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Studio server waveform and thumbnail routes that percent-decode paths without containment checks. Unauthenticated attackers, including script in a malicious composition, can send encoded ../ sequences to probe file existence and extract waveform data from files outside the project.

CVE-2026-130843.description: HyperFrames before 0.9.30 contains a missing Origin and Host validation vulnerability in the unauthenticated Studio API that allows malicious web pages to write project files. Attackers can send CORS-simple POST requests to /api/projects/:id/files/* or use DNS rebinding to plant package.json scripts or agent configs, leading to command execution.

CVE-2026-130844.description: HyperFrames before 0.8.216 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the engine URL downloader because isBlockedHost() only checks IP literals and never resolves DNS host names. Attackers can supply compositions with remote media, image or font URLs whose host names resolve to private addresses, making preview or render processes send HTTPS requests to internal services.

CVE-2026-130845.description: CodeIgniter4 before 4.7.5 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the View Parser (system/View/Parser.php) that allows attackers to bypass auto-escaping through re-scanned substitutions. Attackers controlling one rendered value can inject Parser syntax like {other|raw} or {!other!} to emit unescaped attacker-controlled values, executing scripts in viewers' browsers.

CVE-2026-130846.description: AppFlowy-Web before 0.20.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the TextareaAutosize component that allows workspace members with edit access to inject markup by copying unescaped values into a hidden mirror via innerHTML. Attackers can store a database row title or checklist task containing an element with an event handler to execute script in browsers of users opening the row, including unauthenticated published page visitors.

CVE-2026-130847.description: Dolibarr ERP CRM before 24.0.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the Users REST API put() method that allows non-admin API users to set administrator passwords. Authenticated users with user modification and password rights can send a PUT request to the users endpoint with a chosen pass value for a SuperAdmin account and then log in as that administrator.

CVE-2026-130848.description: Dolibarr ERP CRM through 24.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability in Website::importWebSite() that allows website editors without PHP permission to execute code by importing templates. Attackers can import a template zip whose javascript.js.php contains PHP code, which the public javascript.js.php endpoint includes, executing code as the web server user.

CVE-2026-130849.description: BZFlag bzfs before 2.4.32 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in NetHandler::tcpReceive() that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a TCP message with a body length of exactly 1024. Attackers can overwrite the tcplen receive offset with a negative value to write controlled bytes before the buffer, crashing the server or executing commands as the bzfs user.

CVE-2026-130850.description: LaraCollab through 0.18.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated client-role users to inject script by posting unsanitized task comments rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Attackers can post malicious comments that execute when users, including administrators, open the task or view dashboard recent comments, allowing actions in their session.

CVE-2026-130851.description: wishthis through 1.2.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in User::ownsWishlist() that allows authenticated users to modify other users' wishes and wishlists. Attackers can supply sequential wish_id and wishlist_id values to the wishes and wishlists API handlers to edit wishes, add wishes, or rename and delete wishlists.

CVE-2026-130852.description: wishthis through 1.2.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT branch of src/api/wishes.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify wish URLs across all users. Attackers who know a wish link from a public wishlist can supply wish_url_current and wish_url_proposed parameters to redirect owners and gift-givers to attacker-controlled URLs.

CVE-2026-130853.description: Nexterm through 1.2.2-BETA contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows users with permissions.manage to gain unauthorized permissions because addGroupMember and setUserGroups lack the grantsBeyondCaller check. Attackers can add their own account to custom groups via the group membership endpoints to inherit permissions like users.impersonate and settings.backup.

CVE-2026-130854.description: AudioBookRequest 1.9.0 through 2.0.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject script through manual book request fields due to disabled Jinja2 autoescaping. Attackers can submit malicious title, author, narrator or info values via POST /api/requests/manual to execute script in an administrator's browser and access admin-only endpoints.

CVE-2026-130855.description: Bonsai through 6.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to access admin pages because AdminAuthHandler accepts both Administrator and Editor roles. Attackers can use UsersController and DynamicConfigController to reset administrator passwords, promote accounts to Administrator, and change global settings to take over the instance.

CVE-2026-130856.description: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to reinitialize installed instances by calling the public POST /api/init endpoint. Attackers can reset an existing account's password, assign the top creator role, and obtain an access token to take over accounts and use admin-only API routes.

CVE-2026-130857.description: EveryDocs Core before 1.6.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' records through unscoped Model.find(params[:id]) lookups in multiple controllers. Self-registered attackers can enumerate sequential ids to read, modify, or delete other users' documents and stored files, and rename or delete their folders, tags and people.

CVE-2026-130858.description: FS PBX through 2.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in FaxesController, PaymentGatewayController and VirtualReceptionistController API routes that only check authentication. Any authenticated user can delete other tenants' fax records by UUID, deactivate or modify the platform-wide payment gateway, and change another tenant's IVR greeting.

CVE-2026-130859.description: Habitat through 1.7.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in CreatePostController::addAttachmentsToPost() that allows authenticated users to claim other users' unposted image uploads. Email-verified attackers can submit sequential attachmentIds when creating a post to attach another user's pending image, exposing it publicly and removing it from the uploader's post.

CVE-2026-130860.description: Flagr before 1.2.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access the flag management write API through an insecure default FLAGR_BASIC_AUTH_WHITELIST_PATHS including /api/v1/flags. Because basicAuth.whitelist() in pkg/config/middleware.go matches only path prefixes regardless of HTTP method, attackers can create, modify, enable, disable, and delete flags, variants, segments, constraints, and distributions.

CVE-2026-130861.description: UrlHub before 1.20.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create accounts via the POST /admin/user/store route because role:admin middleware only covers view and create actions. Attackers, including self-registered users, can submit a request with role=admin to create an administrator account and gain full administrative control.

CVE-2026-130862.description: BeikeShop through 2.0.0.32 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered customers to inject script by submitting an unsanitized RMA comment rendered unescaped in mail templates. Attackers can submit a return request with malicious script saved to mail_logs.content, executing in an administrator's browser session when they view the Mail Logs entry.

CVE-2026-130863.description: ArtisanCloud PowerX through 1.0.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the IAM role management API that allows authenticated tenant members to escalate privileges. CVE-2026-130864.description: Coyote before commit d6e8fb9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Wiki\CommentController::save that allows authenticated users to edit other users' wiki comments. CVE-2026-130873.description: ep3-bs through 1.9.1b contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows staff users with only user management privilege to delete administrator accounts.
