CVE-2026-130874.description: Seerr before 3.5.2 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust disk space through unnormalized /imageproxy cache keys. Attackers can request the same TMDB image using many equivalent dot-segment path spellings, storing unlimited duplicate copies that fill the shared SQLite configuration volume and break logins and requests.

CVE-2026-130875.description: tac_plus-ng before commit d8493e0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows clients holding the TACACS+ shared key to overflow a stack buffer due to an operator precedence error in author_pak_looks_bogus() and accounting_pak_looks_bogus(). Attackers can send packets whose argument-length table exceeds the payload, causing eval_args() to read past the packet and memcpy() oversized cmd values into cmdline, crashing the daemon or executing code.

CVE-2026-77433.description: Kiwi TCMS is an open source test management system. From 16.1 until 16.2, the account confirmation page’s incomplete validation of the next parameter accepts protocol-relative URLs because the version 16.1 fix for CVE-2026-54724 only requires the value to start with a slash. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a confirmation URL on a trusted Kiwi TCMS hostname that redirects a user to an external site, enabling phishing and related downstream confidentiality or integrity impacts when the user follows the link. Attackers with Author or Editor roles can send requests to logo-upload.php or logo-remove.php under /admin/ajax/ to replace the site logo with an uploaded image or delete it.

CVE-2026-95822.description: The SOCKS5 client in subsys/net/lib/socks/socks.c built the CONNECT request in socks5_tcp_connect() by choosing the SOCKS5 address type from the address family of the proxy (proxy->sa_family) while reading the bytes out of the destination address supplied to connect(). A SOCKS5 request encodes the destination independently of the transport used to reach the proxy, so the two families are unrelated and nothing in the path forces them to agree: set_context_proxy() only requires the proxy family to match the socket, and zsock_connect_ctx() enters the SOCKS branch before any destination validation. With an IPv6 proxy and an AF_INET destination the code treated an 8-byte struct net_sockaddr_in as a struct net_sockaddr_in6 and copied the 16-byte sin6_addr from it, reading 12 bytes past the end of the object and transmitting them to the proxy. With CONFIG_USERSPACE enabled, z_vrfy_zsock_connect() copies only addrlen user bytes into a stack-resident struct net_sockaddr_storage and enforces no per-family minimum length, so the oversized read stays within the storage but returns stale, uninitialised kernel-stack bytes. An unprivileged user-mode thread can therefore open an AF_INET6 stream socket, point setsockopt(SO_SOCKS5) at a proxy it controls, and call connect() with a short AF_INET destination to have the kernel send it 12 bytes of supervisor stack residue per attempt. Without CONFIG_USERSPACE the read runs past the end of the caller's own struct net_sockaddr_in, disclosing adjacent memory to the proxy; the family mismatch can arise unintentionally when a destination is obtained from DNS while an IPv6 proxy is configured. Impact is limited to information disclosure of at most 12 bytes per connect() call, with no write primitive; the leak is delivered to whoever operates the SOCKS5 proxy. The mirrored pairing (IPv6 destination through an IPv4 proxy) is memory-safe but encoded the destination as SOCKS5_ATYP_IPV4 from the first four bytes of the IPv6 address, causing the proxy to connect to an unrelated host. Exploitation requires the non-default CONFIG_SOCKS option, a socket with SO_SOCKS5 configured, and both IPv4 and IPv6 support in the image. The fix moves the encoding into a helper that selects the address type from dest->sa_family and validates dest_len against the matching struct net_sockaddr_in/struct net_sockaddr_in6 before copying, rejecting under-length or unsupported destinations with an error.

CVE-2026-97698.description: Mistune is a Python Markdown parser with renderers and plugins. Prior to 3.3.4, parse_link_href performs an unbounded parenthesis-balancing scan to the end of the document for each unmatched opening parenthesis reached through an empty [] link label. In src/mistune/helpers.py and src/mistune/inline_parser.py, the empty label bypasses no_close_bracket_before, and no_link_before advances only past the short label, so successive [] ( candidates repeatedly scan the remaining document. Rendering untrusted Markdown with the default HTML renderer and no plugins can perform quadratic CPU work and keep a worker at 100 percent utilization. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.

CVE-2026-97699.description: Mistune is a Python Markdown parser with renderers and plugins. Prior to 3.3.4, inline image parsing sends nested ![ openers through precedence_scan because the no_link_before and _label_contains_link linearization guards are gated by not is_image. In src/mistune/inline_parser.py, each outer image opener can therefore search the remaining image body, while max_image_depth does not apply because the failed scans do not produce image tokens. Rendering untrusted Markdown with the default HTML renderer and no plugins can perform quadratic CPU work and keep a worker at 100 percent utilization. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.

CVE-2025-62165.description: Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, CivetWeb permits unauthenticated clients to flood the WebUI login page and API invalid paths without connection or request-rate limits. Repeated requests can consume substantial CPU in request processing and session authentication, making the WebUI sluggish or unresponsive and potentially affecting the wider system and DNS service. Requests to selected invalid or redirecting paths also generate a log entry for each request, allowing network traffic to expand logs and exhaust constrained storage such as an SD card, while other request forms consume CPU without producing a corresponding request log. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.7.

CVE-2026-102529.description: HtmlSanitizer is a .NET library for cleaning HTML fragments and documents from constructs that can lead to XSS attacks. Prior to 9.0.967 and 9.1.968-beta, HtmlSanitizer CSS style-declaration sanitization can process an attacker-controlled style attribute with quadratic cost because SanitizeStyleDeclaration repeatedly causes the complete declaration to be serialized while removing disallowed CSS properties. One unauthenticated request can occupy a synchronous application worker for seconds, and concurrent requests can saturate all workers and sustain denial of service. This issue is fixed in versions 9.0.967 and 9.1.968-beta.

CVE-2026-104796.description: Chevereto before 4.5.8 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to cause the server to issue arbitrary requests by supplying a malicious URL to the uploadToWebsite function, which fetches the raw source via fetch_url before the Upload::checkValidUrl SSRF guard can be invoked. Attackers can target loopback addresses, RFC1918 internal services, cloud instance metadata endpoints, and file/gopher/dict schemes through the /json upload action to disclose internal responses or credentials when the fetched content is stored and served back as a public image URL.

CVE-2026-65963.description: Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.6.2 until 6.7, PATCH /api/config accepts unfiltered CivetWeb lua_* options through webserver.advancedOpts, while POST /api/teleporter writes attacker-controlled content from a dhcp.leases archive entry through src/zip/teleporter.c without content validation. An authenticated administrator can place controlled file content on disk, point a Lua execution option at that file, and rely on the advancedOpts configuration change to restart FTL. CivetWeb then executes the file as Lua through the processing in src/webserver/webserver.c, allowing arbitrary commands to run as the pihole operating-system user and persist across restarts while the configuration and file remain. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

CVE-2026-65964.description: Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. Prior to 6.7, log_http_access in src/webserver/webserver.c writes attacker-controlled User-Agent content to the access log without output neutralization when debug.api is enabled. If an administrator configures files.log.webserver inside webserver.paths.webroot with a filename matching lua_server_page_pattern, an unauthenticated request can plant Lua markup in that log and a later request can cause CivetWeb to evaluate the log as a Lua server page. The resulting commands run as the pihole operating-system user and can access or modify pihole-owned configuration, credentials, databases, logs, and rendered interface content. When the log is not served through the Lua handler, the same unneutralized writer still permits log forgery and downstream log-parser injection. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

CVE-2026-65966.description: Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, validation in src/api/list.c permits spaces for GRAVITY_GROUPS and consequently skips carriage-return and line-feed validation for group names submitted through POST /api/groups. The unsanitized name is copied into the Location value in pi_hole_extra_headers, and CivetWeb interprets embedded CR/LF sequences as separate HTTP response headers. An authenticated administrator can therefore inject headers such as Set-Cookie, Location, or Cache-Control; when a browser processes the response, this can cause session fixation, attacker-controlled redirects, or cache behavior changes. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

CVE-2026-68918.description: Ikaros is a content management system for ACGMN media. Prior to 1.2.0, server/src/main/java/run/ikaros/server/core/tag/TagEndpoint.java does not enforce tag ownership for authenticated users with tag permissions. GET /tags/condition accepts an arbitrary userId and can enumerate another user's tags, DELETE /tag/id/{id} deletes a tag without comparing its owner to the requester, and DELETE /tag/condition omits userId from its filter and can delete every user's tags matching the supplied condition. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.0.

CVE-2026-69155.description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.30.0 until 0.40.3, an authenticated Agent with folder write access can use POST /upload to store HTML or SVG content that GET /download/{path} serves from the application origin through server/src/handlers/download.rs. The response sets Content-Disposition: inline and lacks forced attachment handling and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, allowing the browser to render the uploaded active content as the application. When a victim opens the link, the script can access the JavaScript-readable atomic_session cookie and the Agent private key in same-origin IndexedDB, enabling persistent account impersonation. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

CVE-2026-69156.description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.30.0 until 0.40.3, the Commit application path in lib/src/commit.rs allows an authenticated Agent to assign the server-managed internalId property to an owned resource without character validation. The /download handler in server/src/handlers/download.rs passes that value to filesystem path construction and NamedFile::open without sanitization, containment validation, or a File-class check, so traversal or absolute paths can read files available to the server process. Reading the server configuration can expose the root Agent private key and allow root impersonation with full read, write, and delete access to server data. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

CVE-2026-69157.description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.29.0 to 0.40.2, Atomic Server provisions a well-known /setup invite with write enabled, the Drive root as its target, and usagesLeft set to one. construct_invite_redirect in server/src/plugins/invite.rs discards the redeemer identity, so an unauthenticated request containing an attacker-controlled public-key can create a new Agent and grant it write access to the entire Drive. On a fresh, unclaimed deployment, this permits reading, modifying, or deleting resources, changing permissions, and creating or altering Agents. No complete fixed version was verified as of this review.

CVE-2026-69158.description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. Prior to 0.40.3, unauthenticated requests to /bookmark can supply a url that server/src/plugins/bookmark.rs passes through fetch_data to fetch_body. Endpoint dispatch in lib/src/db.rs invokes the handler before check_read, and lib/src/client/helpers.rs previously checked only that the URL began with HTTP, without restricting loopback, private, link-local, DNS-rebinding, or redirect targets. The handler reflects fetched content in returned resource fields, making this a full-response server-side request forgery that can expose internal services and plain-GET cloud metadata. The short request timeout limits slow targets, and metadata services requiring a separate token request are outside the demonstrated GET-only path. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

CVE-2026-71304.description: Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, check_client_auth() in src/api/auth.c detects that a matching session identifier has passed valid_until but still assigns user_id before the expired state can be rejected. That assignment sends execution through the authorized branch, renews valid_until for another timeout interval, and leaves the session-expired response unreachable. An attacker who possesses a previously valid session identifier can periodically reuse it to preserve administrative access indefinitely, making the configured session timeout ineffective. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

CVE-2026-103931.description: Instatic is an open source visual content management system for building static websites. Prior to 0.0.14, isSafeUrl() and safeUrl() in src/core/html-sanitize/index.ts remove tabs, newlines, carriage returns, and characters handled by String.prototype.trim(), but leave other leading C0 control characters that browsers discard before parsing a URL scheme. A low-privileged editor can place a dangerous URL behind one of those controls in a URL property or custom HTML attribute, allowing src/core/publisher/escapeProps.ts and the shared URL sanitizer to emit it into rendered content. When an Owner or Admin activates the element in the same-origin admin editor canvas, script executes with the victim's application authority and can drive admin APIs to read protected data, create an owner account, or install a plugin. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.14.

CVE-2026-109549.description: OmniFaces is a utility library for Faces. From 5.2 until 5.4.3, applications using <o:sse> or @Push(type=SSE) with session scope, view scope, or a user attribute can expose pushed messages because org.omnifaces.cdi.push.SseEndpoint#doGet accepts a channel identifier registered by SseChannelManager and PushSessionManager without verifying that the caller's HTTP session owns it. An attacker who obtains the victim's channel identifier from a logged URL, report, Referer header, or shared link can connect from a foreign or absent session and receive messages intended for the victim. Application-scoped channels are intentionally unbound, and this issue permits message receipt but not message injection. This issue is fixed in version 5.4.3.

CVE-2026-114782.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Hyperion Infrastructure Technology product of Oracle Hyperion (component: Common Events). The supported version that is affected is 11.2.26.0.000. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Hyperion Infrastructure Technology. CVE-2026-117552.description: Typecho before 1.3.1-rc contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the XML-RPC pingback.ping method where checkSafeHost() validates a hostname's resolved IP once but the subsequent outbound request performs an independent DNS resolution, creating a TOCTOU window exploitable via DNS rebinding. An unauthenticated attacker can configure a domain to return a benign IP at validation time and an internal address (loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata IP) at request time, causing the server to issue blind SSRF requests to arbitrary internal hosts and ports.

CVE-2026-129510.description: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the XmlLayout and XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J of Apache log4net. Both layouts split a message holding the CDATA end marker into several CDATA sections, but searched for the marker with a culture-sensitive comparison. Ignorable characters or a combining mark around the marker made the search miss it, so the CDATA section stayed open. From 3.3.1 on, an XML parser then reads the following log events as part of that message; earlier versions leave the log file not well-formed. A party whose data reaches a log message could hide later log events from a consumer that parses the XML log. This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-61675.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/atualiza_pagamentos.php performs payment-status database updates without checking whether the requester has an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester can supply a payment identifier, payment date, and paid value to mark arbitrary payment records as paid or otherwise modify payment information, causing financial record corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

CVE-2026-61676.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/cadastro_cobranca.php creates billing records without checking for an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies valid billing parameters can create arbitrary billing entries, enabling financial data manipulation and operational disruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

CVE-2026-61677.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/processa_edicao_socio.php updates member information without validating an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies a target member identifier and replacement member fields can modify arbitrary member records, corrupt personal information, and cause loss of data integrity. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

CVE-2026-61680.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.6, web/html/socio/sistema/cadastro_cobrancas_geracao.php performs privileged charge-generation operations without checking for an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies valid charge-generation parameters can create arbitrary charge records, enabling financial record manipulation and large-scale billing corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.6.

CVE-2026-61689.description: XWiki Platform is a generic wiki platform. From 4.3-milestone-1 until 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0, the /rest/wikis/{wikiName}/query REST endpoint permits HQL query construction that can combine blind conditions with FROM-clause injection to join BaseObject and StringProperty, bypassing the SELECT-column whitelist. An unauthenticated attacker can recover database values from inaccessible pages, including salted SHA1 password hashes and passwords stored in configuration properties. It should be assumed that, with more complex techniques, this can work even when the attacker cannot read any wiki page. A typical password hash may require roughly 800 requests, and expensive injected queries can also degrade availability. The issue is remediated by disabling HQL and XWQL REST queries by default. This issue is fixed in versions 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0.

CVE-2026-61713.description: Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.3.0, a sandboxed iframe can use declarative refresh to auto-navigate because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs does not enforce the sandboxed automatic-features flag. The bypass occurs with sandbox="", sandbox="allow-same-origin", sandbox="allow-forms", and sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-forms". Attacker-controlled framed content can replace itself without user action, enabling framed phishing, content replacement, redirect loops, and limited denial of service, but the issue does not by itself permit script execution or parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.

CVE-2026-61715.description: Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.4.0, a frame with sandbox="" can reach and execute a javascript: URL through declarative refresh because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs can reach JavaScript URL handling in components/script/script_thread.rs without enforcing the sandbox's script prohibition. This gives attacker-controlled content arbitrary JavaScript execution in a frame intended to be scriptless, including nested DOM probe creation and blind browser requests. The frame retains an opaque origin, so the issue does not by itself provide parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.0.

CVE-2026-63193.description: October System provides the system module for October Content Management System. Prior to 3.7.18 and 4.3.2, the Media Library MediaManager::onCropImage and cropImage path accepts a user-controlled destination filename without applying the default_extensions allowlist enforced by the normal upload path. An authenticated backend user with media.library.create permission can upload arbitrary bytes under an allowed extension and use the zero-dimension crop branch, which performs a byte-for-byte File::copy, to write those bytes into the public media folder under an attacker-selected extension. Default server configurations block PHP execution in that folder, but HTML or SVG output can produce stored cross-site scripting in the application origin; non-default servers that execute PHP in the media directory can expose remote code execution. This vulnerability is fixed in 3.7.18 and 4.3.2.

CVE-2026-69187.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, web/controle/control.php authorizes FuncionarioControle requests only by checking whether an authenticated employee has a permission row for resource 11 or 91, while MiddlewareDAO::verificarPermissao() does not compare the stored id_acao value or authorize the requested method. An employee with any such permission and a valid CSRF token from the employee's own session can invoke FuncionarioControle::adicionarPermissao, FuncionarioControle::alterarPermissao, or FuncionarioControle::excluirPermissao to add, change, or remove permissions for arbitrary roles. This can grant higher action levels over sensitive resources, expose or modify protected employee, patient, configuration, and administrative data, or disrupt legitimate access by changing other roles. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

CVE-2026-69188.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, a user with backup-management permission can upload a crafted gzip-compressed tar archive through web/html/configuracao/importar_dump.php, after which web/controle/control.php accepts a user-controlled modulo value and combines it with nomeClasse for require_once(). By using a phar:// path to the uploaded archive and selecting the whitelisted InternoControle, whose empty resource list is treated as authorized, the user can cause an embedded controller file and its requested method to execute as the web-server process. The attack path depends on the configured BKP_DIR, and enabling phar.readonly or phar.require_hash does not prevent PHP from reading the gzip tar archive through phar://. Successful exploitation permits access to or modification of sensitive data, configuration, credentials, source files, host commands, and services reachable by the web-server account. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

CVE-2026-121757.description: Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library version 2.1 or later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When the CP949 decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\xa2\xe8' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice. If //IGNORE is set on the destination encoding and this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer. To exploit this, the target iconv function needs to set //IGNORE on the destination of the conversion and the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

CVE-2026-121758.description: Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44 may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When the ISO-2022-CN-EXT decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\x0e' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice. If this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer. To exploit this, the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

CVE-2026-124024.description: Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When converting from UCS-4, these encoders may encounter a combining base such as U+00E6 and jump ahead by 4 bytes to check the next UCS-4 code point. The check for end of buffer however does not account for this, which may result in a buffer overread if the following code point has less than 4 bytes remaining. Exploitation of this bug not only requires attacker control of input and encoding, but also strict control over layout of the input in memory.

CVE-2026-129511.description: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the FileAppender, RollingFileAppender, UdpAppender and SmtpAppender of Apache log4net. Characters the configured encoding could not represent were converted by that encoding's best-fit fallback, which turns fullwidth characters such as U+FF1C, U+FF1E and U+FF02 into <, > and ". The conversion happened after XmlLayout or XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J had escaped the text, so a party whose data reaches a log message could forge complete log events in an XML log, for example a fake audit entry. On .NET Framework this needs no configuration where the ANSI code page is single-byte, since that is the default encoding; on .NET it needs a configured single-byte encoding such as ISO-8859-1. This is the best-fit conversion described by the WorstFit research. This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-129512.description: Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character vulnerability in the AdoNetAppender of Apache log4net. Text parameters were bound unchanged, so a NUL character or an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate reached the database as it was. A database that refuses such a value, such as PostgreSQL, rejected the insert and the event was lost; only the first such loss per appender was reported. A party whose data reaches a log message could suppress that event. This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-129891.description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public suffix list because update_self_from_url fetches it over cleartext HTTP with no integrity check. Called with no argument, as the module's documentation shows, the updater fetches the list from the `http://` address in the URL constant and checks only that the request succeeded, with no signature or digest over the response. The lines that come back are written into the module's own source file as the built-in list. An attacker on the network path when the updater runs chooses the suffix boundary the module reports to every caller on the host, and that answer persists in the installed module until it is reinstalled. Dropping one rule makes the hostname check in IO::Socket::SSL accept a wildcard certificate that spans the whole public suffix that rule named.

CVE-2026-129892.description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url rewrites the module's source. The rewrite copies the module's source down to the built-in list's heredoc and appends each fetched line below it. Nothing checks that a line looks like a domain. A line that is not a comment loses only what follows a `//` and its trailing whitespace, so a line reading END_BUILTIN_DATA is appended as it stands and ends the data block in the rewritten file. Every fetched line after it is Perl. Arbitrary Perl runs in every process that loads IO::Socket::SSL, which loads this module unconditionally, until the file is reinstalled. The attacker must control the fetched list, through the cleartext default URL or a caller-supplied one, and the updater must run with write access to the installed module.

CVE-2026-131842.description: Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.

CVE-2026-131843.description: Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href attributes without escaping in HTML output modes. Attackers can craft a PDF whose /URI entry contains a double quote followed by HTML markup or event handlers to execute script in browsers viewing the generated HTML.

CVE-2026-131844.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in CurlCachedFileLoader::init(). Malicious HTTP servers can return an enormous Content-Length so CachedFile resizes its chunk cache accordingly, aborting pdfinfo or PDFDocFactory-based applications with std::bad_alloc for denial of service.

CVE-2026-131845.description: Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() that allows local attackers to obtain valid signatures over altered content. Attackers with write access to the output file or directory can overwrite or swap the PDF between writing and hashing, causing the signer's key to sign attacker-controlled content.

CVE-2026-131846.description: Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in splashModeDeviceN8. Attackers can supply a PDF with an ICCBased image whose alternate is DeviceN, causing getDeviceNLine() to overflow the per-row buffer, crashing the renderer and corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-131847.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated signature verification. Attackers can supply a signed PDF embedding the signer certificate to crash applications or pdfsig runs validating multiple signatures, or cause incorrect certificate validation results.

CVE-2026-131848.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

CVE-2026-131849.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice SZL responses. A rogue or impersonated PLC can keep flagging more data with attacker-controlled DLen slices, overflowing the 65536-byte opData buffer via Cli_ReadSZL() and Cli_ReadSZLList(), crashing the client and corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-131850.description: ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

CVE-2026-131851.description: ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

CVE-2026-131852.description: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

CVE-2026-131853.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking remaining packet bytes. A malicious SSHv1 client or server in an intercepted session can send a short packet with a large data_len to disclose up to 64 bytes of adjacent heap memory through captured credentials in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131854.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131855.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.

CVE-2026-131856.description: Pika before 1.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious brokers to exhaust client memory by declaring oversized frame payloads. Attackers can send frame headers declaring up to 4 GiB payloads, unchecked against frame_max, or very large message bodies to terminate consuming applications.

CVE-2026-131857.description: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

CVE-2026-92182.description: Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

CVE-2026-111801.description: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from private repositories they could not access. An attacker required an authenticated account, a readable repository and pull request to use as the request context, and target review-thread identifiers. The thread-preview endpoint resolved supplied identifiers without restricting them to the authorized pull request, exposing private file paths and, when positioning and diff data were available, source-code excerpts, commit identifiers, and line metadata without victim interaction. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.21, 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.21.10, 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-112740.description: A command injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated site administrator to execute arbitrary commands as the host git user on peer Git server nodes outside the pre-receive hook sandbox by supplying a crafted pre-receive environment download URL. Exploitation required a clustered deployment using custom pre-receive hook environments and at least one peer Git server node. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, 3.20.12, and 3.19.16. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-105929.description: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influenced content.

CVE-2026-106096.description: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

CVE-2026-110307.description: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-112115.description: An untrusted search path in ASUS Armoury Crate allows a local, low-privileged user to achieve privilege escalation by executing a crafted library at a high integrity level, via user-controlled environment settings inherited by an elevated process. Refer to the ' Security Update for Armoury Crate App ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-112117.description: A Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in ASUS System Control Interface , allows a local, low-privileged user to gain full control over arbitrary existing files and folders outside the allowed directories via a crafted path containing dot-segment sequences that satisfies a folder prefix check, which can lead to unauthorized read and modification of protected files and may result in local privilege escalation. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS System Control Interface ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-114202.description: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-114204.description: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to bypass authentication by forging a session token for an account with a recent valid login, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-114205.description: Incorrect authorization in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote authenticated user with a low-privileged role to create an administrator account, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-116637.description: A site administrator could modify files on the appliance host with root privileges and disclose private repository data due to improper path validation in GitHub Enterprise Server. Exploitation required a crafted pre-receive hook environment. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-116643.description: An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private repositories within the trusted certificate authority's scope. Exploitation required an instance using built-in authentication and a valid certificate issued to the attacker by a trusted SSH certificate authority. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-119469.description: Incorrect default permissions in the ASUS DisplayWidget Center allow a local, low-privileged user to achieve arbitrary code execution in the security context of another user via a crafted executable placed in that user-writable directory, which the application launches when the other user runs it and uses a particular feature.Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Display Widget Center ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-126574.description: Missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Control Center Datacenter and Control Center Enterprise allows remote authenticated users with a low-privileged Viewer role to change the password of an Administrator account, thereby obtaining administrative privileges, via a crafted password update request. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-131647.description: A CRLF injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a user with write access to a repository to bypass branch protections and update branches or tags in that repository through specially crafted input when resolving pull request conflicts. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-131820.description: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated user with repository write access to send requests to internal services through Slack webhook validity checks, potentially leading to remote code execution on the appliance. Exploitation required Secret Protection with secret scanning and validity checks for partner patterns enabled. This vulnerability affected all versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, and 3.20.12. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-19399.description: Improper Authentication and Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in ASUS Router firmware allow an unauthenticated nearby user to perform file operations or read files in an unintended directory via crafted HTTP requests during an active user session. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-88711.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in certain ASUS Router firmware models allows an remote attacker to to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges by inducing a logged-in administrator to visit a malicious website. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-88760.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in certain ASUS Router firmware allows unauthenticated nearby users to obtain router information and resources (e.g., multimedia files) via HTTP requests. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-93458.description: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a remote attacker to obtain router’s UID or login authorization tokens for the victim's linked account via a crafted web page, which requires a logged-in router administrator to actively complete the third-party authorization flow. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-93459.description: Use of externally-controlled format string in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a nearby administrator to read or write memory, potentially resulting in a denial-of-service, via crafted format specifiers sent to the logging/summary function. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

8849f0b6eb7336d31db56e64.title_ko: 중국 업체, 유탄발사기·포획망 장착 가능한 원격 진압 로봇 공개
8849f0b6eb7336d31db56e64.summary_ko: 중국 군경 장비업체 블러드윙 테크놀로지가 원격 조종 폭동 진압 로봇 차량 ‘War Bear’를 개발했다. 무한궤도로 이동하며 38mm 유탄발사기·최루탄·포획망 등을 장착할 수 있고, 업체는 장비를 바꾸면 정찰과 폭발물 처리 등에도 활용할 수 있다고 설명했다.
8849f0b6eb7336d31db56e64.background_ko: 경찰이 위험 지역에 직접 접근하지 않고도 폭동 진압 작전을 수행할 수 있도록 만든 원격 조종 무인 차량이다.

c6d97c03dd402eb660c3e76d.title_ko: Optimizely 취약점 악용해 178개 조직 웹사이트에 악성 코드 유입
c6d97c03dd402eb660c3e76d.summary_ko: Report URI는 Optimizely를 통해 178개 조직의 웹사이트에 악성 JavaScript가 유입됐다고 보고했다. 악성 코드에는 결제정보·쿠키 탈취 기능과 구형 iPhone·iPad를 겨냥한 공격 코드가 포함됐으며, Optimizely는 취약점 수정과 삽입 코드 제거를 완료했다고 밝혔다.
c6d97c03dd402eb660c3e76d.background_ko: Optimizely는 공격자가 Experimentation의 취약점을 악용해 일부 고객 프로젝트에 악성 JavaScript를 삽입했다고 밝혔다.

curation.reason_ko: 178개 조직에 악성 스크립트가 전달된 공급망 사고로, 제3자 웹 코드 관리의 위험을 드러냈다.

978233edaf72cb24e0b46fef.title_ko: 엔비디아 이사회, 젠슨 황 복귀 배제…후임 CEO 물색
978233edaf72cb24e0b46fef.summary_ko: 보도에 따르면 엔비디아 이사회는 젠슨 황의 CEO 복귀를 배제하고 전문 업체를 통해 내부·외부 후임 후보 검토에 나섰다. 3분기 매출은 전년보다 두 배 이상 늘었지만, 중국향 Hopper 칩 출하 중단과 경영진 교체로 AI 인프라 투자 전략의 향방이 주목된다.
978233edaf72cb24e0b46fef.background_ko: 이사회 의장은 회사의 행동강령과 조직문화에 맞지 않는 개인적 행동이 공개된 뒤 황이 자발적으로 사임했다고 설명했다.

curation.reason_ko: 엔비디아 이사회가 젠슨 황의 CEO 복귀를 배제하고 후임 선임에 나서 경영 전환 방향이 구체화됐다.

de41ff5fe6301cf8efbf1ee1.title_ko: 박정훈, 수능 시간 AI 문제 풀이 제한·시험장 전파 차단 입법 추진
de41ff5fe6301cf8efbf1ee1.summary_ko: 박정훈 국민의힘 의원이 수능 시험 시간에 AI의 문항 이미지 분석과 정답 생성을 제한하도록 정부가 구글 등 AI 기업에 협조를 요청해야 한다고 주장했다. AI 사업자와의 협력을 의무화하는 고등교육법 개정안과 시험장 전파 차단을 허용하는 전파법 개정안 발의도 예고했다.
de41ff5fe6301cf8efbf1ee1.background_ko: 박 의원은 AI·첨단 장비를 이용한 부정행위를 막기에 기존 수능 대책이 부족하다며 AI 서비스 제한과 전파 차단을 요구했다.

9298accace71dabfa91f8d82.title_ko: 미 NSA 기밀 통신망 장애…핵심 임무는 정상 운영
9298accace71dabfa91f8d82.summary_ko: 미 국가안보국(NSA)의 기밀 내부 통신망 NSANet에 장애가 발생해 일부 시스템 운영이 영향을 받았다. NSA는 정기 유지보수 중 일시적인 성능 저하가 있었지만 핵심 임무는 정상 수행 중이라고 밝혔으며, 구체적인 원인과 장애 범위는 공개하지 않았다. 미 당국은 최근 잇따른 전산 장애가 사이버공격과 연관됐다는 증거는 없다고 설명했다.

d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.title_ko: Cisco Talos, OpenJDK 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-114938 공개
d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.summary_ko: Cisco Talos는 OpenJDK Java 17.0.6 이상에서 조작된 Base64 입력으로 인증 없이 원격 코드 실행이 가능할 수 있는 취약점을 공개했다. AVX-512 VBMI가 활성화된 x86-64 환경이 대상이며 CVSS 4.0 점수는 9.2라고 설명했다. 실제 악용은 아직 관측되지 않았으며, 업데이트 적용이나 JVM의 AVX-512 사용 비활성화를 권고했다.
d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.background_ko: Talos에 따르면 AVX-512 VBMI가 활성화된 일부 x86-64 JVM에서 잘못된 Base64 입력을 처리할 때 원격 코드 실행이 발생할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Talos가 특정 CPU 환경의 OpenJDK 원격 코드 실행 위험을 경고했으며 실제 악용은 관측하지 못했다.

0cffca88b39abb84a21edcd9.title_ko: 미국, 빅테크 반대에도 중국산 데이터센터 광트랜시버 수입 제한 추진
0cffca88b39abb84a21edcd9.summary_ko: 로이터 보도에 따르면 미국 정부는 빅테크의 반대에도 중국산 신형 광트랜시버 수입 금지를 계속 추진하고 있다. 관련 기업들은 조치 이행에 최장 10년이 걸릴 수 있다고 주장했으며, 행정부 기류에 따라 규제가 보류될 가능성도 거론됐다.
0cffca88b39abb84a21edcd9.background_ko: 미 정가에서는 중국산 광트랜시버가 데이터 탈취나 악성코드 설치, 서비스 방해에 악용될 수 있다는 국가안보 우려가 제기됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국의 중국산 광트랜시버 수입 제한 추진에 빅테크가 반발해 데이터센터 공급망의 정책 불확실성이 커졌다.

8d8efd1deef14a69c27d2a37.title_ko: 현대차, 12월 웨이모에 로보택시용 아이오닉 5 공급…해외 수출도 추진
8d8efd1deef14a69c27d2a37.summary_ko: 현대차는 2026년 12월 웨이모에 아이오닉 5를 로보택시 전용 차량으로 공급할 계획이다. 차량에는 웨이모의 6세대 자율주행 시스템이 탑재되며, 호세 무뇨스 사장은 미국 시장 공급뿐 아니라 해외 수출도 이뤄질 것이라고 밝혔다. 모셔널을 통한 미국 로보택시 서비스도 추진한다.
8d8efd1deef14a69c27d2a37.background_ko: 현대차는 2024년 10월 아이오닉 5에 웨이모의 6세대 자율주행 시스템을 탑재하는 다년간 전략적 파트너십을 체결했다.

curation.reason_ko: 현대차가 12월 Waymo용 아이오닉 5 공급과 수출 계획을 밝혀 로보택시 차량 생산 협력이 구체화됐다.

716dd0390c4a624cd016c825.title_ko: 초소형 카메라·AI 활용 시험 부정행위 적발…시험장 탐지·점검 강화
716dd0390c4a624cd016c825.summary_ko: 보도에 따르면 세무사 시험에서 초소형 카메라와 AI를 이용한 부정행위가 적발됐다. 기사는 이에 대한 대응으로 수능 시험장 열화상 카메라 투입과 국가자격시험 전수조사, IT 자산 조사 및 소프트웨어 자재명세서(SBOM) 조기 도입 등이 추진되고 있다고 전했다.
716dd0390c4a624cd016c825.background_ko: 초소형 카메라와 AI를 활용한 세무사 시험 부정행위 적발을 계기로 시험장 내 AI 악용 차단과 점검 강화가 추진됐다.

9f7db2018a9c2d97d484d0ae.title_ko: AI스페라, 모의해킹·위협 분석 자동화 플랫폼 AITEM 출시 예고
9f7db2018a9c2d97d484d0ae.summary_ko: AI스페라는 AI 기반 위협 노출 관리 플랫폼 ‘Criminal IP AITEM’을 19일 정식 출시한다고 밝혔다. 회사 설명에 따르면 기존 공격표면관리 기능에 AI 에이전트, 취약점 영향 분석과 AI 모의해킹을 결합했다. 외부 노출 자산 탐지부터 위험 검증, 반복적인 조회·알림 업무까지 자동화를 지원한다.
9f7db2018a9c2d97d484d0ae.background_ko: 기업이 관리해야 할 자산과 취약점이 늘면서 자사에 실제 영향을 미치는 위험을 선별하고 대응으로 연결할 필요성이 커졌다.

8f645aad3234b5eada33ca19.title_ko: 보스턴다이나믹스, 2027년 반도체 제조 현장서 아틀라스 시험
8f645aad3234b5eada33ca19.summary_ko: 보스턴다이나믹스는 글로벌파운드리와 협력해 2027년 초부터 반도체 제조 현장에서 휴머노이드 로봇 아틀라스를 시험한다. 활용 가능한 작업과 요구 조건을 확인하고 초기 작업 학습을 진행할 예정이다. 사족보행 로봇 스팟의 배치도 미국·독일·싱가포르 생산시설로 확대한다.
8f645aad3234b5eada33ca19.background_ko: 이번 협력은 반도체 제조 현장에서 휴머노이드의 활용 작업과 요구 조건을 확인하고 AI 기반 제조를 확대하기 위해 추진됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 보스턴다이나믹스가 반도체 제조 현장에서 Atlas를 검증하기로 해 휴머노이드의 산업 적용 범위가 확장된다.

472c75760ebfecefe8e278e3.title_ko: 팔로알토 조사, 기업 40% “AI 에이전트 작업 사후 재구성 못 해”
472c75760ebfecefe8e278e3.summary_ko: 팔로알토 네트웍스가 10개국 경영진·실무자 2,800명을 조사한 결과, 응답 조직의 40%가 AI 에이전트의 작업을 사후 재구성하지 못한다고 답했다. 코드 보안 문제를 운영환경에서 수정하기까지는 평균 18.4일이 걸렸다. 한국 기업만을 대상으로 한 통계는 아니다.
472c75760ebfecefe8e278e3.background_ko: 보고서는 빠른 서비스 출시 압박과 개발 속도 저하에 대한 우려를 보안 문제 수정 지연의 주요 배경으로 분석했다.

0cc2e28fceba92242e044b4e.title_ko: 라쿠텐증권, 테스트 환경 고객정보 유출 가능성…최대 447만 계좌 상세정보
0cc2e28fceba92242e044b4e.summary_ko: 라쿠텐증권은 테스트 환경의 고객정보가 유출됐을 가능성을 확인했으며, 상세 개인정보는 최대 약 447만 계좌, 고객코드·로그인 ID는 최대 약 1125만 계좌가 영향 범위라고 밝혔다. 두 수치는 합산할 수 없으며 침입 원인은 조사 중이다. 발표 당시 비밀번호 유출이나 계정 무단 접속·부정거래는 확인되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 라쿠텐증권이 최대 약 447만 계좌의 상세 고객정보 유출 가능성을 밝혀 금융 개인정보 보호 대응이 중요하다.

ae53905bbe84e031c0120244.title_ko: VLA 로보틱스 입문서, 모델 학습부터 실물 로봇 제어까지 실습
ae53905bbe84e031c0120244.summary_ko: 김병규의 ‘VLA 로보틱스 입문’은 시각·언어·행동 모델의 원리부터 데이터 수집, 파인튜닝, 실물 로봇 제어까지 다루는 실습서다. MuJoCo와 LeRobot, SmolVLA를 활용하며, 대부분의 실습은 개인 PC와 무료 코랩으로 진행할 수 있다고 소개됐다.

306bb7287b1043f521fa057d.title_ko: 앤트로픽 공모가, 희망 범위 상단 웃돌 가능성…CNBC 보도

12f6bc47aa3c9164d517b993.title_ko: 문샷 AI, 생물학·화학 연구에 키미 활용…과학적 발견 경쟁 가세
12f6bc47aa3c9164d517b993.summary_ko: 문샷 AI가 키미를 생물학·화학·신약 개발에 활용하며 과학적 발견을 차세대 경쟁 분야로 내세웠다. DP테크놀로지는 키미 K3.1 프로를 통합한 BioMaster가 생쥐 세포 유전자 데이터를 약 90분 만에 분석해 후보 유전자 100개를 찾았다고 발표했다. 다만 이는 연구 자동화 사례로, 새로운 과학적 발견을 입증한 성과와는 구별된다.
12f6bc47aa3c9164d517b993.background_ko: 최첨단 AI의 경쟁 기준이 정해진 벤치마크 문제 해결에서 새로운 지식을 만들어내는 능력으로 확대되면서 범용 모델 개발사들도 과학 연구에 집중하고 있다.

73b45fb1511b27e2ce12ea65.title_original: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
73b45fb1511b27e2ce12ea65.excerpt: arXiv:2611.03330v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs without per-LLM fitting, and no law names the factors that set it. From closed-form expressions of LLM inference's computational and memory-access complexity, we derive the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache and next-token computation cost. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from several families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. SIMPLE explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and higher GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy linearly relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; accuracy rises but energy rises faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14x across a 4.0x range. summary.title_ko: chrome-devtools-mcp, 코딩 에이전트용 Chrome DevTools 저장소

summary.summary_ko: plannotator는 사용자가 에이전트 작업에 관여하며 계획을 세우고, 의사결정과 주석 작성, 코드 검토를 수행하도록 돕는 작업 공간이다. 팀원과 내용을 공유하고 모든 피드백을 한 번의 클릭으로 에이전트에 전달하는 기능을 내세운다.

summary.title_ko: uptime-kuma, 자체 호스팅 방식의 모니터링 도구
summary.summary_ko: uptime-kuma는 사용자가 직접 호스팅해 운영하는 모니터링 도구로 소개된 저장소다.

summary.title_ko: claude-trading-skills, 주식 투자·트레이딩용 Claude Code 스킬 모음
summary.summary_ko: claude-trading-skills는 주식 투자자와 트레이더를 위한 Claude Code 스킬 저장소다. 시장 분석, 기술적 차트 분석, 경제 일정, 종목 선별, 매매 전략 개발을 위한 스킬을 제공한다고 소개한다.

summary.title_ko: airgorah, 와이파이 보안 점검 소프트웨어
summary.summary_ko: airgorah는 와이파이 보안을 점검하는 소프트웨어다.

summary.title_ko: AG-UI, 에이전트와 사용자의 상호작용을 위한 프로토콜

summary.title_ko: Veyra-NRVideo, AI 초해상도·프레임 생성 결합한 Windows 영상 도구
summary.summary_ko: Veyra-NRVideo는 영상·이미지·캡처 카드 입력의 실시간 미리보기와 AI 기반 화질 개선을 표방하는 Windows용 도구다. 저장소 측은 DLSS 5 영상 개선과 프레임 생성을 결합해 PS5 GTA6를 120FPS로 구현하는 것을 내세운다.

summary.title_ko: caveman, 간결한 표현으로 코딩 에이전트 토큰 절감 표방

summary.title_ko: Claude-BugHunter, 버그 탐색·외부 레드팀 작업용 Claude Code 스킬 모음
summary.summary_ko: Claude Code에서 버그 탐색과 외부 레드팀 작업에 활용하도록 구성된 스킬 묶음이다. 저장소 설명에 따르면 스킬 82개와 슬래시 명령 15개, 핵심 취약점 24개 분류에서 선별한 공개 보고서 패턴 681개를 담았으며, 기업용 신원 체계와 인프라 공격 매트릭스도 포함한다.

summary.title_ko: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator, AI 에이전트 스킬을 평가하는 다단계 프레임워크
summary.summary_ko: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator는 AI 에이전트의 스킬을 평가하는 다단계 프레임워크다. 품질 검증 단계, 의미적 중복 탐지, 합성 평가 데이터셋 생성 기능을 제공하며, 실제 에이전트 평가를 통해 스킬이 에이전트 행동에 미치는 영향을 측정한다.

summary.title_ko: google-labs-code/stitch-skills, Stitch MCP 연동용 에이전트 스킬 모음

summary.background_ko: 여러 코딩 에이전트와의 호환성을 확보하기 위해 각 스킬이 Agent Skills 공개 표준을 따르도록 설계됐다.

summary.title_ko: ggml-org/ggml: 기계학습용 텐서 라이브러리
summary.summary_ko: 기계학습을 위한 텐서 라이브러리 저장소다.

summary.title_ko: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator, AI 에이전트 스킬·플러그인 평가 프레임워크
summary.summary_ko: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator는 AI 에이전트의 스킬과 플러그인을 여러 단계로 평가하는 프레임워크다. 품질 기준 검사, 의미적 중복 탐지, 합성 평가 데이터 생성과 함께 스킬이 에이전트 동작에 미치는 영향을 측정하는 실제 에이전트 평가 기능을 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: ffmpeg-skill, 코딩 에이전트용 로컬 영상 편집 도구 공개
summary.summary_ko: ffmpeg-skill은 Claude Code, Cursor, Codex에서 사용할 수 있는 로컬 영상 편집 저장소로, FFmpeg 도구 42개와 기계 판독형 규약, MCP 서버를 제공한다. 영상 자르기, 자막, 화면 재구성, 음량 조정과 플랫폼별 내보내기를 지원하며 클라우드나 API 키가 필요 없다고 소개한다.

summary.title_ko: PaperOrchestra, 다중 에이전트 기반 AI 연구 논문 작성 자동화 프레임워크

summary.title_ko: Cursor 플러그인 명세와 공식 플러그인 저장소
